answer.en: No. Even a tiny amount of alcohol can be extremely toxic to cats, and cats are especially sensitive to it. Keep drinks, foods made with alcohol and products like hand sanitiser away from your cat, and call your vet if your cat swallows any.
answer.sl: Ne. Že zelo majhna količina alkohola je lahko za mačke izjemno strupena, mačke pa so nanj še posebej občutljive. Pijače, hrano z alkoholom in izdelke, kot je razkužilo za roke, hranite stran od muce in pokličite veterinarja, če ga kaj zaužije.

why.en: All animals can get alcohol poisoning, but cats are especially sensitive. Alcohol is not only in drinks: it can also be in liqueur sweets, hand sanitiser, mouthwash and raw, rising bread dough. Signs usually appear quickly after a cat swallows it.
why.sl: Zastrupitev z alkoholom lahko doleti vse živali, mačke pa so še posebej občutljive. Alkohol ni le v pijačah: najdemo ga tudi v bonbonih z likerjem, razkužilu za roke, ustni vodici in surovem, vzhajajočem testu. Znaki se navadno pokažejo hitro po zaužitju.

en: In severe cases: seizures or collapse
sl: V hudih primerih: krči ali kolaps

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away. Note what your cat swallowed, how much and when, and keep the bottle or packaging. Don't wait for signs to appear, and don't try to make your cat sick at home.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Zapišite, kaj je muca zaužila, koliko in kdaj, ter shranite steklenico ali embalažo. Ne čakajte na znake in muce doma ne poskušajte spraviti k bruhanju.

child.en: Grown-up drinks are never for cats. If kitty licks a glass or spilled drink, tell a grown-up right away.
child.sl: Pijače za odrasle niso nikoli za muce. Če muca poliže kozarec ali razlito pijačo, takoj povej odraslemu.

q.en: Where else can alcohol hide?
q.sl: Kje vse se lahko skriva alkohol?

a.en: Besides drinks, alcohol can be found in liqueur sweets, hand sanitiser, mouthwash and raw, rising bread dough.
a.sl: Poleg pijač je alkohol lahko tudi v bonbonih z likerjem, razkužilu za roke, ustni vodici ter surovem, vzhajajočem testu.

answer.en: No, almonds are best kept away from cats. Sweet almonds aren't considered toxic, but they are high in oils and fats and can make a cat unwell, with stomach upset or vomiting.
answer.sl: Ne, mandljev mački raje ne dajajte. Sladki mandlji ne veljajo za strupene, vendar imajo veliko olj in maščob in lahko mački povzročijo slabo počutje, razdražen želodec ali bruhanje.

why.en: Cats Protection lists almonds among nuts that contain high amounts of oils and fats which can make a cat unwell. The ASPCA says sweet almonds sold for eating are not toxic to pets, but because they are not a normal part of a pet's diet they can cause digestive issues. Bitter almonds contain a cyanide compound and are considered toxic.
why.sl: Cats Protection mandlje navaja med oreščki, ki vsebujejo veliko olj in maščob, zaradi katerih se mačka lahko slabo počuti. ASPCA navaja, da sladki mandlji, ki se prodajajo za uživanje, za hišne živali niso strupeni, a ker niso del njihove običajne prehrane, lahko povzročijo prebavne težave. Grenki mandlji vsebujejo cianidno spojino in veljajo za strupene.

what_to_do.en: If your cat ate almonds, contact your vet for advice, especially if she ate a lot or seems unwell. Note what she ate, how much and when. If they were bitter almonds, contact your vet straight away.
what_to_do.sl: Če je muca pojedla mandlje, se za nasvet obrnite na veterinarja, zlasti če jih je pojedla veliko ali se ne počuti dobro. Zapišite, kaj je pojedla, koliko in kdaj. Če so bili to grenki mandlji, takoj pokličite veterinarja.

child.en: Almonds are a snack for people. They are too oily for cats, so keep them in your lunchbox.
child.sl: Mandlji so prigrizek za ljudi. Za mucke so preveč mastni, zato naj ostanejo v tvoji malici.

q.en: What about bitter almonds?
q.sl: Kaj pa grenki mandlji?

a.en: Bitter almonds contain a cyanide compound and are considered toxic. If your cat ate bitter almonds, contact your vet straight away.
a.sl: Grenki mandlji vsebujejo cianidno spojino in veljajo za strupene. Če je mačka pojedla grenke mandlje, takoj pokličite veterinarja.

q.en: Are some nuts worse than others?
q.sl: Ali so nekateri oreščki hujši od drugih?

a.en: Yes. Macadamia nuts are fatty and also toxic to cats, so they are the ones to be most careful with.
a.sl: Da. Makadamije so mastne in za mačke tudi strupene, zato je pri njih potrebna največja previdnost.

answer.en: No, it's best not to. The ASPCA lists the apricot plant as toxic to cats: its stems, leaves and seeds (the stone) contain cyanide. Don't offer apricots to your cat, keep stones and plant parts out of reach, and call your vet if your cat chews any.
answer.sl: Ne, raje ne. ASPCA rastlino marelice navaja kot strupeno za mačke: njeni peclji, listi in semena (koščice) vsebujejo cianid. Muci ne ponujajte marelic, koščice in dele rastline hranite izven dosega ter pokličite veterinarja, če jih muca grizlja.

why.en: The stems, leaves and seeds contain cyanide (as cyanogenic glycosides) and are particularly toxic while wilting. The sources we found describe the risk from these plant parts and do not say the fruit flesh is safe for cats, so we do not recommend sharing it.
why.sl: Peclji, listi in semena vsebujejo cianid (v obliki cianogenih glikozidov) in so posebej strupeni, ko venejo. Viri, ki smo jih našli, opisujejo nevarnost teh delov rastline in ne navajajo, da je sadni del za mačke varen, zato ga ne priporočamo.

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away if your cat chewed a stone, stem or leaves. Note what was eaten, how much and when. Don't wait for signs to appear, and don't try to make your cat sick at home.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali, če je muca grizljala koščico, peclje ali liste. Zapišite, kaj je pojedla, koliko in kdaj. Ne čakajte na znake in muce doma ne poskušajte spraviti k bruhanju.

child.en: Apricots are a people snack. Their stones and leaves are not safe for cats, so tell a grown-up if kitty chews one.
child.sl: Marelice so priboljšek za ljudi. Koščice in listi niso varni za muce. Če jih muca grizlja, povej odraslemu.

q.en: Which part is the problem?
q.sl: Kateri del je nevaren?

a.en: The ASPCA says the stems, leaves and seeds contain cyanide, and that they are particularly toxic while wilting.
a.sl: ASPCA navaja, da cianid vsebujejo peclji, listi in semena ter da so posebej strupeni, ko venejo.

answer.en: It's best not to. Avocado is high in fat and contains a toxin called persin, and Cats Protection says eating a lot of it can cause health problems in cats. Avocado is mainly dangerous to birds, horses and some other animals, but it's still not a good food for cats.
answer.sl: Raje ne. Avokado je zelo masten in vsebuje toksin persin, Cats Protection pa navaja, da lahko večja količina mačkam povzroči zdravstvene težave. Avokado je najbolj nevaren za ptice, konje in nekatere druge živali, za mačke pa vseeno ni primerna hrana.

why.en: Sources disagree. Cats Protection lists avocado among foods toxic to cats because of its high fat content and persin, with problems when large amounts are eaten. The ASPCA plant database lists avocado as toxic to horses only and says it is mainly a problem for birds, rabbits, horses and ruminants. We use the stricter view and do not recommend it.
why.sl: Viri se razlikujejo. Cats Protection uvršča avokado med živila, strupena za mačke, zaradi visoke vsebnosti maščob in persina, težave pa omenja pri večjih količinah. ASPCA ga v bazi rastlin navaja kot strupenega le za konje in pravi, da je predvsem težava za ptice, kunce, konje in prežvekovalce. Izberemo strožje stališče in ga ne priporočamo.

en: Any sign of being unwell after eating a lot of it (our sources do not list specific signs in cats)
sl: Kakršen koli znak slabega počutja po večji količini (naši viri ne navajajo posebnih znakov pri mačkah)

what_to_do.en: If your cat ate avocado, contact your vet for advice, especially if a lot was eaten or your cat seems unwell. Note how much your cat ate and when.
what_to_do.sl: Če je muca pojedla avokado, se za nasvet obrnite na veterinarja, zlasti če ga je pojedla veliko ali se ne počuti dobro. Zapišite, koliko ga je pojedla in kdaj.

child.en: Avocado is a people food. It's too fatty for cats, so give kitty her own cat treats instead.
child.sl: Avokado je hrana za ljudi. Za muco je premasten, zato ji raje daj njene mačje priboljške.

q.en: Is avocado poisonous for cats like it is for birds?
q.sl: Je avokado za mačke strupen kot za ptice?

a.en: The ASPCA says avocado is primarily a problem for birds, rabbits, donkeys, horses and ruminants. Cats Protection still advises against it for cats because of its fat and persin.
a.sl: ASPCA pravi, da je avokado predvsem težava za ptice, kunce, osle, konje in prežvekovalce. Cats Protection ga mačkam vseeno odsvetuje zaradi maščob in persina.

answer.en: Yes, a little plain, well-cooked beef is fine as an occasional treat. Cut off the fat, remove all bones and add no seasoning. Raw beef is not recommended.
answer.sl: Da, malo navadnega, dobro kuhanega govejega mesa je v redu kot občasen priboljšek. Odrežite maščobo, odstranite vse kosti in ga ne začinite. Surova govedina ni priporočljiva.

why.en: Beef is one of the most common proteins in cat food. As a home treat it must be properly cooked: International Cat Care warns that raw or undercooked meat such as beef, lamb and pork can carry Toxoplasma, and advises feeding only properly cooked food. Fatty trimmings are on RSPCA Australia's do-not-feed list, and cooked bones can splinter.
why.sl: Govedina je ena najpogostejših beljakovin v hrani za mačke. Kot domači priboljšek mora biti dobro kuhana: International Cat Care opozarja, da surovo ali premalo kuhano meso, kot so govedina, jagnjetina in svinjina, lahko prenaša toksoplazmo, in svetuje le dobro kuhano hrano. Mastni ostanki so na seznamu RSPCA Avstralija živil, ki jih ne dajemo, kuhane kosti pa se lahko razcepijo.

what_to_do.en: Offer a small piece first. If your cat gets vomiting or diarrhoea afterwards, stop and ask your vet. If your cat swallowed a cooked bone, call your vet.
what_to_do.sl: Najprej ponudite majhen košček. Če ima mačka potem bruhanje ali drisko, prenehajte in se posvetujte z veterinarjem. Če je mačka pogoltnila kuhano kost, pokličite veterinarja.

serving.en: Well cooked, plain, lean, boneless and unseasoned; a few small pieces now and then.
serving.sl: Dobro kuhano, brez dodatkov, pusto, brez kosti in začimb; nekaj majhnih koščkov občasno.

child.en: A tiny bit of plain cooked beef can be a treat. A grown-up should cook it and take out the bones.
child.sl: Košček navadne kuhane govedine je lahko priboljšek. Odrasli naj jo skuha in odstrani kosti.

answer.en: No, butter is best avoided. It is a fatty dairy food: cat-care guides list fatty foods among things never to feed cats, dairy products can upset a cat's stomach, and their fat adds weight.
answer.sl: Ne, maslu se je bolje izogniti. Je masten mlečni izdelek: viri o negi mačk mastno hrano navajajo med živili, ki jih mačkam nikoli ne dajemo, mlečni izdelki mački lahko razdražijo želodec, njihova maščoba pa jo zredi.

why.en: RSPCA Australia lists fatty trimmings and fatty foods among things never to feed cats, and added fat can lead to a painful condition called pancreatitis. Butter is also a dairy product: many cats are lactose intolerant, milk-based products can cause vomiting or diarrhoea, and dairy products are high in fat and contribute to weight gain.
why.sl: RSPCA Avstralija mastne ostanke in mastno hrano navaja med stvarmi, ki jih mačkam nikoli ne dajemo, dodana maščoba pa lahko povzroči boleče stanje, imenovano pankreatitis. Maslo je tudi mlečni izdelek: mnoge mačke ne prenašajo laktoze, izdelki iz mleka lahko povzročijo bruhanje ali drisko, mlečni izdelki pa imajo veliko maščob in prispevajo k debelosti.

what_to_do.en: If your cat ate butter, watch for vomiting or diarrhoea and contact your vet for advice if she seems unwell or ate a lot.
what_to_do.sl: Če je muca pojedla maslo, bodite pozorni na bruhanje ali drisko in se za nasvet obrnite na veterinarja, če se ne počuti dobro ali ga je pojedla veliko.

child.en: Butter is too fatty for cats. Keep it on your toast and give your cat its own food.
child.sl: Maslo je za mucke premastno. Naj ostane na tvojem kruhu, mucki pa daj njeno hrano.

answer.en: No, cheese is best avoided. It isn't toxic, but many cats are lactose intolerant, so it can upset their stomach. It is also high in fat and salt and doesn't give cats the nutrients they need.
answer.sl: Ne, sira je bolje ne dajati. Ni strupen, vendar mnoge mačke ne prenašajo laktoze, zato jim lahko razdraži želodec. Ima tudi veliko maščob in soli ter mačkam ne da hranil, ki jih potrebujejo.

why.en: Most adult cats can't properly digest lactose, the sugar in milk and in dairy products such as cheese. This can cause vomiting or diarrhoea and make a cat sluggish. Cheese is also high in fat and salt, and eaten regularly it can lead to weight gain. Lactose-free and plant-based cheeses are not a safe swap, because some dairy alternatives contain ingredients that could be toxic to cats.
why.sl: Večina odraslih mačk ne zmore dobro prebaviti laktoze, sladkorja v mleku in mlečnih izdelkih, kot je sir. Posledica sta lahko bruhanje ali driska, mačka je lahko tudi utrujena. Sir ima veliko maščob in soli, in če ga mačka je redno, se lahko zredi. Sir brez laktoze ali rastlinski sir ni varna zamenjava, ker nekateri mlečni nadomestki vsebujejo sestavine, ki so lahko za mačke strupene.

what_to_do.en: If your cat ate a little cheese, there's no need to rush to the vet. Keep an eye on them. If they become unwell or act differently, call your vet and tell them how much cheese your cat ate.
what_to_do.sl: Če je mačka pojedla malo sira, ni treba hiteti k veterinarju. Opazujte jo. Če ji postane slabo ali se vede drugače, pokličite veterinarja in mu povejte, koliko sira je pojedla.

child.en: Cheese can give cats a sore tummy. Give your cat a cat treat instead and keep the cheese for people.
child.sl: Sir lahko mucki povzroči bolan trebušček. Raje ji daj priboljšek za mačke, sir pa ostane za ljudi.

q.en: Are cheese-flavoured cat treats OK?
q.sl: Ali so priboljški za mačke z okusom sira v redu?

a.en: Treats made for cats with a little cheese are fine in small amounts now and then. If your cat gets an upset stomach, choose a different treat next time.
a.sl: Priboljški za mačke z malo sira so v majhnih količinah občasno v redu. Če ima mačka po njih težave z želodcem, naslednjič izberite drug priboljšek.

q.en: Is lactose-free or vegan cheese safer?
q.sl: Je sir brez laktoze ali veganski sir varnejši?

a.en: No. Avoid lactose-free and plant-based cheese too, because many dairy alternatives contain ingredients that could be toxic to cats.
a.sl: Ne. Izogibajte se tudi siru brez laktoze in rastlinskemu siru, ker veliko mlečnih nadomestkov vsebuje sestavine, ki so lahko za mačke strupene.

answer.en: No, it's best not to. The ASPCA lists the cherry plant as toxic to cats: its stems, leaves and seeds (the stone) contain cyanide. Don't offer cherries to your cat, keep stones and plant parts out of reach, and call your vet if your cat chews any.
answer.sl: Ne, raje ne. ASPCA rastlino češnje navaja kot strupeno za mačke: njeni peclji, listi in semena (koščice) vsebujejo cianid. Muci ne ponujajte češenj, koščice in dele rastline hranite izven dosega ter pokličite veterinarja, če jih muca grizlja.

why.en: The stems, leaves and seeds contain cyanide (as cyanogenic glycosides) and are particularly toxic while wilting. The sources we found describe the risk from these plant parts and do not say the fruit flesh is safe for cats, so we do not recommend sharing it.
why.sl: Peclji, listi in semena vsebujejo cianid (v obliki cianogenih glikozidov) in so posebej strupeni, ko venejo. Viri, ki smo jih našli, opisujejo nevarnost teh delov rastline in ne navajajo, da je sadni del za mačke varen, zato ga ne priporočamo.

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away if your cat chewed a stone, stem or leaves. Note what was eaten, how much and when. Don't wait for signs to appear, and don't try to make your cat sick at home.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali, če je muca grizljala koščico, peclje ali liste. Zapišite, kaj je pojedla, koliko in kdaj. Ne čakajte na znake in muce doma ne poskušajte spraviti k bruhanju.

child.en: Cherries are a people snack. Their stones and leaves are not safe for cats, so tell a grown-up if kitty chews one.
child.sl: Češnje so priboljšek za ljudi. Koščice in listi niso varni za muce. Če jih muca grizlja, povej odraslemu.

q.en: Which part is the problem?
q.sl: Kateri del je nevaren?

a.en: The ASPCA says the stems, leaves and seeds contain cyanide, and that they are particularly toxic while wilting.
a.sl: ASPCA navaja, da cianid vsebujejo peclji, listi in semena ter da so posebej strupeni, ko venejo.

answer.en: No. Chives belong to the onion family and are poisonous to cats, fresh, cooked or dried. They can damage red blood cells and cause anaemia. Call your vet if your cat eats any, and keep potted chives out of reach.
answer.sl: Ne. Drobnjak spada med lukovke in je za mačke strupen, svež, kuhan ali sušen. Lahko poškoduje rdeče krvničke in povzroči slabokrvnost. Če ga muca poje, pokličite veterinarja, lonček z drobnjakom pa postavite izven njenega dosega.

why.en: Chives belong to the allium family (the onion family). Alliums damage red blood cells and can lead to anaemia, and they also irritate the stomach and gut. Cats are the most sensitive species. All forms are poisonous to cats — raw, cooked, dried, powdered and liquid.
why.sl: Drobnjak spada med lukovke (družina čebule). Lukovke poškodujejo rdeče krvničke in lahko povzročijo slabokrvnost, poleg tega dražijo želodec in črevesje. Mačke so med vsemi vrstami najbolj občutljive. Strupene so vse oblike – surove, kuhane, sušene, v prahu in tekoče.

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away, even if your cat seems well — signs of anaemia can take several days to show. Note what your cat ate (raw, cooked, powder or a dish containing it), how much and when. Don't try to make your cat sick at home.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali, tudi če se muca zdi v redu, saj se znaki slabokrvnosti lahko pokažejo šele po nekaj dneh. Zapišite, kaj je pojedla (surovo, kuhano, v prahu ali jed, ki to vsebuje), koliko in kdaj. Muce doma ne poskušajte spraviti k bruhanju.

child.en: Chives look like grass, but they're not cat grass! Keep them away from kitty and tell a grown-up if she chews some.
child.sl: Drobnjak je videti kot trava, a ni mačja trava! Naj bo daleč od muce. Če ga grizlja, povej odraslemu.

q.en: Are cooked or dried chives safe for cats?
q.sl: Je kuhan ali sušen drobnjak za mačke varen?

a.en: No. All forms are poisonous to cats, including raw, cooked and dried chives. Be careful with leftovers, sauces, soups and gravy that may contain them.
a.sl: Ne. Za mačke so strupene vse oblike, tudi surov, kuhan in sušen drobnjak. Previdni bodite pri ostankih hrane, omakah, juhah in mesnih omakah, ki ga lahko vsebujejo.

answer.en: No. Chocolate is toxic to cats. It contains theobromine and caffeine, which cats handle poorly, and the darker and more bitter the chocolate, the more dangerous it is. If your cat eats any, call your vet straight away.
answer.sl: Ne. Čokolada je za mačke strupena. Vsebuje teobromin in kofein, ki ju mačke slabo presnavljajo, in bolj ko je čokolada temna in grenka, bolj je nevarna. Če muca poje kaj čokolade, takoj pokličite veterinarja.

why.en: Chocolate contains theobromine and caffeine. Cats process these substances differently from people, which makes them more sensitive to their effects. Because cats struggle to break down theobromine, it stays in the blood and can quickly build up to dangerous levels. Dark and bitter chocolate carries the most risk; white chocolate has the least theobromine.
why.sl: Čokolada vsebuje teobromin in kofein. Mačke te snovi presnavljajo drugače kot ljudje, zato so za njihove učinke bolj občutljive. Ker mačke teobromin težko razgradijo, ostane v krvi in lahko hitro doseže nevarno raven. Najbolj tvegana je temna in grenka čokolada, bela čokolada pa ima teobromina najmanj.

en: In severe cases: muscle tremors or seizures
sl: V hudih primerih: tresenje mišic ali krči

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away, even if your cat seems fine. Note what kind of chocolate your cat ate, how much and when, and keep the wrapper. Don't wait for signs to appear, and don't try to make your cat sick at home.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali, tudi če se muca zdi v redu. Zapišite, kakšno čokolado je pojedla, koliko in kdaj, ter shranite ovojnico. Ne čakajte na znake in muce doma ne poskušajte spraviti k bruhanju.

child.en: Chocolate is a people treat, not a cat treat. Keep it put away, and tell a grown-up if kitty finds some.
child.sl: Čokolada je posladek za ljudi, ne za muce. Pospravi jo in povej odraslemu, če jo muca najde.

q.en: Is white chocolate safe for cats?
q.sl: Je bela čokolada za mačke varna?

a.en: White chocolate has the least theobromine, while darker, more bitter chocolate is the most dangerous. Keep all chocolate out of your cat's reach and call your vet if your cat eats any.
a.sl: Bela čokolada ima najmanj teobromina, najnevarnejša pa je temnejša, bolj grenka čokolada. Vso čokolado hranite izven muckinega dosega in pokličite veterinarja, če jo muca poje.

q.en: Why are cats more sensitive than people?
q.sl: Zakaj so mačke bolj občutljive kot ljudje?

a.en: Cats process theobromine and caffeine differently from people. Theobromine stays in a cat's bloodstream and can quickly reach dangerous levels.
a.sl: Mačke teobromin in kofein presnavljajo drugače kot ljudje. Teobromin ostane v mačji krvi in lahko hitro doseže nevarno raven.

answer.en: No. Coffee contains caffeine, and cats are more sensitive to caffeine than people. Unused coffee grounds and beans can cause serious poisoning. Keep coffee out of reach and call your vet if your cat eats or drinks any.
answer.sl: Ne. Kava vsebuje kofein, mačke pa so nanj bolj občutljive kot ljudje. Neuporabljena mleta kava in kavna zrna lahko povzročijo resno zastrupitev. Kavo hranite izven dosega in pokličite veterinarja, če jo muca poje ali popije.

why.en: Coffee is one of the main sources of caffeine at home. Cats are more sensitive to caffeine than people. Like chocolate, coffee and other caffeine-containing foods have high levels of stimulants called methylxanthines; caffeine speeds up the heart, makes cats restless and upsets the stomach.
why.sl: Kava je eden glavnih virov kofeina doma. Mačke so na kofein bolj občutljive kot ljudje. Kava in druga živila s kofeinom imajo tako kot čokolada veliko poživil, imenovanih metilksantini; kofein pospeši srce, povzroči nemir in prebavne težave.

en: Restlessness, jitteriness, not wanting to lie still
Fast heartbeat or heart rhythm changes
sl: Nemir, živčnost, muca ne more mirovati
Hiter srčni utrip ali spremembe srčnega ritma

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away. Note what your cat swallowed (drink, grounds, beans, tea bag or tablets), how much and when. Don't wait for signs to appear, and don't try to make your cat sick at home.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Zapišite, kaj je muca zaužila (pijačo, mleto kavo, zrna, čajno vrečko ali tablete), koliko in kdaj. Ne čakajte na znake in muce doma ne poskušajte spraviti k bruhanju.

child.en: Coffee is a grown-up drink. It makes cats jittery, so never share it, and tell a grown-up if kitty laps some up.
child.sl: Kava je pijača za odrasle. Muce naredi nemirne, zato je ne deli z njo. Če jo muca poliže, povej odraslemu.

q.en: Are coffee grounds and beans worse than a cup of coffee?
q.sl: Sta mleta kava in kavna zrna nevarnejša od skodelice kave?

a.en: Yes, they can be. Pet Poison Helpline warns that unused coffee grounds or beans could cause serious toxicity in cats. Keep coffee grounds and beans where your cat can't reach them.
a.sl: Lahko, da. Pet Poison Helpline opozarja, da lahko neuporabljena mleta kava ali zrna pri mačkah povzročijo resno zastrupitev. Mleto kavo in zrna hranite tam, kamor muca ne seže.

question.sl: Ali lahko mačke jedo kuhane kosti?

answer.en: No. Cooked bones, such as chicken or turkey bones, can splinter and cause choking, internal injuries or blockages in cats. Always take meat off the bone before sharing, and get rid of carcasses where your cat can't reach them.
answer.sl: Ne. Kuhane kosti, na primer piščančje ali puranje, se lahko razcepijo in pri mačkah povzročijo dušenje, notranje poškodbe ali zaporo. Meso vedno odstranite s kosti, preden ga delite z muco, ostanke pa zavrzite tja, kamor ne seže.

why.en: Cooked bones can splinter into sharp pieces. Swallowed bones can injure or block a cat's gut, which can be serious and may need surgery.
why.sl: Kuhane kosti se lahko razcepijo na ostre koščke. Pogoltnjene kosti lahko poškodujejo ali zamašijo mačja prebavila, kar je lahko resno in lahko zahteva operacijo.

en: Tummy pain (hiding, growling, not wanting to be touched)
sl: Bolečine v trebuhu (skrivanje, renčanje, muca se ne pusti dotikati)

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet right away if your cat swallowed a cooked bone, even if she seems fine. Note what kind of bone it was and when. Don't wait to see what happens, and don't try to make your cat sick at home.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja, če je muca pogoltnila kuhano kost, tudi če se zdi v redu. Zapišite, kakšna kost je bila in kdaj jo je pojedla. Ne čakajte, kaj se bo zgodilo, in muce doma ne poskušajte spraviti k bruhanju.

serving.en: If you share plain cooked chicken or turkey, give only boneless meat.
serving.sl: Če muci ponudite navaden kuhan piščanec ali puran, naj bo meso brez kosti.

child.en: Bones can hurt a cat's tummy. Give kitty only boneless meat, and tell a grown-up if she grabs a bone.
child.sl: Kosti lahko poškodujejo mucin trebušček. Muci daj le meso brez kosti. Če zgrabi kost, povej odraslemu.

q.en: Can I give my cat turkey from the roast?
q.sl: Lahko muci dam nekaj puranjega mesa s praznične mize?

a.en: Cats Protection says plain, cooked turkey is fine as an occasional treat if it is boneless, unseasoned and skinless. Dispose of the carcass safely out of your cat's reach.
a.sl: Cats Protection navaja, da je navaden kuhan puran lahko občasen priboljšek, če je brez kosti, nezačinjen in brez kože. Ostanke trupa varno zavrzite izven muckinega dosega.

question.sl: Ali lahko mačke jedo kuhanega piščanca?

answer.en: Yes, plain cooked chicken is fine as an occasional treat for cats. Boil it, remove all bones and skin, and add no seasoning. Count it as part of your cat's daily food, not a replacement for it.
answer.sl: Da, navaden kuhan piščanec je v redu kot občasen priboljšek za mačke. Skuhajte ga, odstranite vse kosti in kožo ter ga ne začinite. Upoštevajte ga kot del dnevnega obroka, ne kot nadomestek zanj.

why.en: Cats Protection and RSPCA Australia both say boiled or steamed chicken can be offered occasionally. It must be cooked and boneless, because cooked bones can splinter. Feeding only cooked chicken long-term can lead to nutritional deficiencies, so it stays a treat.
why.sl: Cats Protection in RSPCA Avstralija navajata, da je kuhanega ali na pari pripravljenega piščanca mogoče ponuditi občasno. Mora biti kuhan in brez kosti, ker se kuhane kosti lahko razcepijo. Dolgotrajno hranjenje samo s kuhanim piščancem lahko vodi v pomanjkanje hranil, zato naj ostane priboljšek.

what_to_do.en: Offer a small piece first. If your cat gets vomiting or diarrhoea afterwards, stop and ask your vet. If your cat swallowed a cooked chicken bone, call your vet.
what_to_do.sl: Najprej ponudite majhen košček. Če ima mačka potem bruhanje ali drisko, prenehajte in se posvetujte z veterinarjem. Če je mačka pogoltnila kuhano piščančjo kost, pokličite veterinarja.

serving.en: Boiled or steamed, plain, with no bones, skin or seasoning; small pieces within the daily food allowance.
serving.sl: Kuhan ali na pari, brez dodatkov, kosti, kože in začimb; majhni koščki v okviru dnevnega obroka.

child.en: Plain cooked chicken with no bones is a yummy cat treat. Ask a grown-up to get it ready.
child.sl: Navaden kuhan piščanec brez kosti je slasten priboljšek za mucke. Prosi odraslega, da ga pripravi.

q.en: Can my cat eat only chicken?
q.sl: Ali lahko mačka je samo piščanca?

a.en: No. Feeding only cooked chicken long-term can lead to nutritional deficiencies. Keep it as an extra.
a.sl: Ne. Dolgotrajno hranjenje samo s kuhanim piščancem lahko vodi v pomanjkanje hranil. Naj ostane dodatek.

question.sl: Ali lahko mačke jedo kuhana jajca?

answer.en: Yes, in small amounts. A little fully cooked, plain egg is fine as an occasional treat. Eggs are a common protein in cat food, but they should only be given in moderation and never raw.
answer.sl: Da, v majhnih količinah. Malo popolnoma kuhanega jajca brez dodatkov je v redu kot občasen priboljšek. Jajca so pogosta beljakovina v hrani za mačke, vendar jih dajemo le zmerno in nikoli surovih.

why.en: Cornell lists eggs among the protein sources most commonly used in cat food, and PDSA says eggs suit pets, but only in moderation. Cooking matters: raw eggs can carry Salmonella and raw egg white blocks the vitamin biotin. Treats should be a small part of a cat's diet.
why.sl: Cornell jajca navaja med najpogostejšimi viri beljakovin v hrani za mačke, PDSA pa, da so jajca primerna za živali, a le zmerno. Pomembno je kuhanje: surova jajca lahko prenašajo salmonelo, surov beljak pa ovira vsrkavanje vitamina biotina. Priboljški naj bodo le majhen del mačje prehrane.

what_to_do.en: Offer a small piece first. If your cat gets vomiting or diarrhoea afterwards, stop and ask your vet before trying again.
what_to_do.sl: Najprej ponudite majhen košček. Če ima mačka potem bruhanje ali drisko, prenehajte in se pred ponovnim poskusom posvetujte z veterinarjem.

serving.en: Fully cooked and plain, with nothing added; a small piece as an occasional treat.
serving.sl: Popolnoma kuhano in brez dodatkov; majhen košček kot občasen priboljšek.

child.en: A tiny bit of plain cooked egg can be a treat for a cat. Ask a grown-up to cook it first.
child.sl: Košček navadnega kuhanega jajca je lahko priboljšek za mucko. Prosi odraslega, da ga najprej skuha.

q.en: Why not raw?
q.sl: Zakaj ne surovo?

a.en: Raw eggs can carry bacteria such as Salmonella, and raw egg white contains avidin, which stops the vitamin biotin being absorbed.
a.sl: Surova jajca lahko prenašajo bakterije, kot je salmonela, surov beljak pa vsebuje avidin, ki prepreči vsrkavanje vitamina biotina.

question.sl: Ali lahko mačke pijejo energijske pijače?

answer.en: No. Energy drinks often contain a lot of caffeine, and cats are more sensitive to caffeine than people. Never let your cat drink from a can or glass, and call your vet if your cat swallows any.
answer.sl: Ne. Energijske pijače pogosto vsebujejo veliko kofeina, mačke pa so nanj bolj občutljive kot ljudje. Muci nikoli ne dovolite piti iz pločevinke ali kozarca in pokličite veterinarja, če kaj zaužije.

why.en: Energy and sports drinks often contain a lot of caffeine. Cats are more sensitive to caffeine than people. Like chocolate, coffee and other caffeine-containing foods have high levels of stimulants called methylxanthines; caffeine speeds up the heart, makes cats restless and upsets the stomach.
why.sl: Energijske in športne pijače pogosto vsebujejo veliko kofeina. Mačke so na kofein bolj občutljive kot ljudje. Kava in druga živila s kofeinom imajo tako kot čokolada veliko poživil, imenovanih metilksantini; kofein pospeši srce, povzroči nemir in prebavne težave.

en: Restlessness, jitteriness, not wanting to lie still
Fast heartbeat or heart rhythm changes
sl: Nemir, živčnost, muca ne more mirovati
Hiter srčni utrip ali spremembe srčnega ritma

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away. Note what your cat drank, how much and when. Don't wait for signs to appear, and don't try to make your cat sick at home.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Zapišite, kaj je muca popila, koliko in kdaj. Ne čakajte na znake in muce doma ne poskušajte spraviti k bruhanju.

child.en: Energy drinks are for grown-ups, not cats. Kitty only needs fresh water. Tell a grown-up if she drinks some.
child.sl: Energijske pijače so za odrasle, ne za muce. Muca potrebuje le svežo vodo. Če jo popije, povej odraslemu.

question.sl: Ali lahko mačke jedo mastno meso?

answer.en: It's best not to. Fatty meat and poultry skin can upset a cat's digestion and, in sensitive cats, may even lead to pancreatitis. If you share meat, give a little plain, lean, cooked meat with no skin, bones or seasoning.
answer.sl: Raje ne. Mastno meso in perutninska koža lahko muci povzročijo prebavne težave, pri občutljivih mačkah pa celo vnetje trebušne slinavke. Če delite meso, ponudite malo navadnega, pustega, kuhanega mesa brez kože, kosti in začimb.

why.en: Too much fat can affect a cat's digestive tract, especially the pancreas. Cats Protection warns that turkey skin is high in fat and can cause digestive upset or even pancreatitis in sensitive cats, and a University of Georgia vet advises avoiding the fattier pieces of ham altogether.
why.sl: Preveč maščobe lahko obremeni mačja prebavila, zlasti trebušno slinavko. Cats Protection opozarja, da je puranja koža zelo mastna in lahko pri občutljivih mačkah povzroči prebavne težave ali celo vnetje trebušne slinavke, veterinarka z Univerze v Georgii pa svetuje, naj se bolj mastnim kosom šunke povsem izognemo.

what_to_do.en: If your cat ate a lot of fatty food, or is vomiting, has diarrhoea or seems in pain afterwards, contact your vet for advice.
what_to_do.sl: Če je muca pojedla veliko mastne hrane ali po tem bruha, ima drisko ali se zdi, da jo boli, se za nasvet obrnite na veterinarja.

serving.en: Only plain, cooked, lean meat as an occasional treat: no skin, fat, bones or seasoning.
serving.sl: Le navadno, kuhano, pusto meso kot občasen priboljšek: brez kože, maščobe, kosti in začimb.

child.en: Fatty bits can give a cat a sore tummy. If a grown-up says yes, kitty can have a tiny bit of plain lean meat.
child.sl: Zaradi mastnih koščkov lahko muco boli trebušček. Če odrasli dovoli, lahko muca dobi košček navadnega pustega mesa.

q.en: Is chicken or turkey skin OK?
q.sl: Je piščančja ali puranja koža v redu?

a.en: No. Cats Protection says turkey skin is high in fat and can cause digestive upset or even pancreatitis in sensitive cats. Give skinless meat instead.
a.sl: Ne. Cats Protection navaja, da je puranja koža zelo mastna in lahko pri občutljivih mačkah povzroči prebavne težave ali celo vnetje trebušne slinavke. Raje ponudite meso brez kože.

answer.en: No. Garlic is toxic to cats and is the most toxic member of the onion family for them. Raw, cooked, dried and powdered garlic can all damage red blood cells and cause anaemia. Call your vet if your cat eats any.
answer.sl: Ne. Česen je za mačke strupen in je zanje najbolj strupen med lukovkami. V vseh oblikah – surov, kuhan, sušen ali v prahu – lahko poškoduje rdeče krvničke in povzroči slabokrvnost. Če ga muca poje, pokličite veterinarja.

why.en: Garlic belongs to the allium family (the onion family). Alliums damage red blood cells and can lead to anaemia, and they also irritate the stomach and gut. Cats are the most sensitive species. All forms are poisonous to cats — raw, cooked, dried, powdered and liquid. Of the alliums, garlic is the most toxic for cats.
why.sl: Česen spada med lukovke (družina čebule). Lukovke poškodujejo rdeče krvničke in lahko povzročijo slabokrvnost, poleg tega dražijo želodec in črevesje. Mačke so med vsemi vrstami najbolj občutljive. Strupene so vse oblike – surove, kuhane, sušene, v prahu in tekoče. Med lukovkami je za mačke najbolj strupen česen.

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away, even if your cat seems well — signs of anaemia can take several days to show. Note what your cat ate (raw, cooked, powder or a dish containing it), how much and when. Don't try to make your cat sick at home.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali, tudi če se muca zdi v redu, saj se znaki slabokrvnosti lahko pokažejo šele po nekaj dneh. Zapišite, kaj je pojedla (surovo, kuhano, v prahu ali jed, ki to vsebuje), koliko in kdaj. Muce doma ne poskušajte spraviti k bruhanju.

child.en: Garlic smells strong to us, and it's not safe for cats. Keep garlicky food away from kitty and tell a grown-up if she eats some.
child.sl: Česen močno diši, za muce pa ni varen. Hrana s česnom naj bo daleč od muce. Če jo poje, povej odraslemu.

q.en: Is cooked or powdered garlic safe for cats?
q.sl: Je kuhan česen ali česen v prahu za mačke varen?

a.en: No. All forms are poisonous to cats, including raw, cooked, dried, powdered and liquid garlic. Be careful with leftovers, sauces, soups and gravy that may contain it.
a.sl: Ne. Za mačke so strupene vse oblike, tudi surov, kuhan, sušen, v prahu in tekoč česen. Previdni bodite pri ostankih hrane, omakah, juhah in mesnih omakah, ki ga lahko vsebujejo.

q.en: Is garlic good for keeping fleas away?
q.sl: Ali česen pomaga proti bolham?

a.en: Don't give garlic to your cat for any reason. All forms are poisonous to cats, and Blue Cross notes there is also concern that long-term use of garlic may cause problems. Ask your vet about safe flea treatment.
a.sl: Muci česna ne dajajte z nobenim namenom. Za mačke so strupene vse oblike, Blue Cross pa opozarja tudi na pomisleke, da lahko dolgotrajna uporaba česna povzroča težave. Za varno zaščito pred bolhami vprašajte veterinarja.

answer.en: No. Grapes are on the list of foods toxic to cats, and eating them can cause kidney failure. Avoid them completely, even small amounts, and call your vet if your cat eats any.
answer.sl: Ne. Grozdje je na seznamu živil, ki so za mačke strupena, in lahko povzroči odpoved ledvic. Popolnoma se mu izogibajte, tudi majhnim količinam, in pokličite veterinarja, če ga muca poje.

why.en: Cat welfare charities warn that grapes can cause kidney failure in cats, and that cats with chronic kidney disease may be at greater risk. Grape poisoning in cats is rare and not well understood, and some sources only describe it in dogs, so we use the stricter level: treat any amount as an emergency.
why.sl: Organizacije za dobrobit mačk opozarjajo, da lahko grozdje pri mačkah povzroči odpoved ledvic in da so mačke s kronično ledvično boleznijo morda še bolj ogrožene. Zastrupitev z grozdjem je pri mačkah redka in slabo raziskana, nekateri viri jo opisujejo le pri psih, zato izberemo strožjo stopnjo: vsako količino obravnavajte kot nujen primer.

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away. Note how many grapes your cat ate and when. Don't wait for signs to appear, and don't try to make your cat sick at home.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Zapišite, koliko grozdja je muca pojedla in kdaj. Ne čakajte na znake in muce doma ne poskušajte spraviti k bruhanju.

child.en: Grapes are yummy for us but not safe for cats. Keep them on your plate and tell a grown-up if kitty eats one.
child.sl: Nam je grozdje okusno, za muce pa ni varno. Naj ostane na tvojem krožniku. Če ga muca poje, povej odraslemu.

q.en: Are cats with kidney disease at more risk?
q.sl: So mačke z ledvično boleznijo bolj ogrožene?

a.en: Cats Protection says cats with chronic kidney disease may be at greater risk from grapes.
a.sl: Cats Protection navaja, da so mačke s kronično ledvično boleznijo zaradi grozdja morda bolj ogrožene.

answer.en: It's best not to. Ham is fatty and high in salt, which can upset a cat's digestion and raise the risk of pancreatitis. Ham cooked with onion or garlic is toxic to cats. A University of Georgia vet recommends avoiding ham altogether.
answer.sl: Raje ne. Šunka je mastna in zelo slana, kar lahko muci povzroči prebavne težave in poveča tveganje za vnetje trebušne slinavke. Šunka, pripravljena s čebulo ali česnom, je za mačke strupena. Veterinarka z Univerze v Georgii svetuje, naj se šunki povsem izognemo.

why.en: Ham is a fatty meat that is also high in sodium, and both can cause health problems. Too much fat affects the digestive tract, especially the pancreas. Seasonings such as onion or garlic make it toxic. Small amounts may not be extremely harmful, but it is not a good treat. Salty food can also leave cats more dehydrated, and cats with kidney, heart or urinary problems should especially avoid ham.
why.sl: Šunka je mastno meso z veliko natrija, oboje pa lahko povzroči zdravstvene težave. Preveč maščobe obremeni prebavila, zlasti trebušno slinavko. Začimbe, kot sta čebula in česen, jo naredijo strupeno. Majhne količine morda niso zelo škodljive, a dober priboljšek ni. Slana hrana lahko mačke še bolj izsuši, mačke s težavami z ledvicami, srcem ali sečili pa naj se šunki še posebej izogibajo.

what_to_do.en: If your cat ate ham seasoned with onion or garlic, contact your vet right away. If she ate a lot of plain ham, or is vomiting or has diarrhoea, call your vet for advice.
what_to_do.sl: Če je muca pojedla šunko, začinjeno s čebulo ali česnom, takoj pokličite veterinarja. Če je pojedla veliko navadne šunke ali bruha ali ima drisko, se za nasvet obrnite na veterinarja.

child.en: Ham is too salty and fatty for cats. Kitty's own cat treats are a better surprise.
child.sl: Šunka je za muce preslana in premastna. Mucini mačji priboljški so boljše presenečenje.

q.en: Is a tiny bite of ham dangerous?
q.sl: Je majhen grižljaj šunke nevaren?

a.en: Small amounts may not be extremely harmful, but ham seasoned with onion or garlic is toxic to cats, and a University of Georgia vet still recommends avoiding ham altogether.
a.sl: Majhne količine morda niso zelo škodljive, šunka, začinjena s čebulo ali česnom, pa je za mačke strupena, zato veterinarka z Univerze v Georgii vseeno svetuje, naj se ji povsem izognemo.

answer.en: No, ice cream is not a good treat for cats. It is made with milk and cream, which can upset a cat's stomach, and it adds fat and sugar that cats don't need.
answer.sl: Ne, sladoled ni dober priboljšek za mačke. Narejen je iz mleka in smetane, ki mački lahko razdražita želodec, poleg tega pa vsebuje maščobe in sladkor, ki jih mačke ne potrebujejo.

why.en: Adult cats have little lactase, the enzyme that digests milk sugar, so milk and other dairy-based products can cause diarrhoea or other digestive upset. Cream and dairy products are high in fat and can lead to weight gain. Sugar isn't toxic to cats, but it is still unhealthy for them and adds calories they don't need.
why.sl: Odrasle mačke imajo malo laktaze, encima, ki prebavlja mlečni sladkor, zato lahko mleko in drugi mlečni izdelki povzročijo drisko ali druge prebavne težave. Smetana in mlečni izdelki imajo veliko maščob in lahko vodijo v debelost. Sladkor za mačke ni strupen, je pa nezdrav in jim prinaša nepotrebne kalorije.

what_to_do.en: If your cat ate ice cream, watch for diarrhoea or vomiting and contact your vet for advice if she seems unwell. If the ice cream contained chocolate, contact your vet straight away.
what_to_do.sl: Če je muca pojedla sladoled, bodite pozorni na drisko ali bruhanje in se za nasvet obrnite na veterinarja, če se ne počuti dobro. Če je bila v sladoledu čokolada, takoj pokličite veterinarja.

child.en: Ice cream is a treat for people. It can give cats a sore tummy, so keep your cone to yourself.
child.sl: Sladoled je posladek za ljudi. Mucki lahko povzroči bolan trebušček, zato kornet obdrži zase.

q.en: Do cats like ice cream because it is sweet?
q.sl: Ali imajo mačke rade sladoled, ker je sladek?

a.en: No. Cats can't taste sweetness at all, so sugar gives them nothing but extra calories.
a.sl: Ne. Mačke sladkega okusa sploh ne zaznajo, zato jim sladkor prinese le dodatne kalorije.

answer.en: Yes, a little plain, well-cooked lamb is fine as an occasional treat. Cut off the fat, remove all bones and add no seasoning. Raw lamb is not recommended.
answer.sl: Da, malo navadnega, dobro kuhanega jagnječjega mesa je v redu kot občasen priboljšek. Odrežite maščobo, odstranite vse kosti in ga ne začinite. Surova jagnjetina ni priporočljiva.

why.en: Lamb is one of the most common proteins in cat food. As a home treat it must be properly cooked: International Cat Care warns that raw or undercooked meat such as beef, lamb and pork can carry Toxoplasma, and advises feeding only properly cooked food. Fatty trimmings are on RSPCA Australia's do-not-feed list, and cooked bones can splinter.
why.sl: Jagnjetina je ena najpogostejših beljakovin v hrani za mačke. Kot domači priboljšek mora biti dobro kuhana: International Cat Care opozarja, da surovo ali premalo kuhano meso, kot so govedina, jagnjetina in svinjina, lahko prenaša toksoplazmo, in svetuje le dobro kuhano hrano. Mastni ostanki so na seznamu RSPCA Avstralija živil, ki jih ne dajemo, kuhane kosti pa se lahko razcepijo.

what_to_do.en: Offer a small piece first. If your cat gets vomiting or diarrhoea afterwards, stop and ask your vet. If your cat swallowed a cooked bone, call your vet.
what_to_do.sl: Najprej ponudite majhen košček. Če ima mačka potem bruhanje ali drisko, prenehajte in se posvetujte z veterinarjem. Če je mačka pogoltnila kuhano kost, pokličite veterinarja.

serving.en: Well cooked, plain, lean, boneless and unseasoned; a few small pieces now and then.
serving.sl: Dobro kuhano, brez dodatkov, pusto, brez kosti in začimb; nekaj majhnih koščkov občasno.

child.en: A tiny bit of plain cooked lamb can be a treat. A grown-up should cook it and take out the bones.
child.sl: Košček navadne kuhane jagnjetine je lahko priboljšek. Odrasli naj jo skuha in odstrani kosti.

answer.en: No. Leek is in the same family as onion and garlic and is poisonous to cats, raw or cooked. It can damage red blood cells and cause anaemia. Call your vet if your cat eats any.
answer.sl: Ne. Por spada v isto družino kot čebula in česen ter je za mačke strupen, surov ali kuhan. Lahko poškoduje rdeče krvničke in povzroči slabokrvnost. Če ga muca poje, pokličite veterinarja.

why.en: Leek belongs to the allium family (the onion family). Alliums damage red blood cells and can lead to anaemia, and they also irritate the stomach and gut. Cats are the most sensitive species. All forms are poisonous to cats — raw, cooked, dried, powdered and liquid.
why.sl: Por spada med lukovke (družina čebule). Lukovke poškodujejo rdeče krvničke in lahko povzročijo slabokrvnost, poleg tega dražijo želodec in črevesje. Mačke so med vsemi vrstami najbolj občutljive. Strupene so vse oblike – surove, kuhane, sušene, v prahu in tekoče.

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away, even if your cat seems well — signs of anaemia can take several days to show. Note what your cat ate (raw, cooked, powder or a dish containing it), how much and when. Don't try to make your cat sick at home.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali, tudi če se muca zdi v redu, saj se znaki slabokrvnosti lahko pokažejo šele po nekaj dneh. Zapišite, kaj je pojedla (surovo, kuhano, v prahu ali jed, ki to vsebuje), koliko in kdaj. Muce doma ne poskušajte spraviti k bruhanju.

child.en: Leeks are a cousin of onions, so they're not safe for cats. Tell a grown-up if kitty nibbles some.
child.sl: Por je sorodnik čebule, zato za muce ni varen. Če ga muca grizlja, povej odraslemu.

q.en: Is cooked or dried leek safe for cats?
q.sl: Je kuhan ali sušen por za mačke varen?

a.en: No. All forms are poisonous to cats, including raw, cooked and dried leek. Be careful with leftovers, sauces, soups and gravy that may contain it.
a.sl: Ne. Za mačke so strupene vse oblike, tudi surov, kuhan in sušen por. Previdni bodite pri ostankih hrane, omakah, juhah in mesnih omakah, ki ga lahko vsebujejo.

answer.en: Not as a home treat. Liver is very rich in vitamin A, and cats fed raw liver or a diet high in liver can develop vitamin A poisoning. Liver in a complete, balanced cat food is fine.
answer.sl: Ne kot domači priboljšek. Jetra so zelo bogata z vitaminom A, pri mačkah, ki dobivajo surova jetra ali prehrano z veliko jeter, pa se lahko razvije zastrupitev z vitaminom A. Jetra v popolni, uravnoteženi mačji hrani so v redu.

why.en: VCA says vitamin A poisoning most commonly occurs when pets are fed raw liver or vitamin A-rich supplements over weeks to months. The Merck Veterinary Manual notes that in cats it can occur when growing kittens are fed a diet high in liver, and that feeding only liver can cause it. VCA recommends a commercially prepared, balanced diet instead.
why.sl: VCA navaja, da se zastrupitev z vitaminom A najpogosteje pojavi, ko živali več tednov ali mesecev dobivajo surova jetra ali dodatke, bogate z vitaminom A. Merckov veterinarski priročnik navaja, da se pri mačkah lahko pojavi, ko mladiči dobivajo prehrano z veliko jeter, in da jo lahko povzroči hranjenje samo z jetri. VCA namesto tega priporoča komercialno pripravljeno, uravnoteženo prehrano.

en: Vomiting or drowsiness after a very large amount
sl: Bruhanje ali zaspanost po zelo veliki količini

what_to_do.en: Vitamin A poisoning usually builds up over weeks to months, so don't feed liver regularly at home. If your cat has been eating a lot of liver and you notice a rough coat, weight loss, weakness or painful movement, talk to your vet.
what_to_do.sl: Zastrupitev z vitaminom A se običajno razvija več tednov ali mesecev, zato doma jeter ne dajajte redno. Če je mačka jedla veliko jeter in opazite grobo dlako, hujšanje, šibkost ali boleče gibanje, se posvetujte z veterinarjem.

child.en: Liver has lots of one vitamin, and too much isn't good for cats. Their cat food already has the right amount.
child.sl: Jetra imajo veliko enega vitamina, preveč pa za mucke ni dobro. Njihova mačja hrana ga že ima ravno prav.

q.en: My cat food lists liver. Is that a problem?
q.sl: Moja mačja hrana vsebuje jetra. Je to težava?

a.en: No. Liver is a common ingredient in canned cat foods, and a complete, balanced cat food is what vets recommend.
a.sl: Ne. Jetra so pogosta sestavina v konzervirani mačji hrani, veterinarji pa priporočajo prav popolno, uravnoteženo mačjo hrano.

question.sl: Ali lahko mačke jedo makadamija oreščke?

answer.en: No. Macadamia nuts are very fatty, and VCA says they are also toxic and can cause illness in cats. Keep them out of your cat's reach and contact your vet if your cat eats any.
answer.sl: Ne. Makadamija oreščki so zelo mastni, VCA pa navaja, da so tudi strupeni in lahko mačkam povzročijo bolezen. Hranite jih izven mucinega dosega in pokličite veterinarja, če jih muca poje.

why.en: Cats Protection lists macadamia among nuts whose high oil and fat content can make cats unwell. VCA says macadamia nuts are very fatty, potentially causing pancreatitis, and also toxic, causing illness in cats. Detailed descriptions of macadamia poisoning mostly come from dogs, but we use the stricter level for cats.
why.sl: Cats Protection makadamijo navaja med oreščki, ki zaradi veliko olj in maščob mački lahko škodijo. VCA navaja, da so makadamija oreščki zelo mastni in lahko povzročijo pankreatitis, poleg tega pa so strupeni in mačkam povzročajo bolezen. Podrobni opisi zastrupitve z makadamijo večinoma izhajajo iz psov, za mačke pa uporabljamo strožjo stopnjo.

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet straight away if your cat ate macadamia nuts. Note how many she ate and when, and keep the packaging. Don't try to make your cat sick at home.
what_to_do.sl: Če je muca pojedla makadamija oreščke, takoj pokličite veterinarja. Zapišite, koliko jih je pojedla in kdaj, ter shranite embalažo. Muce doma ne poskušajte spraviti k bruhanju.

child.en: Macadamia nuts are not for cats. Keep the nut bowl out of kitty's reach and tell a grown-up if she eats some.
child.sl: Makadamija oreščki niso za muce. Skledo z oreščki postavi izven mucinega dosega. Če jih muca poje, povej odraslemu.

q.en: Are macadamia nuts worse than other nuts?
q.sl: Ali so makadamija oreščki hujši od drugih oreščkov?

a.en: Yes. Most nuts are very fatty, but VCA says macadamia nuts are also toxic and can cause illness in cats, such as weakness, tremors and overheating.
a.sl: Da. Večina oreščkov je zelo mastnih, VCA pa navaja, da so makadamija oreščki tudi strupeni in mačkam lahko povzročijo bolezen, na primer šibkost, tresenje in pregrevanje.

answer.en: It's best not to. Most adult cats are lactose intolerant, so cow's milk can cause vomiting, diarrhoea and stomach pain. Cats get no benefit from milk; fresh water is all they need to drink.
answer.sl: Raje ne. Večina odraslih mačk ne prenaša laktoze, zato jim kravje mleko lahko povzroči bruhanje, drisko in bolečine v trebuhu. Mleko mačkam ne koristi; piti potrebujejo le svežo vodo.

why.en: Milk contains lactose, a sugar that needs the enzyme lactase to be digested. Cats have very little lactase, so most are lactose intolerant and dairy often upsets their stomach. Kittens drink their mother's milk, but orphaned kittens need special kitten milk, not cow's milk.
why.sl: Mleko vsebuje laktozo, sladkor, za katerega prebavo je potreben encim laktaza. Mačke imajo laktaze zelo malo, zato večina ne prenaša laktoze in mlečni izdelki jim pogosto povzročijo prebavne težave. Mladički pijejo mleko svoje mame, osirotelim mladičkom pa je treba dajati posebno mleko za mladiče, ne kravjega.

what_to_do.en: If your cat drank milk and has vomiting or diarrhoea that doesn't settle, or seems unwell, contact your vet for advice.
what_to_do.sl: Če je muca popila mleko in ima bruhanje ali drisko, ki ne mineta, ali se ne počuti dobro, se za nasvet obrnite na veterinarja.

serving.en: If you want to offer milk, choose a milk made for cats (usually low-lactose or lactose-free) and count its calories in your cat's daily food.
serving.sl: Če želite muci ponuditi mleko, izberite mleko za mačke (običajno z malo laktoze ali brez nje) in njegove kalorije upoštevajte pri dnevnem obroku.

child.en: Cartoon cats love milk, but real cats get a sore tummy from it. Fresh water is kitty's best drink!
child.sl: Risane muce obožujejo mleko, prave pa jih od njega boli trebušček. Sveža voda je za muco najboljša pijača!

q.en: Are adult cats lactose intolerant?
q.sl: Ali odrasle mačke ne prenašajo laktoze?

a.en: Yes, most are. Cats lack significant amounts of lactase, the enzyme that breaks down lactose in milk, so milk can cause vomiting, diarrhoea and stomach pain.
a.sl: Da, večina ne. Mačke nimajo dovolj laktaze, encima, ki razgradi laktozo v mleku, zato jim mleko lahko povzroči bruhanje, drisko in bolečine v trebuhu.

q.en: What should kittens drink?
q.sl: Kaj naj pijejo mladički?

a.en: Kittens need their mother's milk. If a kitten has to be bottle-fed, give only special kitten milk, because other milks don't have the right balance of nutrients.
a.sl: Mladički potrebujejo materino mleko. Če mladička hranite po steklenički, mu dajte le posebno mleko za mladiče, ker druga mleka nimajo pravega razmerja hranil.

q.en: Is cat milk from the shop OK?
q.sl: Je mleko za mačke iz trgovine v redu?

a.en: Milk made for cats usually has much less lactose or none. It still has calories, so count it in your cat's daily food. Your cat only needs water to drink.
a.sl: Mleko za mačke ima običajno veliko manj laktoze ali je sploh nima. Še vedno ima kalorije, zato ga upoštevajte pri dnevnem obroku. Muca za pitje potrebuje le vodo.

answer.en: No. Onion is toxic to cats in every form — raw, cooked, dried or powdered. It can damage red blood cells and cause anaemia, and cats are the most sensitive species. Call your vet if your cat eats any.
answer.sl: Ne. Čebula je za mačke strupena v vseh oblikah – surova, kuhana, sušena ali v prahu. Lahko poškoduje rdeče krvničke in povzroči slabokrvnost, mačke pa so najbolj občutljive. Če jo muca poje, pokličite veterinarja.

why.en: Onion belongs to the allium family (the onion family). Alliums damage red blood cells and can lead to anaemia, and they also irritate the stomach and gut. Cats are the most sensitive species. All forms are poisonous to cats — raw, cooked, dried, powdered and liquid.
why.sl: Čebula spada med lukovke (družina čebule). Lukovke poškodujejo rdeče krvničke in lahko povzročijo slabokrvnost, poleg tega dražijo želodec in črevesje. Mačke so med vsemi vrstami najbolj občutljive. Strupene so vse oblike – surove, kuhane, sušene, v prahu in tekoče.

what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali, tudi če se muca zdi v redu, saj se znaki slabokrvnosti lahko pokažejo šele po nekaj dneh. Zapišite, kaj je pojedla (surovo, kuhano, v prahu ali jed, ki to vsebuje), koliko in kdaj. Muce doma ne poskušajte spraviti k bruhanju.

child.en: Onions are not for cats, even cooked in food. If kitty eats some, tell a grown-up so they can call the vet.
child.sl: Čebula ni za muce, tudi kuhana v hrani ne. Če jo muca poje, povej odraslemu, da pokliče veterinarja.

q.en: Is cooked or powdered onion safe for cats?
q.sl: Je kuhana čebula ali čebula v prahu za mačke varna?

a.en: No. All forms are poisonous to cats, including raw, cooked, dried, powdered and liquid onion. Be careful with leftovers, stuffing and gravy that may contain it.
a.sl: Ne. Za mačke so strupene vse oblike, tudi surova, kuhana, sušena, tekoča čebula in čebula v prahu. Previdni bodite pri ostankih hrane, nadevih in mesnih omakah, ki jo lahko vsebujejo.

q.en: Why do signs sometimes appear days later?
q.sl: Zakaj se znaki včasih pokažejo šele čez nekaj dni?

a.en: Tummy upset often shows first, but signs of anaemia usually take longer and can appear within one to five days. That is why you should call your vet straight away rather than wait.
a.sl: Najprej se pogosto pokažejo prebavne težave, znaki slabokrvnosti pa se navadno pojavijo kasneje, v enem do petih dneh. Zato veterinarja pokličite takoj in ne čakajte.

answer.en: No, it's best not to. The ASPCA lists the peach plant as toxic to cats: its stems, leaves and seeds (the stone) contain cyanide. Don't offer peaches to your cat, keep stones and plant parts out of reach, and call your vet if your cat chews any.
answer.sl: Ne, raje ne. ASPCA rastlino breskve navaja kot strupeno za mačke: njeni peclji, listi in semena (koščice) vsebujejo cianid. Muci ne ponujajte breskev, koščice in dele rastline hranite izven dosega ter pokličite veterinarja, če jih muca grizlja.

why.en: The stems, leaves and seeds contain cyanide (as cyanogenic glycosides) and are particularly toxic while wilting. The sources we found describe the risk from these plant parts and do not say the fruit flesh is safe for cats, so we do not recommend sharing it.
why.sl: Peclji, listi in semena vsebujejo cianid (v obliki cianogenih glikozidov) in so posebej strupeni, ko venejo. Viri, ki smo jih našli, opisujejo nevarnost teh delov rastline in ne navajajo, da je sadni del za mačke varen, zato ga ne priporočamo.

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away if your cat chewed a stone, stem or leaves. Note what was eaten, how much and when. Don't wait for signs to appear, and don't try to make your cat sick at home.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali, če je muca grizljala koščico, peclje ali liste. Zapišite, kaj je pojedla, koliko in kdaj. Ne čakajte na znake in muce doma ne poskušajte spraviti k bruhanju.

child.en: Peaches are a people snack. Their stones and leaves are not safe for cats, so tell a grown-up if kitty chews one.
child.sl: Breskve so priboljšek za ljudi. Koščice in listi niso varni za muce. Če jih muca grizlja, povej odraslemu.

q.en: Which part is the problem?
q.sl: Kateri del je nevaren?

a.en: The ASPCA says the stems, leaves and seeds contain cyanide, and that they are particularly toxic while wilting.
a.sl: ASPCA navaja, da cianid vsebujejo peclji, listi in semena ter da so posebej strupeni, ko venejo.

question.sl: Ali lahko mačke jedo arašidovo maslo?

answer.en: It's best not to make it a habit. Some vets say natural peanut butter can be an occasional treat, but it must never contain xylitol, and Cats Protection advises sticking to cat treats instead of human foods.
answer.sl: Bolje je, da to ne postane navada. Nekateri veterinarji pravijo, da je naravno arašidovo maslo lahko občasen priboljšek, vendar nikoli ne sme vsebovati ksilitola, Cats Protection pa svetuje priboljške za mačke namesto človeške hrane.

why.en: Sources disagree. VCA describes natural peanut butter as a treat cats love, as long as it is free of preservatives and life-threatening additives such as xylitol. Cats Protection advises sticking to cat treats rather than human foods and warns that nuts can cause problems for cats. We use the stricter level.
why.sl: Viri se razlikujejo. VCA naravno arašidovo maslo opisuje kot priboljšek, ki ga mačke imajo rade, če ne vsebuje konzervansov in življenjsko nevarnih dodatkov, kot je ksilitol. Cats Protection svetuje priboljške za mačke namesto človeške hrane in opozarja, da oreščki mačkam lahko povzročajo težave. Uporabljamo strožjo stopnjo.

what_to_do.en: A lick of plain peanut butter is unlikely to be serious; watch for vomiting or diarrhoea. If the peanut butter contains xylitol, contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away, note how much was eaten, and don't wait for signs.
what_to_do.sl: Malo navadnega arašidovega masla najverjetneje ne bo resna težava; bodite pozorni na bruhanje ali drisko. Če arašidovo maslo vsebuje ksilitol, takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali, zapišite si, koliko ga je mačka pojedla, in ne čakajte na znake.

serving.en: If your vet is happy with it: natural peanut butter only, with no xylitol or preservatives, as a rare lick, not a habit.
serving.sl: Če se veterinar strinja: samo naravno arašidovo maslo brez ksilitola in konzervansov, redko in le za lizanje, ne kot navada.

child.en: Peanut butter is a people food. Ask a grown-up before sharing anything with your cat.
child.sl: Arašidovo maslo je hrana za ljudi. Preden mucki kaj ponudiš, vprašaj odraslega.

q.en: Why does xylitol matter?
q.sl: Zakaj je ksilitol pomemben?

a.en: Xylitol is a sweetener added to some peanut butters. VCA calls it a life-threatening additive, so always check the label.
a.sl: Ksilitol je sladilo, ki ga dodajajo nekaterim arašidovim maslom. VCA ga označuje kot življenjsko nevaren dodatek, zato vedno preverite deklaracijo.

answer.en: No, it's best not to. The ASPCA lists the plum plant as toxic to cats: its stems, leaves and seeds (the stone) contain cyanide. Don't offer plums to your cat, keep stones and plant parts out of reach, and call your vet if your cat chews any.
answer.sl: Ne, raje ne. ASPCA rastlino slive navaja kot strupeno za mačke: njeni peclji, listi in semena (koščice) vsebujejo cianid. Muci ne ponujajte sliv, koščice in dele rastline hranite izven dosega ter pokličite veterinarja, če jih muca grizlja.

why.en: The stems, leaves and seeds contain cyanide (as cyanogenic glycosides) and are particularly toxic while wilting. The sources we found describe the risk from these plant parts and do not say the fruit flesh is safe for cats, so we do not recommend sharing it.
why.sl: Peclji, listi in semena vsebujejo cianid (v obliki cianogenih glikozidov) in so posebej strupeni, ko venejo. Viri, ki smo jih našli, opisujejo nevarnost teh delov rastline in ne navajajo, da je sadni del za mačke varen, zato ga ne priporočamo.

what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali, če je muca grizljala koščico, peclje ali liste. Zapišite, kaj je pojedla, koliko in kdaj. Ne čakajte na znake in muce doma ne poskušajte spraviti k bruhanju.

child.sl: Slive so priboljšek za ljudi. Koščice in listi niso varni za muce. Če jih muca grizlja, povej odraslemu.

q.en: Which part is the problem?
q.sl: Kateri del je nevaren?

a.en: The ASPCA says the stems, leaves and seeds contain cyanide, and that they are particularly toxic while wilting.
a.sl: ASPCA navaja, da cianid vsebujejo peclji, listi in semena ter da so posebej strupeni, ko venejo.

answer.en: Yes, a little plain, well-cooked pork is fine as an occasional treat. Cut off the fat, remove all bones and add no seasoning. Raw pork is not recommended.
answer.sl: Da, malo navadnega, dobro kuhanega svinjskega mesa je v redu kot občasen priboljšek. Odrežite maščobo, odstranite vse kosti in ga ne začinite. Surova svinjina ni priporočljiva.

why.en: Pork is one of the most common proteins in cat food. As a home treat it must be properly cooked: International Cat Care warns that raw or undercooked meat such as beef, lamb and pork can carry Toxoplasma, and advises feeding only properly cooked food. Fatty trimmings are on RSPCA Australia's do-not-feed list, and cooked bones can splinter. Ham is a different food and is covered separately.
why.sl: Svinjina je ena najpogostejših beljakovin v hrani za mačke. Kot domači priboljšek mora biti dobro kuhana: International Cat Care opozarja, da surovo ali premalo kuhano meso, kot so govedina, jagnjetina in svinjina, lahko prenaša toksoplazmo, in svetuje le dobro kuhano hrano. Mastni ostanki so na seznamu RSPCA Avstralija živil, ki jih ne dajemo, kuhane kosti pa se lahko razcepijo. Šunka je drugo živilo in je opisana posebej.

what_to_do.en: Offer a small piece first. If your cat gets vomiting or diarrhoea afterwards, stop and ask your vet. If your cat swallowed a cooked bone, call your vet.
what_to_do.sl: Najprej ponudite majhen košček. Če ima mačka potem bruhanje ali drisko, prenehajte in se posvetujte z veterinarjem. Če je mačka pogoltnila kuhano kost, pokličite veterinarja.

serving.en: Well cooked, plain, lean, boneless and unseasoned; a few small pieces now and then.
serving.sl: Dobro kuhano, brez dodatkov, pusto, brez kosti in začimb; nekaj majhnih koščkov občasno.

child.en: A tiny bit of plain cooked pork can be a treat. A grown-up should cook it and take out the bones.
child.sl: Košček navadne kuhane svinjine je lahko priboljšek. Odrasli naj jo skuha in odstrani kosti.

answer.en: No. Raisins, like grapes and currants, are on the list of foods toxic to cats and can cause kidney failure. Watch out for cakes, mince pies and other baked goods that contain them, and call your vet if your cat eats any.
answer.sl: Ne. Rozine so, tako kot grozdje in ribez, na seznamu živil, ki so za mačke strupena, in lahko povzročijo odpoved ledvic. Pazite na pecivo, kolače in drugo, kar jih vsebuje, ter pokličite veterinarja, če jih muca poje.

why.en: Cat welfare charities warn that grapes, raisins and currants can cause kidney failure in cats, with cats that have chronic kidney disease possibly at greater risk. Cats are unlikely to eat many raisins on their own but may be tempted by foods that contain them. Cat cases are rare and not well understood, so we use the stricter level.
why.sl: Organizacije za dobrobit mačk opozarjajo, da lahko grozdje, rozine in ribez pri mačkah povzročijo odpoved ledvic, mačke s kronično ledvično boleznijo pa so morda še bolj ogrožene. Mačke same verjetno ne pojedo veliko rozin, lahko pa jih zamika hrana, ki jih vsebuje. Primeri pri mačkah so redki in slabo raziskani, zato izberemo strožjo stopnjo.

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away. Note what your cat ate (raisins or a food containing them), how much and when, and keep the packaging. Don't wait for signs to appear, and don't try to make your cat sick at home.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Zapišite, kaj je muca pojedla (rozine ali hrano z njimi), koliko in kdaj, ter shranite embalažo. Ne čakajte na znake in muce doma ne poskušajte spraviti k bruhanju.

child.en: Raisins are not a cat snack. Keep raisins and raisin cake away from kitty, and tell a grown-up if she eats some.
child.sl: Rozine niso priboljšek za muce. Rozine in kolač z rozinami naj bodo daleč od muce. Če jih poje, povej odraslemu.

q.en: What about mince pies and Christmas cake?
q.sl: Kaj pa praznično pecivo z rozinami?

a.en: PDSA warns that mince pies and Christmas cake contain raisins, sultanas and currants, which are highly toxic to pets. Keep them out of your cat's reach.
a.sl: PDSA opozarja, da praznično pecivo, kot so pite s suhim sadjem in božični kolač, vsebuje rozine, sultanine in ribez, ki so za hišne ljubljenčke zelo strupeni. Hranite ga izven muckinega dosega.

question.sl: Ali lahko mačke jedo surove kosti?

answer.en: It's best not to. Cats Protection advises avoiding raw bones because they increase the risk of choking or a blockage in the stomach. Bones can also injure a cat's gut, and raw meat may carry harmful bacteria and parasites.
answer.sl: Raje ne. Cats Protection svetuje, naj se surovim kostem izogibamo, ker povečajo tveganje za dušenje ali zaporo v želodcu. Kosti lahko poškodujejo tudi mačja prebavila, surovo meso pa lahko vsebuje škodljive bakterije in zajedavce.

why.en: Swallowed bones can injure or block the gut, which can be serious and may need surgery. Raw meat attached to bones may also contain harmful bacteria and parasites.
why.sl: Pogoltnjene kosti lahko poškodujejo ali zamašijo prebavila, kar je lahko resno in lahko zahteva operacijo. Surovo meso na kosteh lahko vsebuje tudi škodljive bakterije in zajedavce.

en: Tummy pain (hiding, growling, not wanting to be touched)
sl: Bolečine v trebuhu (skrivanje, renčanje, muca se ne pusti dotikati)

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet right away if your cat swallowed a bone or is choking or vomiting. Note what kind of bone it was and when. Don't wait to see what happens, and don't try to make your cat sick at home.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja, če je muca pogoltnila kost ali se duši ali bruha. Zapišite, kakšna kost je bila in kdaj. Ne čakajte, kaj se bo zgodilo, in muce doma ne poskušajte spraviti k bruhanju.

child.en: Bones can get stuck in a cat's throat or tummy. Leave bones out of kitty's bowl and tell a grown-up if she finds one.
child.sl: Kosti se lahko muci zataknejo v grlu ali trebuščku. V mucini skledi naj ne bo kosti. Če jo najde, povej odraslemu.

question.sl: Ali lahko mačke jedo surova jajca?

answer.en: No, don't give cats raw eggs. Raw eggs may carry harmful bacteria such as Salmonella, which can make both cats and people ill, and raw egg white contains a protein that can block a vitamin.
answer.sl: Ne, mačkam ne dajajte surovih jajc. Surova jajca lahko vsebujejo škodljive bakterije, kot je salmonela, ki lahko povzročijo bolezen pri mačkah in ljudeh, surov beljak pa vsebuje beljakovino, ki lahko ovira vsrkavanje vitamina.

why.en: Raw eggs may contain harmful bacteria and parasites and could mean food poisoning for cats and humans alike. Raw egg white also contains avidin, which binds the vitamin biotin and stops it being absorbed. Cooking food thoroughly protects pets from salmonella.
why.sl: Surova jajca lahko vsebujejo škodljive bakterije in zajedavce ter lahko povzročijo zastrupitev s hrano pri mačkah in ljudeh. Surov beljak vsebuje tudi avidin, ki veže vitamin biotin in prepreči njegovo vsrkavanje. Temeljito kuhanje hrane živali varuje pred salmonelo.

what_to_do.en: If your cat licked a little raw egg, watch for vomiting, diarrhoea, fever or not eating, and call your vet if any appear. Wash your hands and any surfaces the egg touched.
what_to_do.sl: Če je mačka polizala malo surovega jajca, bodite pozorni na bruhanje, drisko, vročino ali odklanjanje hrane in pokličite veterinarja, če se kaj od tega pojavi. Umijte si roke in površine, ki so prišle v stik z jajcem.

child.en: Raw eggs can carry germs. Only grown-ups should handle them, and cats shouldn't eat them.
child.sl: Na surovih jajcih so lahko klice. Z njimi naj ravnajo odrasli, mucke pa jih ne smejo jesti.

q.en: Are cooked eggs OK instead?
q.sl: Ali so kuhana jajca v redu?

a.en: Cooked egg is a different matter: PDSA says eggs can suit pets, but only in moderation. Cook it fully and serve it plain.
a.sl: Kuhano jajce je nekaj drugega: PDSA navaja, da so jajca lahko primerna za živali, a le zmerno. Jajce popolnoma skuhajte in ga ponudite brez dodatkov.

question.sl: Ali lahko mačke jedo surovo ribo?

answer.en: No, raw fish is not a good idea for cats. It may carry harmful bacteria and parasites, and some raw fish contains thiaminase, an enzyme that destroys vitamin B1. Fish for cats should be properly cooked, with bones removed.
answer.sl: Ne, surova riba za mačke ni dobra izbira. Lahko vsebuje škodljive bakterije in zajedavce, nekatere surove ribe pa vsebujejo tiaminazo, encim, ki uničuje vitamin B1. Ribo za mačke je treba dobro skuhati in odstraniti kosti.

why.en: Cats Protection says uncooked fish may contain harmful bacteria and parasites. The Merck Veterinary Manual notes that thiaminases are found in raw freshwater fish and are destroyed by cooking. Thiamine (vitamin B1) is an essential nutrient, so cooking fish removes this risk.
why.sl: Cats Protection navaja, da surova riba lahko vsebuje škodljive bakterije in zajedavce. Merckov veterinarski priročnik navaja, da so tiaminaze prisotne v surovih sladkovodnih ribah in da jih kuhanje uniči. Tiamin (vitamin B1) je nujno hranilo, zato kuhanje ribe to tveganje odpravi.

what_to_do.en: If your cat ate a little raw fish, watch for vomiting, diarrhoea, fever or not eating, and call your vet if any appear. Raw fish should not become a regular food.
what_to_do.sl: Če je mačka pojedla malo surove ribe, bodite pozorni na bruhanje, drisko, vročino ali odklanjanje hrane in pokličite veterinarja, če se kaj od tega pojavi. Surova riba naj ne postane redna hrana.

serving.en: If you share fish: properly cooked, plain, with all bones removed, a few pieces at a time.
serving.sl: Če ribo delite: dobro kuhano, brez dodatkov, z odstranjenimi vsemi kostmi, po nekaj koščkov naenkrat.

child.en: Cats love fish, but it needs to be cooked by a grown-up first, with no bones.
child.sl: Mucke imajo rade ribe, a jih mora odrasel najprej skuhati in odstraniti kosti.

q.en: What is thiaminase?
q.sl: Kaj je tiaminaza?

a.en: It is an enzyme found in some raw fish that destroys thiamine (vitamin B1). Cooking destroys it.
a.sl: To je encim v nekaterih surovih ribah, ki uničuje tiamin (vitamin B1). Kuhanje ga uniči.

question.sl: Ali lahko mačke jedo surovo meso?

answer.en: No, raw meat is not recommended for cats. Even though wild cats eat raw prey, raw meat can carry germs such as Salmonella, Listeria and E. coli, and parasites such as Toxoplasma, which can make cats and people ill.
answer.sl: Ne, surovo meso za mačke ni priporočljivo. Čeprav divje mačke jedo surov plen, lahko surovo meso prenaša klice, kot so salmonela, listerija in E. coli, ter zajedavce, kot je toksoplazma, ki lahko povzročijo bolezen pri mačkah in ljudeh.

why.en: Cornell and the Merck Veterinary Manual both advise against raw meat for cats, as food or as a treat, because it can spread toxoplasmosis and other infections. Contamination of raw meat by bacteria is common, and some cats seem fine but shed the bacteria in their stool, which can spread to people and other pets. Supermarket meat for people is meant to be cooked.
why.sl: Cornell in Merckov veterinarski priročnik odsvetujeta surovo meso za mačke, kot hrano ali priboljšek, ker lahko prenaša toksoplazmozo in druge okužbe. Surovo meso je pogosto okuženo z bakterijami, nekatere mačke pa so videti zdrave, a bakterije izločajo z iztrebki, s čimer se lahko okužijo ljudje in druge živali. Meso za ljudi iz trgovine je namenjeno kuhanju.

what_to_do.en: If your cat ate a bit of raw meat, watch for vomiting, diarrhoea, fever, not eating or tiredness, and call your vet if any appear. Wash your hands and clean surfaces and bowls well.
what_to_do.sl: Če je mačka pojedla malo surovega mesa, bodite pozorni na bruhanje, drisko, vročino, odklanjanje hrane ali utrujenost in pokličite veterinarja, če se kaj od tega pojavi. Dobro si umijte roke ter očistite površine in posodice.

child.en: Raw meat can carry germs. Cats should only get meat that a grown-up has cooked.
child.sl: Na surovem mesu so lahko klice. Mucke naj dobijo le meso, ki ga je skuhal odrasel.

q.en: Cats eat raw prey in the wild, so why not?
q.sl: Divje mačke jedo surov plen, zakaj torej ne?

a.en: Raw meat can carry bacteria and parasites that infect cats and their owners, and Cornell says raw diets have no clear health benefit for cats.
a.sl: Surovo meso lahko prenaša bakterije in zajedavce, ki okužijo mačke in njihove lastnike, Cornell pa navaja, da surova prehrana mačkam ne prinaša jasne koristi za zdravje.

q.en: Who is most at risk?
q.sl: Kdo je najbolj ogrožen?

a.en: People at highest risk of serious illness are the very old, the very young and people with weak immune systems.
a.sl: Najbolj ogroženi za resno bolezen so zelo stari ljudje, zelo majhni otroci in ljudje z oslabljenim imunskim sistemom.

question.en: Can cats eat raw yeast dough?
question.sl: Ali lahko mačke jedo surovo kvašeno testo?

answer.en: No. Raw yeast dough is dangerous for cats in two ways: it can keep expanding in the stomach and cause a blockage, and the yeast makes alcohol, which is toxic to cats. Keep rising dough out of reach and call your vet if your cat eats any.
answer.sl: Ne. Surovo kvašeno testo je za mačke nevarno na dva načina: v želodcu lahko še naprej narašča in povzroči zaporo, kvas pa tvori alkohol, ki je za mačke strupen. Vzhajajoče testo postavite izven dosega in pokličite veterinarja, če ga muca poje.

why.en: Raw dough contains some alcohol and produces carbon dioxide. Once swallowed, the yeast keeps working in the stomach: the dough expands and can cause an obstruction, while the alcohol it produces is absorbed into the blood. Cats are especially sensitive to alcohol.
why.sl: Surovo testo vsebuje nekaj alkohola in tvori ogljikov dioksid. Ko ga žival poje, kvas v želodcu deluje naprej: testo se širi in lahko povzroči zaporo, nastali alkohol pa se vsrka v kri. Mačke so na alkohol še posebej občutljive.

en: Trying to vomit without bringing anything up

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away. Note how much dough your cat ate and when. Don't wait for signs to appear, and don't try to make your cat sick at home.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Zapišite, koliko testa je muca pojedla in kdaj. Ne čakajte na znake in muce doma ne poskušajte spraviti k bruhanju.

child.en: Bread dough needs to rise in a bowl, not in a tummy. Keep dough away from kitty and tell a grown-up if she eats some.
child.sl: Testo mora vzhajati v skledi, ne v trebuščku. Naj bo daleč od muce. Če ga poje, povej odraslemu.

q.en: Why is raw dough dangerous if it's not a poison itself?
q.sl: Zakaj je surovo testo nevarno, če samo po sebi ni strup?

a.en: Raw dough contains live yeast. In the stomach it keeps rising and producing alcohol, so it can both cause a blockage and lead to alcohol poisoning.
a.sl: Surovo testo vsebuje živ kvas. V želodcu še naprej vzhaja in tvori alkohol, zato lahko povzroči zaporo in tudi zastrupitev z alkoholom.

answer.en: Yes, a little cooked salmon is fine as an occasional treat. Serve it plain, with no bones or seasoning, and keep it small. Fish shouldn't replace a cat's complete food.
