answer.sl: Da, malo kuhanega lososa je v redu kot občasen priboljšek. Ponudite ga brez dodatkov, brez kosti in začimb ter v majhni količini. Riba naj ne nadomesti popolne mačje hrane.

why.en: Cats Protection lists cooked salmon with no bones or seasoning among safe festive foods and says small amounts of cooked fish such as salmon are suitable. RSPCA Australia says tinned salmon in spring water can be an occasional treat. Raw fish is different: it may carry bacteria and parasites.
why.sl: Cats Protection kuhanega lososa brez kosti in začimb navaja med varno praznično hrano in pravi, da so majhne količine kuhane ribe, kot je losos, primerne. RSPCA Avstralija navaja, da je konzerviran losos v izvirski vodi lahko občasen priboljšek. Surova riba je nekaj drugega: lahko prenaša bakterije in zajedavce.

what_to_do.en: Offer a small piece first. If your cat gets vomiting or diarrhoea afterwards, stop and ask your vet. Remove any bones you find.
what_to_do.sl: Najprej ponudite majhen košček. Če ima mačka potem bruhanje ali drisko, prenehajte in se posvetujte z veterinarjem. Odstranite vse kosti, ki jih najdete.

serving.en: Cooked, plain, boneless and unseasoned, or tinned in spring water; a few small pieces now and then.
serving.sl: Kuhan, brez dodatkov, kosti in začimb, ali konzerviran v izvirski vodi; nekaj majhnih koščkov občasno.

child.en: A tiny bit of cooked salmon with no bones can be a special treat. Ask a grown-up first.
child.sl: Košček kuhanega lososa brez kosti je lahko poseben priboljšek. Najprej vprašaj odraslega.

q.en: Can cats eat raw salmon or sushi?
q.sl: Ali lahko mačke jedo surovega lososa ali suši?

a.en: It's best not to. Uncooked fish may contain harmful bacteria and parasites, so fish for cats should be properly cooked.
a.sl: Bolje ne. Surova riba lahko vsebuje škodljive bakterije in zajedavce, zato mora biti riba za mačke dobro kuhana.

answer.en: No, not as a food or treat. A cat's digestive system is not designed to handle large amounts of salt, and too much can cause salt poisoning. Keep table salt, rock salt and very salty foods away from your cat, and call your vet if she eats a lot.
answer.sl: Ne, ne kot hrana ali priboljšek. Mačja prebavila niso ustvarjena za večje količine soli, preveč soli pa lahko povzroči zastrupitev. Kuhinjsko sol, sol za posipanje in zelo slano hrano hranite stran od muce in pokličite veterinarja, če je poje veliko.

why.en: Too much salt causes thirst and frequent urination and, in serious cases, tremors and seizures. Salt sources at home include table salt used in cooking and rock salt used as a de-icer in winter.
why.sl: Preveč soli povzroči žejo in pogosto uriniranje, v hujših primerih pa tresenje in krče. Viri soli v domu so kuhinjska sol in sol za posipanje cest in pločnikov pozimi.

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away if your cat ate salt or a very salty food or licked rock salt. Note what she ate, how much and when. Don't wait for signs to appear, and don't try to make your cat sick at home.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali, če je muca pojedla sol ali zelo slano hrano oziroma lizala sol za posipanje. Zapišite, kaj je pojedla, koliko in kdaj. Ne čakajte na znake in muce doma ne poskušajte spraviti k bruhanju.

child.en: Salt is not a cat treat. Keep the salt shaker and very salty food away from kitty.
child.sl: Sol ni priboljšek za muce. Solnica in zelo slana hrana naj bosta daleč od muce.

q.en: Is winter road salt a danger for cats?
q.sl: Je sol za posipanje pozimi nevarna za mačke?

a.en: It can be. Pet Poison Helpline lists rock salt used as a de-icer in winter among the salt sources that can harm cats, so keep bags of it out of reach.
a.sl: Lahko je. Pet Poison Helpline sol za posipanje pozimi navaja med viri soli, ki lahko škodijo mačkam, zato vreče s soljo hranite izven dosega.

answer.en: Yes, as an occasional treat. Tinned sardines in spring water can be offered now and then, watching out for bones. They shouldn't become the main part of a cat's diet.
answer.sl: Da, kot občasen priboljšek. Konzervirane sardine v izvirski vodi lahko ponudite občasno, pri čemer pazite na kosti. Ne smejo postati glavni del mačje prehrane.

why.en: RSPCA Australia says fish such as tinned sardines in spring water can be offered as an occasional treat, taking care with bones, but are not suitable as the main part of the diet. Cats Protection advises fish be properly cooked, with bones removed, and given only a few pieces at a time.
why.sl: RSPCA Avstralija navaja, da je ribo, kot so konzervirane sardine v izvirski vodi, mogoče ponuditi kot občasen priboljšek, pri čemer je treba paziti na kosti, ni pa primerna kot glavni del prehrane. Cats Protection svetuje, naj bo riba dobro kuhana, brez kosti in naj je mačka dobi le nekaj koščkov naenkrat.

what_to_do.en: Offer a small piece first. If your cat gets vomiting or diarrhoea afterwards, stop and ask your vet.
what_to_do.sl: Najprej ponudite majhen košček. Če ima mačka potem bruhanje ali drisko, prenehajte in se posvetujte z veterinarjem.

serving.en: Tinned in spring water, with bones removed; a few pieces now and then.
serving.sl: Konzervirane v izvirski vodi, z odstranjenimi kostmi; nekaj koščkov občasno.

child.en: Sardines can be a little fishy treat for cats sometimes. A grown-up should check for bones.
child.sl: Sardine so lahko včasih majhen ribji priboljšek za mucke. Odrasel naj preveri, da ni kosti.

answer.en: No. Many teas contain caffeine, and cats are more sensitive to caffeine than people. Tea bags are especially risky. Don't share your tea, and call your vet if your cat chews a tea bag or drinks caffeinated tea.
answer.sl: Ne. Veliko čajev vsebuje kofein, mačke pa so nanj bolj občutljive kot ljudje. Posebej tvegane so čajne vrečke. Čaja ne delite z muco in pokličite veterinarja, če prežveči čajno vrečko ali popije čaj s kofeinom.

why.en: Many teas contain caffeine. Cats are more sensitive to caffeine than people. Like chocolate, coffee and other caffeine-containing foods have high levels of stimulants called methylxanthines; caffeine speeds up the heart, makes cats restless and upsets the stomach.
why.sl: Veliko čajev vsebuje kofein. Mačke so na kofein bolj občutljive kot ljudje. Kava in druga živila s kofeinom imajo tako kot čokolada veliko poživil, imenovanih metilksantini; kofein pospeši srce, povzroči nemir in prebavne težave.

en: Restlessness, jitteriness, not wanting to lie still
Fast heartbeat or heart rhythm changes
sl: Nemir, živčnost, muca ne more mirovati
Hiter srčni utrip ali spremembe srčnega ritma

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away. Note what your cat swallowed (drink, grounds, beans, tea bag or tablets), how much and when. Don't wait for signs to appear, and don't try to make your cat sick at home.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Zapišite, kaj je muca zaužila (pijačo, mleto kavo, zrna, čajno vrečko ali tablete), koliko in kdaj. Ne čakajte na znake in muce doma ne poskušajte spraviti k bruhanju.

child.en: Tea is for people. Keep cups and used tea bags away from kitty, and tell a grown-up if she gets into them.
child.sl: Čaj je za ljudi. Skodelice in uporabljene čajne vrečke naj bodo daleč od muce. Če jih najde, povej odraslemu.

q.en: Are tea bags dangerous?
q.sl: So čajne vrečke nevarne?

a.en: Yes. Pet Poison Helpline warns that eating tea bags could cause serious toxicity in cats. Throw used tea bags away where your cat can't reach them.
a.sl: Da. Pet Poison Helpline opozarja, da lahko zaužite čajne vrečke pri mačkah povzročijo resno zastrupitev. Uporabljene vrečke zavrzite tja, kamor muca ne seže.

answer.en: Not regularly. A small amount of tuna may not cause harm, but tinned tuna for people lacks nutrients cats need, can be high in salt and mercury, and some vets advise against it even as a treat. It is never a complete diet.
answer.sl: Ne redno. Majhna količina tune morda ne škodi, vendar konzervirani tuni za ljudi manjkajo hranila, ki jih mačke potrebujejo, lahko ima veliko soli in živega srebra, nekateri veterinarji pa jo odsvetujejo celo kot priboljšek. Nikoli ni popolna prehrana.

why.en: Sources disagree, so we use the stricter level. RSPCA Australia allows tinned tuna in spring water as an occasional treat. VCA says cats shouldn't eat tuna, not even as a treat, because it lacks essential nutrients and has too much unsaturated fat. Cats Protection warns it can be high in salt and mercury and cause weight gain. The Merck Veterinary Manual notes vitamin E deficiency in cats given large quantities of canned tuna.
why.sl: Viri se razlikujejo, zato uporabljamo strožjo stopnjo. RSPCA Avstralija dovoljuje konzervirano tuno v izvirski vodi kot občasen priboljšek. VCA navaja, da mačke tune ne bi smele jesti niti kot priboljšek, ker ji manjkajo nujna hranila in ima preveč nenasičenih maščob. Cats Protection opozarja, da ima lahko veliko soli in živega srebra ter mačko zredi. Merckov veterinarski priročnik omenja pomanjkanje vitamina E pri mačkah, ki so dobivale velike količine konzervirane tune.

what_to_do.en: A bite of tuna is unlikely to be a problem. Don't make it a habit or a main meal. If your cat seems unwell after eating tuna, or eats a lot of it often, talk to your vet.
what_to_do.sl: Grižljaj tune najverjetneje ne bo težava. Naj ne postane navada ali glavni obrok. Če se mačka po tuni ne počuti dobro ali je pogosto poje veliko, se posvetujte z veterinarjem.

serving.en: If at all: tinned in spring water with no added salt, a little, rarely, and never instead of cat food.
serving.sl: Če sploh: konzervirana v izvirski vodi brez dodane soli, malo, redko in nikoli namesto mačje hrane.

child.en: Cats love tuna, but too much isn't healthy. Their own cat food keeps them strong.
child.sl: Mucke imajo rade tuno, a preveč tune ni zdravo. Močne jih ohranja njihova mačja hrana.

q.en: Can my cat live on tuna?
q.sl: Ali lahko mačka živi samo od tune?

a.en: No. Tuna lacks essential nutrients cats need, and cats given large amounts of canned tuna have developed vitamin E deficiency.
a.sl: Ne. Tuni manjkajo nujna hranila, ki jih mačke potrebujejo, pri mačkah, ki so dobivale velike količine konzervirane tune, pa se je razvilo pomanjkanje vitamina E.

question.sl: Ali lahko mačke jedo puranje meso?

answer.en: Yes, a little plain cooked turkey is fine as an occasional treat. Remove bones and skin and skip seasoning, stuffing and gravy. Turkey on its own isn't a complete diet.
answer.sl: Da, malo navadnega kuhanega puranjega mesa je v redu kot občasen priboljšek. Odstranite kosti in kožo ter izpustite začimbe, nadev in omako. Puran sam po sebi ni popolna prehrana.

why.en: Cats Protection says plain cooked turkey is fine as an occasional treat but shouldn't be given regularly, as turkey alone lacks nutrients cats need. Turkey skin is high in fat and can cause digestive upset or even pancreatitis, and roast skin may carry garlic or herbs. Turkey bones can splinter and cause choking or blockages.
why.sl: Cats Protection navaja, da je navaden kuhan puran v redu kot občasen priboljšek, ne pa redno, ker puran sam ne vsebuje vseh hranil, ki jih mačke potrebujejo. Puranja koža ima veliko maščob in lahko povzroči prebavne težave ali celo pankreatitis, pečena koža pa ima lahko česen ali zelišča. Puranje kosti se lahko razcepijo in povzročijo dušenje ali zamašitev.

what_to_do.en: Offer a small piece first. If your cat gets vomiting or diarrhoea afterwards, stop and ask your vet. If your cat ate turkey bones, stuffing or gravy with onion or garlic, call your vet straight away.
what_to_do.sl: Najprej ponudite majhen košček. Če ima mačka potem bruhanje ali drisko, prenehajte in se posvetujte z veterinarjem. Če je mačka pojedla puranje kosti, nadev ali omako s čebulo ali česnom, takoj pokličite veterinarja.

serving.en: Plain cooked meat with no bones, skin or seasoning; a small amount, counted in the daily food.
serving.sl: Navadno kuhano meso brez kosti, kože in začimb; majhna količina, upoštevana v dnevnem obroku.

child.en: A little plain turkey with no bones can be a cat treat. The skin and gravy stay on your plate.
child.sl: Malo navadnega purana brez kosti je lahko priboljšek za mucke. Koža in omaka ostaneta na tvojem krožniku.

q.en: Can cats have turkey skin?
q.sl: Ali lahko mačke jedo puranjo kožo?

a.en: It's best not to. Turkey skin is high in fat and can cause digestive upset or even pancreatitis, and it may have touched seasoning or garlic.
a.sl: Bolje ne. Puranja koža ima veliko maščob in lahko povzroči prebavne težave ali celo pankreatitis, lahko pa je prišla v stik z začimbami ali česnom.

answer.en: No, walnuts are best kept away from cats. They contain a lot of oils and fats, which can make a cat unwell and may cause vomiting or diarrhoea.
answer.sl: Ne, orehov mački raje ne dajajte. Vsebujejo veliko olj in maščob, zaradi katerih se mačka lahko slabo počuti, lahko pa povzročijo tudi bruhanje ali drisko.

why.en: Cats Protection names walnuts among nuts with high amounts of oils and fats that can make a cat unwell. VCA adds that most nuts are very fatty and can cause vomiting and diarrhoea.
why.sl: Cats Protection orehe navaja med oreščki z veliko olj in maščob, zaradi katerih se mačka lahko slabo počuti. VCA dodaja, da je večina oreščkov zelo mastnih in lahko povzroči bruhanje in drisko.

what_to_do.en: If your cat ate walnuts, contact your vet for advice, especially if she ate a lot or seems unwell. Note what she ate, how much and when.
what_to_do.sl: Če je muca pojedla orehe, se za nasvet obrnite na veterinarja, zlasti če jih je pojedla veliko ali se ne počuti dobro. Zapišite, kaj je pojedla, koliko in kdaj.

child.en: Walnuts are too oily for a cat's tummy. Keep them for people and give your cat its own treats.
child.sl: Orehi so za mucin trebušček premastni. Naj ostanejo za ljudi, mucki pa daj njene priboljške.

q.en: Are some nuts worse than others?
q.sl: Ali so nekateri oreščki hujši od drugih?

a.en: Yes. Macadamia nuts are fatty and also toxic to cats, so they are the ones to be most careful with.
a.sl: Da. Makadamije so mastne in za mačke tudi strupene, zato je pri njih potrebna največja previdnost.

answer.en: No, yogurt is best avoided. It is a dairy product, and adult cats have little of the enzyme that digests milk sugar, so dairy can cause diarrhoea or an upset stomach. Veterinary guides advise against feeding cats dairy products.
answer.sl: Ne, jogurta je bolje ne dajati. Je mlečni izdelek, odrasle mačke pa imajo malo encima, ki prebavlja mlečni sladkor, zato jim mlečni izdelki lahko povzročijo drisko ali razdražen želodec. Veterinarski viri odsvetujejo mlečne izdelke za mačke.

why.en: Adult cats have little lactase, the enzyme that breaks down lactose, so milk and other dairy-based products can cause diarrhoea or other digestive upset. Many cats are lactose intolerant. Dairy products are also high in fat and can add to weight gain. Plant-based alternatives are not automatically safe, as some contain ingredients that could be toxic to cats.
why.sl: Odrasle mačke imajo malo laktaze, encima, ki razgradi laktozo, zato lahko mleko in drugi mlečni izdelki povzročijo drisko ali druge prebavne težave. Mnoge mačke ne prenašajo laktoze. Mlečni izdelki imajo tudi veliko maščob in lahko prispevajo k debelosti. Rastlinski nadomestki niso samodejno varni, saj nekateri vsebujejo sestavine, ki so lahko za mačke strupene.

what_to_do.en: If your cat ate yogurt, watch for diarrhoea, vomiting or a change in behaviour, and contact your vet for advice if she seems unwell.
what_to_do.sl: Če je muca pojedla jogurt, bodite pozorni na drisko, bruhanje ali spremembo vedenja in se za nasvet obrnite na veterinarja, če se ne počuti dobro.

child.en: Yogurt is a people food. It can upset a cat's tummy, so keep it in your bowl, not your cat's.
child.sl: Jogurt je hrana za ljudi. Mucki lahko razdraži trebušček, zato naj ostane v tvoji skodelici, ne v njeni.

q.en: Is dairy-free yogurt better for cats?
q.sl: Je jogurt brez mleka boljši za mačke?

a.en: Not necessarily. Many dairy alternatives contain ingredients that could be toxic to cats, so they are best avoided too.
a.sl: Ne nujno. Veliko mlečnih nadomestkov vsebuje sestavine, ki so lahko za mačke strupene, zato se jim je bolje izogniti.

answer.en: No. Alcohol is toxic to dogs. Drinks and foods containing alcohol can cause vomiting, wobbliness, breathing problems and tremors. Alcohol is absorbed quickly, and signs usually begin within 15–90 minutes, so act fast.
answer.sl: Ne. Alkohol je za pse strupen. Pijače in hrana z alkoholom lahko povzročijo bruhanje, opotekanje, težave z dihanjem in tresenje. Alkohol se hitro vsrka, znaki pa se običajno začnejo v 15–90 minutah, zato ukrepajte hitro.

why.en: Alcohol (ethanol) is rapidly absorbed into the blood and depresses the nervous system. It is not only in drinks: it is also in liquor-filled sweets, raw rising bread dough, hand sanitiser and mouthwash. All animals are at risk.
why.sl: Alkohol (etanol) se hitro vsrka v kri in zavira živčevje. Ni le v pijačah: najdemo ga tudi v bonbonih z alkoholnim polnilom, surovem vzhajanem testu, razkužilu za roke in ustni vodi. Ogrožene so vse živali.

sl: Znaki se običajno začnejo v 15–90 minutah

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline immediately. Note what your dog drank or ate and roughly how much. Don't wait for signs: alcohol acts fast, and early treatment is key.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Zapišite si, kaj je pes popil ali pojedel in približno koliko. Ne čakajte na znake: alkohol deluje hitro, zgodnje zdravljenje pa je ključno.

child.en: Grown-up drinks are never for dogs. If a dog drinks some, it can get very ill fast, so tell a grown-up right away.
child.sl: Pijače za odrasle niso nikoli za pse. Če jih pes popije, lahko hitro zelo zboli, zato takoj povej odraslemu.

q.en: Is a lick of beer okay?
q.sl: Je en polizek piva v redu?

a.en: No. Drinks and foods containing alcohol are toxic to dogs. Never offer alcohol, and call your vet if your dog drinks some.
a.sl: Ne. Pijače in hrana z alkoholom so za pse strupene. Psu alkohola nikoli ne ponudite in pokličite veterinarja, če ga popije.

q.en: Where else can a dog find alcohol at home?
q.sl: Kje drugje doma lahko pes najde alkohol?

a.en: In liquor-filled sweets, raw rising bread dough, hand sanitiser and mouthwash.
a.sl: V bonbonih z alkoholnim polnilom, surovem vzhajanem testu, razkužilu za roke in ustni vodi.

answer.en: No, it is best not to. Almonds are not as dangerous as macadamia nuts, but they are fatty and can cause vomiting, diarrhoea and possibly pancreatitis. Whole almonds can also get stuck, especially in small dogs.
answer.sl: Ne, bolje ne. Mandlji niso tako nevarni kot makadamija, so pa mastni in lahko povzročijo bruhanje, drisko in morda vnetje trebušne slinavke. Celi mandlji se lahko tudi zataknejo, posebej pri majhnih psih.

why.en: Almonds, like most nuts, are high in fat, which can upset the stomach and put a dog at risk of pancreatitis. Whole almonds can block the food pipe, intestines or windpipe, especially in small breeds. Salted and flavoured almonds bring extra risks from salt and seasonings.
why.sl: Mandlji so kot večina oreščkov zelo mastni, kar lahko razdraži prebavo in psa izpostavi tveganju za vnetje trebušne slinavke. Celi mandlji lahko zamašijo požiralnik, črevesje ali sapnik, posebej pri majhnih pasmah. Soljeni in začinjeni mandlji prinašajo še dodatno tveganje zaradi soli in začimb.

en: Belly pain, nausea or low energy (possible pancreatitis)
Choking or signs of a blockage
sl: Boleč trebuh, slabost ali utrujenost (možno vnetje trebušne slinavke)

what_to_do.en: One or two almonds are usually no cause for panic: watch your dog for vomiting, diarrhoea or belly pain. Call your vet if your dog ate a lot of almonds or flavoured almonds, seems to be choking, or shows any of these signs.
what_to_do.sl: Eden ali dva mandlja običajno nista razlog za paniko: opazujte, ali pes bruha, ima drisko ali ga boli trebuh. Pokličite veterinarja, če je pes pojedel veliko ali začinjenih mandljev, se duši ali kaže katerega od teh znakov.

child.en: Almonds are a people snack. They are hard for dogs to digest and can upset their tummy. Give a dog treat instead!
child.sl: Mandlji so prigrizek za ljudi. Pes jih težko prebavi in ga lahko boli trebušček. Raje mu daj pasji priboljšek!

q.en: Are almonds as dangerous as macadamia nuts?
q.sl: So mandlji tako nevarni kot makadamija?

a.en: No. Macadamia nuts are toxic to dogs; almonds are a problem mainly because of their fat and the risk of blockage.
a.sl: Ne. Makadamija je za pse strupena; pri mandljih sta glavni težavi maščoba in nevarnost zamašitve.

q.en: My dog ate one almond. What now?
q.sl: Pes je pojedel en mandelj. Kaj zdaj?

a.en: Don't panic. Watch for tummy upset and call your vet if signs appear.
a.sl: Brez panike. Opazujte prebavo in pokličite veterinarja, če se pojavijo znaki.

answer.en: Not recommended. The apricot plant is listed as toxic to dogs: its stems, leaves and seeds contain cyanide, especially as they wilt. Never let your dog chew apricot stones, leaves or stems.
answer.sl: Ni priporočljivo. Marelica je navedena kot strupena za pse: njeni peclji, listi in semena vsebujejo cianid, zlasti ko venejo. Psu nikoli ne pustite žvečiti marelične koščice, listov ali pecljev.

why.en: Apricot stems, leaves and seeds contain cyanogenic glycosides, which release cyanide. Cyanide reduces the body's ability to use oxygen. Because the plant is listed as toxic to dogs, we do not rate apricots as a safe treat.
why.sl: Peclji, listi in semena marelice vsebujejo cianogene glikozide, iz katerih se sprošča cianid. Cianid zmanjša sposobnost telesa, da porablja kisik. Ker je rastlina navedena kot strupena za pse, marelic ne ocenjujemo kot varen priboljšek.

what_to_do.en: If your dog chewed or swallowed apricot stones, leaves or stems, contact your vet for advice right away. Note what was eaten and roughly how much.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes žvečil ali pogoltnil marelične koščice, liste ali peclje, se takoj posvetujte z veterinarjem. Zapišite si, kaj in približno koliko je pojedel.

child.en: Apricot stones, leaves and stems are bad for dogs. Keep apricots for people, and tell a grown-up if your dog chews a stone.
child.sl: Marelične koščice, listi in peclji so za pse slabi. Marelice so za ljudi; povej odraslemu, če pes žveči koščico.

q.en: Which parts of the apricot are toxic?
q.sl: Kateri deli marelice so strupeni?

a.en: The stems, leaves and seeds contain cyanide, and they are particularly toxic as they wilt.
a.sl: Peclji, listi in semena vsebujejo cianid in so posebej strupeni, ko venejo.

answer.en: No, it's safer to keep avocado away from dogs. Some vets say the flesh is not toxic, but the skin, pit and leaves contain persin, and the large pit can choke a dog or block its gut. Avocado is also very fatty, which can lead to pancreatitis.
answer.sl: Ne, avokado je bolje držati stran od psov. Nekateri veterinarji pravijo, da meso ni strupeno, lupina, koščica in listi pa vsebujejo persin, velika koščica pa lahko psa zaduši ali mu zamaši prebavila. Avokado je tudi zelo masten, kar lahko vodi v vnetje trebušne slinavke.

why.en: Sources disagree, so we use the stricter level. The Merck Veterinary Manual says dogs seem relatively resistant compared with other species, the ASPCA names birds and rabbits as the biggest concern, and AKC says the flesh is not toxic. Blue Cross calls persin poisonous to dogs. All agree that the pit can choke a dog or cause a blockage and that the high fat can cause pancreatitis.
why.sl: Viri se razlikujejo, zato uporabljamo strožjo stopnjo. Veterinarski priročnik Merck pravi, da so psi v primerjavi z drugimi vrstami razmeroma odporni, ASPCA kot največjo skrb navaja ptice in kunce, AKC pa pravi, da meso ni strupeno. Blue Cross persin označuje kot strupen za pse. Vsi se strinjajo, da lahko koščica psa zaduši ali povzroči zaporo in da lahko veliko maščobe povzroči vnetje trebušne slinavke.

en: Signs of a blockage after swallowing the pit: repeated vomiting, not eating, tiredness
Feeling unwell from the high fat, which can lead to pancreatitis
sl: Znaki zapore po zaužitju koščice: ponavljajoče se bruhanje, pes noče jesti, utrujenost
Slabo počutje zaradi veliko maščobe, ki lahko vodi v vnetje trebušne slinavke

what_to_do.en: If your dog chewed or swallowed an avocado pit, contact your vet right away and don't wait for signs. If it ate guacamole, call your vet or a pet poison helpline too, because guacamole usually contains onion and garlic. Note what and how much was eaten.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes žvečil ali pogoltnil koščico avokada, takoj pokličite veterinarja in ne čakajte na znake. Če je pojedel guacamole, prav tako pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali, saj guacamole običajno vsebuje čebulo in česen. Zapišite si, kaj in koliko je pojedel.

child.en: Avocado is not a good dog snack. The big stone inside can get stuck in a dog's tummy, so keep avocados away.
child.sl: Avokado ni dober pasji prigrizek. Velika koščica se lahko psu zatakne v trebuščku, zato avokado pospravi.

q.en: Is guacamole safe for dogs?
q.sl: Je guacamole za pse varen?

a.en: No. Guacamole usually contains onion and garlic, which are toxic to dogs.
a.sl: Ne. Guacamole običajno vsebuje čebulo in česen, ki sta za pse strupena.

q.en: What if my dog swallowed the pit?
q.sl: Kaj, če je pes pogoltnil koščico?

a.en: Contact your vet right away. The pit can cause a blockage in the gut.
a.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja. Koščica lahko povzroči zaporo v prebavilih.

q.en: Is avocado flesh poisonous to dogs?
q.sl: Je meso avokada za pse strupeno?

a.en: Sources disagree: some say the flesh is not toxic, others call avocado poisonous to dogs. Because it is also very fatty and the pit is a hazard, we advise keeping it away.
a.sl: Viri se razlikujejo: nekateri pravijo, da meso ni strupeno, drugi avokado označujejo kot strupen za pse. Ker je tudi zelo masten in je koščica nevarna, svetujemo, da ga psu ne dajete.

answer.en: Not recommended. Bacon is not toxic, but it is a fatty table food that can cause vomiting and diarrhoea or trigger pancreatitis, which can be severe. When in doubt, don't share table food with your dog.
answer.sl: Ni priporočljivo. Slanina ni strupena, je pa mastna hrana z mize, ki lahko povzroči bruhanje in drisko ali sproži vnetje trebušne slinavke, ki je lahko hudo. Ob dvomu hrane z mize s psom ne delite.

why.en: Pet Poison Helpline names bacon among fatty table foods that cause problems ranging from mild stomach upset to severe pancreatitis. A fatty meal is a known pancreatitis trigger, and some breeds, such as Miniature Schnauzers, are more prone to it.
why.sl: Pet Poison Helpline slanino navaja med mastno hrano z mize, ki povzroča težave od blagih prebavnih motenj do hudega vnetja trebušne slinavke. Mastni obrok je znan sprožilec tega vnetja, nekatere pasme, na primer pritlikavi šnavcerji, pa so zanj bolj dovzetne.

en: Vomiting, sometimes starting 1–4 days after the fatty meal
Tummy pain (a dog may stretch into a 'prayer' position)
sl: Bruhanje, včasih šele 1–4 dni po mastnem obroku
Bolečine v trebuhu (pes se lahko raztegne v »molitveni« položaj)

what_to_do.en: If your dog ate a lot of fatty food, or shows vomiting, tummy pain or tiredness in the following days, contact your vet. Note what was eaten and roughly how much. Signs of pancreatitis can be delayed by a few days.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes pojedel veliko mastne hrane ali v naslednjih dneh bruha, ga boli trebuh ali je utrujen, pokličite veterinarja. Zapišite si, kaj in približno koliko je pojedel. Znaki vnetja trebušne slinavke se lahko pokažejo z nekajdnevno zamudo.

child.en: Bacon smells yummy, but it is too fatty for dogs and can hurt their tummy. Choose a dog treat instead.
child.sl: Slanina lepo diši, a je za pse premastna in jim lahko škodi trebuščku. Raje izberi pasji priboljšek.

q.en: Is a tiny piece of bacon dangerous?
q.sl: Je majhen košček slanine nevaren?

a.en: Bacon is not toxic, but fatty table food can upset a dog's stomach or trigger pancreatitis, so it's best not to share it.
a.sl: Slanina ni strupena, a mastna hrana z mize lahko psu povzroči prebavne težave ali vnetje trebušne slinavke, zato je raje ne delite.

answer.en: Yes, plain cooked beef with the fat trimmed can be a healthy source of protein. Leave out salt, spices and toppings such as onion and garlic, never give cooked bones, and avoid raw beef, which can carry bacteria.
answer.sl: Da, navadna kuhana govedina z odstranjeno maščobo je lahko zdrav vir beljakovin. Izpustite sol, začimbe in dodatke, kot sta čebula in česen, nikoli ne dajte kuhanih kosti in se izogibajte surovi govedini, ki lahko prenaša bakterije.

why.en: Unseasoned, cooked beef can be a healthy protein, cut into bite-sized pieces with the fat trimmed. Burgers and steaks often contain salt, spices and toppings that can be dangerous; onions and garlic are toxic to dogs. Raw steak or burger can carry Salmonella and E. coli, and cooked bones of any kind should never be given.
why.sl: Nezačinjena kuhana govedina je lahko zdrav vir beljakovin, narezana na grižljaje in brez maščobe. Burgerji in zrezki pogosto vsebujejo sol, začimbe in dodatke, ki so lahko nevarni; čebula in česen sta za pse strupena. Surov zrezek ali burger lahko prenaša salmonelo in E. coli, kuhanih kosti kakršne koli vrste pa psu nikoli ne dajte.

what_to_do.en: If your dog ate fatty or seasoned beef, watch for vomiting, diarrhoea or belly pain and call your vet if they appear. If it ate cooked bones or food with onion or garlic, call your vet straight away.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes pojedel mastno ali začinjeno govedino, opazujte, ali bruha, ima drisko ali ga boli trebuh, in pokličite veterinarja, če se to pojavi. Če je pojedel kuhane kosti ali hrano s čebulo ali česnom, takoj pokličite veterinarja.

serving.en: Plain, unseasoned, fully cooked beef, fat trimmed, boneless, in bite-sized pieces.
serving.sl: Navadna, nezačinjena, popolnoma kuhana govedina, brez maščobe in kosti, narezana na grižljaje.

child.en: A few bites of plain cooked beef can be a treat. Burgers with onions or sauce are only for people.
child.sl: Nekaj grižljajev navadne kuhane govedine je lahko priboljšek. Burgerji s čebulo ali omako so samo za ljudi.

q.en: Can my dog have a bite of my burger?
q.sl: Ali lahko pes dobi grižljaj mojega burgerja?

a.en: Better not: burgers often contain salt, spices and toppings such as onion that can be dangerous. Plain cooked meat is the safer choice.
a.sl: Bolje ne: burgerji pogosto vsebujejo sol, začimbe in dodatke, kot je čebula, ki so lahko nevarni. Navadno kuhano meso je varnejša izbira.

answer.en: No, it is best not to. Butter is not poisonous, but it is very fatty, and fatty foods can upset a dog's stomach and may trigger pancreatitis, a painful inflammation. Food you share, such as eggs or mashed potato, is best prepared without butter.
answer.sl: Ne, bolje ne. Maslo ni strupeno, je pa zelo mastno, mastna hrana pa lahko psu razdraži želodec in sproži vnetje trebušne slinavke, ki je boleče. Hrano, ki jo delite s psom, na primer jajca ali pire, je najbolje pripraviti brez masla.

why.en: Fatty table foods are not a toxicity problem, but fatty foods such as butter, oils and meat drippings may cause pancreatitis. Some breeds, especially miniature Schnauzers, are more prone to it. Vets also suggest preparing food for dogs, such as eggs or mashed potato, without butter.
why.sl: Mastna hrana z mize ni strupena, a mastna živila, kot so maslo, olja in mast od pečenke, lahko povzročijo vnetje trebušne slinavke. Nekatere pasme, predvsem mali šnavcerji, so zanj bolj dovzetne. Veterinarski viri tudi svetujejo, da hrano za pse, na primer jajca ali pire, pripravimo brez masla.

en: Vomiting, sometimes starting 1–4 days after a fatty meal
sl: Bruhanje, ki se lahko začne 1–4 dni po mastnem obroku

what_to_do.en: If your dog ate a lot of butter, or shows vomiting, belly pain, diarrhoea or low energy in the next few days, call your vet as soon as possible.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes pojedel veliko masla ali v naslednjih dneh bruha, ga boli trebuh, ima drisko ali je utrujen, čim prej pokličite veterinarja.

child.en: Butter is too fatty for dogs and can give them a sore tummy. Keep the butter dish out of reach!
child.sl: Maslo je za pse premastno in jih lahko boli trebušček. Maslo pospravi, da ga pes ne doseže!

q.en: Is butter toxic to dogs?
q.sl: Je maslo za pse strupeno?

a.en: Not in the poisonous sense. The problem is the fat, which may cause stomach upset or pancreatitis.
a.sl: Ne v smislu zastrupitve. Težava je maščoba, ki lahko povzroči prebavne težave ali vnetje trebušne slinavke.

question.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo indijske oreščke?

answer.en: Yes, a few plain cashews as an occasional treat are generally safe: shelled, unsalted and unseasoned. They are high in fat, so too many can cause tummy upset or pancreatitis. Avoid mixed nuts, which may contain toxic macadamia nuts.
answer.sl: Da, nekaj navadnih indijskih oreščkov kot občasen priboljšek je na splošno varnih: oluščenih, nesoljenih in nezačinjenih. So zelo mastni, zato jih preveč lahko razdraži prebavo ali povzroči vnetje trebušne slinavke. Izogibajte se mešanicam oreščkov, ki lahko vsebujejo strupeno makadamijo.

why.en: Cashews aren't toxic, but they are a high-fat snack: eating too many can lead to tummy upset, pancreatitis and weight gain. Salted cashews add salt, which in excess is harmful. The biggest risk comes from other nuts in a mix, such as macadamias. Some dogs may react with swelling, itching or hives.
why.sl: Indijski oreščki niso strupeni, so pa zelo mastni: preveč jih lahko povzroči prebavne težave, vnetje trebušne slinavke in debelost. Soljeni dodajo sol, ki v prevelikih količinah škoduje. Največje tveganje so drugi oreščki v mešanici, na primer makadamija. Nekateri psi se lahko odzovejo z oteklino, srbenjem ali koprivnico.

what_to_do.en: Watch for vomiting, diarrhoea, swelling, itching or hives and call your vet if they appear. If your dog ate a large amount, salted nuts or a mix that may contain macadamia nuts, call your vet straight away.
what_to_do.sl: Opazujte, ali se pojavijo bruhanje, driska, oteklina, srbenje ali koprivnica, in če se, pokličite veterinarja. Če je pes pojedel veliko oreščkov, soljene oreščke ali mešanico, ki lahko vsebuje makadamijo, takoj pokličite veterinarja.

serving.en: Only a few plain cashews, shelled and unsalted, never from a mixed-nut bag.
serving.sl: Le nekaj navadnih indijskih oreščkov, oluščenih in nesoljenih, nikoli iz mešanice oreščkov.

child.en: A dog may have one or two plain cashews sometimes. Salty nut mixes are not for dogs.
child.sl: Pes lahko včasih dobi enega ali dva navadna indijska oreščka. Slane mešanice oreščkov niso za pse.

q.en: Why not mixed nuts?
q.sl: Zakaj ne mešanica oreščkov?

a.en: Mixes may contain macadamia nuts, which are very toxic to dogs, and are often salted.
a.sl: Mešanice lahko vsebujejo makadamijo, ki je za pse zelo strupena, in so pogosto soljene.

answer.en: Not as a regular treat. Some vet sources allow small bits of plain, lower-fat cheese, but cheese is fatty, many dogs digest dairy poorly, and some cheeses contain onion, garlic or chives. Blue cheeses are a particular worry.
answer.sl: Ne kot reden priboljšek. Nekateri veterinarski viri dovolijo majhne koščke navadnega, manj mastnega sira, a sir je masten, mnogi psi mlečne izdelke slabo prebavljajo, nekateri siri pa vsebujejo čebulo, česen ali drobnjak. Posebej previdni bodite pri plesnivih modrih sirih.

why.en: Dogs have little lactase, the enzyme that digests milk sugar, so dairy can upset the stomach. Cheese is high in fat: too much leads to weight gain and can trigger pancreatitis. Flavoured cheeses may contain onion, garlic or chives, and blue cheeses such as Roquefort contain roquefortine C, to which dogs appear sensitive. Sources differ: the AKC and Dogs Trust allow small amounts, while Cornell lists cheese among fatty foods to avoid, so we use the stricter level.
why.sl: Psi imajo malo laktaze, encima, ki razgradi mlečni sladkor, zato jim mlečni izdelki lahko razdražijo prebavo. Sir je zelo masten: preveč ga povzroči debelost in lahko sproži vnetje trebušne slinavke. Aromatizirani siri lahko vsebujejo čebulo, česen ali drobnjak, modri siri, kot je rokfor, pa roquefortin C, za katerega so psi očitno občutljivi. Viri se razlikujejo: AKC in Dogs Trust dovolita majhne količine, Cornell pa sir uvršča med mastno hrano, ki se ji je treba izogniti, zato smo izbrali strožjo stopnjo.

en: Belly pain, nausea, low energy or poor appetite (possible pancreatitis)
sl: Boleč trebuh, slabost, utrujenost ali slab apetit (možno vnetje trebušne slinavke)

what_to_do.en: A small plain piece usually needs nothing more than watching for tummy upset. Call your vet if your dog ate a lot of cheese, ate blue cheese or cheese with onion, garlic or chives, or shows vomiting, belly pain or tremors.
what_to_do.sl: Pri majhnem koščku navadnega sira običajno zadošča, da opazujete prebavo. Pokličite veterinarja, če je pes pojedel veliko sira, modri sir ali sir s čebulo, česnom ali drobnjakom ali če bruha, ga boli trebuh ali se trese.

serving.en: If you share at all: a tiny piece of plain, lower-fat cheese such as mozzarella or cottage cheese, never flavoured or blue cheese.
serving.sl: Če ga sploh daste: droben košček navadnega, manj mastnega sira, na primer mocarele ali skute, nikoli aromatiziranega ali modrega sira.

child.en: Cheese is very fatty for a dog's tummy. A tiny plain piece now and then is plenty — ask a grown-up first.
child.sl: Sir je za pasji trebušček zelo masten. Droben navaden košček občasno je dovolj — najprej vprašaj odraslega.

q.en: Is blue cheese worse than other cheese for dogs?
q.sl: Je modri sir za pse slabši od drugih sirov?

a.en: Yes. Roquefort and other blue cheeses contain roquefortine C, and dogs appear sensitive to it; severe cases can bring muscle tremors.
a.sl: Da. Rokfor in drugi modri siri vsebujejo roquefortin C, za katerega so psi očitno občutljivi; v hujših primerih se pojavi tresenje mišic.

q.en: Which cheese is the least risky?
q.sl: Kateri sir je najmanj tvegan?

a.en: Lower-fat plain cheeses such as mozzarella, cottage cheese or soft goat cheese, in a small amount.
a.sl: Manj mastni navadni siri, kot so mocarela, skuta ali mehki kozji sir, v majhni količini.

answer.en: No, cherries are best avoided. The ripe flesh is not the toxic part, but the pits, stems and leaves contain compounds that can release cyanide, and pits can block a dog's intestines. Pet Poison Helpline says the risk outweighs any benefit.
answer.sl: Ne, češnjam se je bolje izogniti. Zrelo meso ni strupeni del, koščice, peclji in listi pa vsebujejo snovi, iz katerih se lahko sprosti cianid, koščice pa lahko psu zamašijo črevesje. Pet Poison Helpline pravi, da tveganje presega koristi.

why.en: Cherry pits, stems and leaves contain cyanogenic glycosides, which can turn into cyanide. Cyanide is released when a pit is chewed and broken; a pit swallowed whole is not expected to poison, but it can get stuck and cause a blockage. One cherry will not cause cyanide poisoning, yet the risk is not worth it.
why.sl: Koščice, peclji in listi češenj vsebujejo cianogene glikozide, ki se lahko spremenijo v cianid. Cianid se sprosti, ko pes koščico prežveči in zdrobi; cela pogoltnjena koščica naj ne bi zastrupila, lahko pa se zatakne in povzroči zaporo. Ena češnja ne povzroči zastrupitve s cianidom, a tveganje se ne splača.

what_to_do.en: If your dog ate cherry pits, stems or leaves, or a lot of cherries, contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away. Note roughly how many were eaten and whether pits were chewed. Don't wait for signs.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes pojedel koščice, peclje ali liste češenj ali veliko češenj, takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Zapišite si, približno koliko jih je pojedel in ali je koščice prežvečil. Ne čakajte na znake.

child.en: Cherries have hard stones inside that are bad for dogs. Keep cherries for people and tell a grown-up if your dog eats some.
child.sl: Češnje imajo v sebi trde koščice, ki so za pse slabe. Češnje so za ljudi; povej odraslemu, če jih pes poje.

q.en: Is one cherry an emergency?
q.sl: Je ena češnja nujen primer?

a.en: One cherry will not cause cyanide poisoning, and a healthy dog that eats one or two does not need panic. Still, pits can cause blockages, so ask your vet if you are unsure.
a.sl: Ena češnja ne povzroči zastrupitve s cianidom in zdravemu psu, ki poje eno ali dve, ni treba paničariti. Koščice pa lahko povzročijo zaporo, zato se ob dvomu posvetujte z veterinarjem.

q.en: Can I give pitted cherries?
q.sl: Lahko dam izkoščičene češnje?

a.en: The ripe pulp is not the toxic part, but Pet Poison Helpline advises that the risk of feeding cherries outweighs the benefits.
a.sl: Zrela sredica ni strupeni del, a Pet Poison Helpline svetuje, da tveganje hranjenja s češnjami presega koristi.

answer.en: Not recommended. A few potato chips are unlikely to cause salt poisoning, but chips are salty and excessive salty food is not good for dogs, especially those with heart problems. Onion- or garlic-flavoured chips add a further risk, because onion and garlic are toxic to dogs.
answer.sl: Ni priporočljivo. Nekaj čipsa verjetno ne povzroči zastrupitve s soljo, a čips je slan, preveč slane hrane pa psom ne koristi, zlasti tistim s srčnimi težavami. Čips z okusom čebule ali česna je še bolj tvegan, ker sta čebula in česen za pse strupena.

why.en: AKC says a dog can have salty foods like potato chips in limited amounts, but excess salt is not good for dogs and can cause fluid retention. Large amounts of salt can lead to salt poisoning. Onion and garlic are toxic to dogs in every form, including powders.
why.sl: AKC pravi, da lahko pes slano hrano, kot je čips, je v omejenih količinah, a presežek soli psom ne koristi in lahko povzroči zastajanje tekočine. Velike količine soli lahko vodijo v zastrupitev s soljo. Čebula in česen sta za pse strupena v vseh oblikah, tudi v prahu.

en: Strong thirst and peeing a lot
Vomiting, often within a few hours

what_to_do.en: If your dog ate a lot of chips, especially onion- or garlic-flavoured ones, contact your vet or a pet poison helpline. Note the flavour and roughly how much was eaten.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes pojedel veliko čipsa, zlasti z okusom čebule ali česna, pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Zapišite si okus in približno koliko je pojedel.

child.en: Chips are a salty people snack. They are not good for dogs, so keep the bag closed and give your dog its own treat.
child.sl: Čips je slan prigrizek za ljudi. Psom ne koristi, zato vrečko zapri in psu daj njegov priboljšek.

q.en: Are flavoured chips worse?
q.sl: Je čips z okusom slabši?

a.en: They can be. Onion and garlic are toxic to dogs in every form, including powders, so check the flavour.
a.sl: Lahko je. Čebula in česen sta za pse strupena v vseh oblikah, tudi v prahu, zato preverite okus.

answer.en: No. Chives belong to the allium family, like onion and garlic, and are toxic to dogs. Raw, cooked and dried chives can all damage red blood cells, and signs often take a few days to appear.
answer.sl: Ne. Drobnjak spada v družino lukov, tako kot čebula in česen, in je za pse strupen. Surov, kuhan in posušen drobnjak lahko poškodujejo rdeče krvničke, znaki pa se pogosto pokažejo šele po nekaj dneh.

why.en: It belongs to the allium family (onion, garlic, leek, chives), which is toxic to dogs. These plants contain compounds that damage red blood cells and can lead to anaemia. All parts and all forms are harmful: raw, cooked, dried and powdered. Stomach upset can happen with any amount; larger amounts damage the blood.
why.sl: Spada v družino lukov (čebula, česen, por, drobnjak), ki je za pse strupena. Te rastline vsebujejo snovi, ki poškodujejo rdeče krvničke in lahko povzročijo slabokrvnost. Škodljivi so vsi deli in vse oblike: surove, kuhane, posušene in v prahu. Prebavne težave se lahko pojavijo pri vsaki količini, večje količine pa poškodujejo kri.

en: Tummy upset, even after small amounts
Signs of anaemia (damaged red blood cells), usually a few days later
sl: Prebavne težave, tudi po majhnih količinah
Znaki slabokrvnosti (poškodovane rdeče krvničke), običajno po nekaj dneh

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away. Note what was eaten (chives) and roughly how much. Don't wait for signs: damage to the blood usually shows only a few days later.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Zapišite si, kaj je pes pojedel (drobnjak) in približno koliko. Ne čakajte na znake: okvara krvi se običajno pokaže šele po nekaj dneh.

child.en: Chives look like little green grass, but they are in the onion family and not for dogs. Tell a grown-up if your dog eats some.
child.sl: Drobnjak je videti kot zelena travica, a spada med čebule in ni za pse. Povej odraslemu, če ga pes poje.

q.en: Is it safe when cooked or as powder?
q.sl: Je varno, če je kuhano ali v prahu?

a.en: No. Raw, cooked, dried, powdered and liquid forms are all poisonous to dogs.
a.sl: Ne. Za pse so strupene surove, kuhane, posušene, praškaste in tekoče oblike.

q.en: Why don't signs show straight away?
q.sl: Zakaj se znaki ne pokažejo takoj?

a.en: Symptoms can start within 24 hours but more often take a few days to appear; signs of anaemia typically develop several days after eating.
a.sl: Znaki se lahko pojavijo v 24 urah, pogosteje pa šele po nekaj dneh; znaki slabokrvnosti se običajno razvijejo nekaj dni po zaužitju.

answer.en: No. Chocolate is toxic to dogs, even in quite small amounts. It contains theobromine and caffeine, and the darker the chocolate, the greater the risk. Baking chocolate and cocoa powder are the most dangerous; white chocolate has the least of these substances.
answer.sl: Ne. Čokolada je za pse strupena, tudi v precej majhnih količinah. Vsebuje teobromin in kofein; temnejša kot je čokolada, večje je tveganje. Najnevarnejša sta čokolada za kuhanje in kakav v prahu, bela čokolada pa vsebuje najmanj teh snovi.

why.en: Chocolate contains methylxanthines, mainly theobromine and caffeine, which are toxic to dogs. Dark chocolate, cooking chocolate and cocoa powder contain more of them than milk chocolate. Dogs are affected most often because they eat whatever they find and can easily reach chocolate. Sweets and baked goods may also contain other harmful ingredients.
why.sl: Čokolada vsebuje metilksantine, predvsem teobromin in kofein, ki so za pse strupeni. Temna čokolada, čokolada za kuhanje in kakav v prahu jih vsebujejo več kot mlečna čokolada. Psi so najpogosteje prizadeti, ker pojedo, kar najdejo, in čokolado zlahka dosežejo. Sladkarije in pecivo lahko vsebujejo še druge škodljive sestavine.

en: Panting, strong thirst and peeing more
sl: Sopihanje, huda žeja in pogostejše uriniranje
Znaki se običajno pojavijo v 6–12 urah

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away, even if your dog ate only a little. Note what kind of chocolate it was and how much was eaten. Don't wait for signs, because they can take hours to appear.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali, tudi če je pes pojedel le malo. Zapišite si, katero čokolado in koliko je pojedel. Ne čakajte na znake, saj se lahko pokažejo šele po nekaj urah.

child.en: Chocolate is for people, not dogs. It can make dogs very ill. Keep it away and tell a grown-up if your dog eats some.
child.sl: Čokolada je za ljudi, ne za pse. Psu lahko zelo škodi. Pospravi jo in povej odraslemu, če jo pes poje.

q.en: Is white chocolate safe for dogs?
q.sl: Je bela čokolada za pse varna?

a.en: It is not a safe treat. White chocolate has the lowest content of the harmful substances, but the risk still depends on the type and amount eaten, so call your vet if your dog ate some.
a.sl: Ni varen priboljšek. Bela čokolada vsebuje najmanj škodljivih snovi, a tveganje je vseeno odvisno od vrste in količine, zato pokličite veterinarja, če jo je pes pojedel.

q.en: Which chocolate is the most dangerous?
q.sl: Katera čokolada je najnevarnejša?

a.en: Baking chocolate and cocoa powder, followed by dark chocolate. The darker the chocolate, the greater the risk.
a.sl: Čokolada za kuhanje in kakav v prahu, nato temna čokolada. Temnejša kot je čokolada, večje je tveganje.

q.en: When do signs of chocolate poisoning appear?
q.sl: Kdaj se pokažejo znaki zastrupitve s čokolado?

a.en: Usually within 6–12 hours after eating it, which is why you should call the vet straight away instead of waiting.
a.sl: Običajno v 6–12 urah po zaužitju, zato veterinarja pokličite takoj in ne čakajte.

answer.en: No. Coffee contains caffeine, which is toxic to dogs; dogs are more sensitive to it than people. A lick or two is unlikely to cause poisoning, but coffee grounds and beans can cause serious toxicity. Chocolate-covered coffee beans are a double threat.
answer.sl: Ne. Kava vsebuje kofein, ki je za pse strupen; psi so nanj bolj občutljivi kot ljudje. En ali dva polizka verjetno ne povzročita zastrupitve, mleta kava in kavna zrna pa lahko povzročijo hudo zastrupitev. Zrna, oblita s čokolado, so dvojna nevarnost.

why.en: Caffeine overstimulates the heart and nervous system. It is the same kind of substance that makes chocolate toxic. A lick or two of coffee is unlikely to poison, but unused coffee grounds and beans can cause serious toxicity, and chocolate-covered beans are a double threat.
why.sl: Kofein pretirano spodbuja srce in živčevje. Gre za isto vrsto snovi, zaradi katere je strupena čokolada. Polizek ali dva kave verjetno ne zastrupita, neuporabljena mleta kava in zrna pa lahko povzročijo hudo zastrupitev; zrna v čokoladi so dvojna nevarnost.

sl: Nemir, pretirana živahnost, hoja sem in tja

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline as soon as you realise your dog has had caffeine. Note what it was (drink, grounds, beans, tea bags) and roughly how much. Don't wait for signs: early treatment matters.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj ko opazite, da je pes zaužil kofein, pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Zapišite si, kaj je bilo (pijača, mleta kava, zrna, čajne vrečke) in približno koliko. Ne čakajte na znake: zgodnje zdravljenje je pomembno.

child.en: Coffee is a grown-up drink and is not for dogs. Keep cups and coffee beans out of reach.
child.sl: Kava je pijača za odrasle in ni za pse. Skodelice in kavna zrna pospravi izven dosega.

q.en: My dog licked my cup. Is that an emergency?
q.sl: Pes je polizal mojo skodelico. Je to nujno?

a.en: One or two licks are unlikely to poison most dogs. If your dog drank more, or ate grounds, beans or tea bags, call your vet or a pet poison helpline.
a.sl: En ali dva polizka večine psov verjetno ne zastrupita. Če je pes popil več ali pojedel mleto kavo, zrna ali čajne vrečke, pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali.

q.en: Are coffee grounds dangerous?
q.sl: Je nevarna tudi mleta kava?

a.en: Coffee grounds are a known source of caffeine for pets. Keep grounds and beans away from your dog and call your vet if it eats some.
a.sl: Mleta kava je znan vir kofeina za živali. Mleto kavo in zrna hranite stran od psa in pokličite veterinarja, če jih poje.

question.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo kuhane kosti?

answer.en: No. Never give a dog cooked bones. Cooked bones splinter into sharp shards that can cut the mouth, cause choking or block the gut. Cooked poultry bones are especially brittle and can turn into a veterinary emergency.
answer.sl: Ne. Psu nikoli ne dajajte kuhanih kosti. Kuhane kosti se razcepijo v ostre drobce, ki lahko porežejo usta, povzročijo dušenje ali zamašijo prebavila. Kuhane kosti perutnine so posebej krhke in lahko povzročijo nujno stanje pri veterinarju.

why.en: Cooking makes bones brittle, so they break into sharp splinters. Chicken and turkey bones are the classic example, but any bones from the kitchen table can injure a dog. The FDA has received reports of choking, mouth wounds, vomiting, diarrhoea, rectal bleeding and gut blockages in dogs that ate bones or bone treats.
why.sl: Kuhanje naredi kosti krhke, zato se razlomijo v ostre drobce. Najbolj znane so piščančje in puranje kosti, poškodujejo pa lahko vse kosti z mize. FDA je prejela poročila o dušenju, ranah v ustih, bruhanju, driski, krvavitvah iz zadnjika in zaporah prebavil pri psih, ki so pojedli kosti ali kostne priboljške.

en: Cuts or bleeding in the mouth

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet right away if your dog has eaten cooked bones, even if it seems fine. Note what kind of bone it was and roughly how much was eaten. Don't wait for signs of a blockage.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja, če je pes pojedel kuhane kosti, tudi če se zdi v redu. Zapišite si, kakšna kost je bila in približno koliko je pojedel. Ne čakajte na znake zapore.

child.en: Bones from our plates are not for dogs. They break into sharp bits. Tell a grown-up if your dog finds one.
child.sl: Kosti z naših krožnikov niso za pse. Zlomijo se v ostre koščke. Povej odraslemu, če pes najde kost.

q.en: Are chicken bones the worst?
q.sl: So piščančje kosti najhujše?

a.en: Cooked poultry bones are especially brittle and splinter easily, but any cooked bone from the table can cause injury.
a.sl: Kuhane kosti perutnine so posebej krhke in se zlahka razcepijo, poškodbo pa lahko povzroči vsaka kuhana kost z mize.

q.en: How do I stop my dog getting bones?
q.sl: Kako preprečim, da pes pride do kosti?

a.en: Keep platters out of reach while cooking and eating, and be careful what goes in the bin: dogs often raid the trash for carcasses and steak bones.
a.sl: Med kuhanjem in jedjo imejte krožnike izven dosega in pazite, kaj vržete v koš: psi pogosto stikajo po smeteh za ostanki perutnine in kostmi zrezkov.

question.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo kuhanega piščanca?

answer.en: Yes. Plain, unseasoned cooked chicken, taken off the bone, can be served to a dog on its own. Never give cooked chicken bones, which splinter easily, and skip seasoned, fatty or raw chicken.
answer.sl: Da. Navaden, nezačinjen kuhan piščanec brez kosti lahko psu ponudite kar samega. Nikoli ne dajte kuhanih piščančjih kosti, ki se zlahka razcepijo, in se izogibajte začinjenemu, mastnemu ali surovemu piščancu.

why.en: Unseasoned roasted, poached, grilled or baked chicken is fine on its own. Cooked chicken bones splinter easily and can cause choking or puncture the gut. Raw chicken is not recommended because of Salmonella and other bacteria. Thigh meat has about twice the fat of breast, and fatty foods can upset the stomach.
why.sl: Nezačinjen pečen, poširan, na žaru ali v pečici pripravljen piščanec je primeren sam po sebi. Kuhane piščančje kosti se zlahka razcepijo in lahko povzročijo dušenje ali predrtje prebavil. Surov piščanec ni priporočljiv zaradi salmonele in drugih bakterij. Bedra imajo približno dvakrat več maščobe kot prsi, mastna hrana pa lahko razdraži prebavo.

what_to_do.en: If your dog swallowed cooked chicken bones, call your vet for advice and don't try to make your dog sick. Call straight away if you see choking, vomiting or signs of tummy pain.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes pogoltnil kuhane piščančje kosti, pokličite veterinarja za nasvet in ne poskušajte izzvati bruhanja. Takoj pokličite, če opazite dušenje, bruhanje ali znake bolečine v trebuhu.

serving.en: Plain cooked chicken (breast is leanest), no seasoning, fully cooked, taken off the bone, in small pieces.
serving.sl: Navaden kuhan piščanec (prsi so najbolj puste), brez začimb, popolnoma kuhan, brez kosti, v majhnih koščkih.

child.en: Plain cooked chicken with no bones is a tasty dog treat. Chicken bones are never for dogs.
child.sl: Navaden kuhan piščanec brez kosti je slasten pasji priboljšek. Piščančje kosti nikoli niso za pse.

q.en: Why are cooked chicken bones dangerous?
q.sl: Zakaj so kuhane piščančje kosti nevarne?

a.en: Cooked chicken bones splinter easily and can cause choking or a puncture in the gut.
a.sl: Kuhane piščančje kosti se zlahka razcepijo in lahko povzročijo dušenje ali predrtje prebavil.

question.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo kuhana jajca?

answer.en: Yes. Fully cooked eggs are safe and nutritious for dogs in moderation, as long as they are plain: no oil, butter, salt or seasonings. Hard-boiled or scrambled eggs work well. Too many can lead to weight gain.
answer.sl: Da. Popolnoma kuhana jajca so za pse v zmernih količinah varna in hranljiva, če so navadna: brez olja, masla, soli in začimb. Primerna so trdo kuhana ali umešana jajca. Preveč jih lahko vodi do debelosti.

why.en: Cooked eggs provide protein, vitamins and healthy fats, but they are not essential to a balanced diet. Vets advise always cooking eggs before giving them to a dog. Egg shells have sharp edges that can hurt a dog's throat, and like any treat, eggs add calories.
why.sl: Kuhana jajca dajejo beljakovine, vitamine in zdrave maščobe, vendar za uravnoteženo prehrano niso nujna. Jajca je treba pred hranjenjem psa vedno skuhati. Lupine imajo ostre robove, ki lahko poškodujejo psu grlo, jajca pa kot vsak priboljšek dodajo kalorije.

what_to_do.en: If your dog ate eggs cooked with butter, salt or seasonings, or a lot of eggs, watch for tummy upset and call your vet if vomiting or diarrhoea is severe or doesn't stop.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes pojedel jajca, pripravljena z maslom, soljo ali začimbami, ali veliko jajc, opazujte prebavo in pokličite veterinarja, če sta bruhanje ali driska huda ali ne prenehata.

serving.en: Fully cooked (hard-boiled or scrambled), plain, without oil, butter, salt, seasonings or other additives; as an occasional treat.
serving.sl: Popolnoma kuhana (trdo kuhana ali umešana), navadna, brez olja, masla, soli, začimb in drugih dodatkov; kot občasen priboljšek.

child.en: A plain cooked egg can be a yummy treat for a dog. No salt or butter, please!
child.sl: Navadno kuhano jajce je lahko za psa slasten priboljšek. Brez soli in masla, prosim!

q.en: Can dogs eat eggshells?
q.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo jajčne lupine?

a.en: Sources differ: Dogs Trust lists cooked eggshells as usually fine, while the AKC warns that shells have sharp edges. Leaving them out is the safer choice.
a.sl: Viri se razlikujejo: Dogs Trust kuhane lupine navaja kot običajno primerne, AKC pa opozarja, da imajo lupine ostre robove. Varneje je, da jih ne dajete.

q.en: How should I cook eggs for my dog?
q.sl: Kako naj psu pripravim jajca?

a.en: Hard-boiled or scrambled, fully cooked and plain, with no salt, butter or seasonings.
a.sl: Trdo kuhana ali umešana, popolnoma kuhana in navadna, brez soli, masla in začimb.

question.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo koruzne storže?

answer.en: No. Never give a dog corn on the cob. Dogs may swallow pieces or even the whole cob, which can cause choking or a serious intestinal blockage that may need emergency treatment. Plain corn kernels off the cob are a different matter.
answer.sl: Ne. Psu nikoli ne dajajte koruze na storžu. Psi lahko pogoltnejo kose ali celo cel storž, kar lahko povzroči dušenje ali resno zaporo črevesja, ki lahko zahteva nujno zdravljenje. Navadna koruzna zrnca brez storža so nekaj drugega.

why.en: Swallowed pieces can block the intestines; in one reported case the blockage restricted the blood supply, and emergency treatment may be needed. Plain kernels in moderation are generally safe; the cob is the danger.
why.sl: Pogoltnjeni kosi lahko zamašijo črevesje; v enem opisanem primeru je zapora ovirala prekrvavitev, potrebno pa je lahko nujno zdravljenje. Navadna zrnca so v zmernih količinah na splošno varna; nevaren je storž.

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet right away if your dog swallowed a corn cob or part of one, even if it seems fine. Note when it happened and roughly how much was eaten. Don't wait for signs of a blockage.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja, če je pes pogoltnil koruzni storž ali njegov del, tudi če se zdi v redu. Zapišite si, kdaj se je to zgodilo in približno koliko je pojedel. Ne čakajte na znake zapore.

child.en: Corn cobs can get stuck in a dog's tummy. Put cobs straight in a closed bin, and tell a grown-up if your dog eats one.
child.sl: Koruzni storži se lahko psu zataknejo v trebuščku. Storže takoj daj v zaprt koš in povej odraslemu, če ga pes poje.

q.en: Can dogs eat corn kernels?
q.sl: Lahko psi jedo koruzna zrnca?

a.en: Plain corn kernels are generally safe for dogs in moderation. It's the cob that is dangerous.
a.sl: Navadna koruzna zrnca so za pse v zmernih količinah na splošno varna. Nevaren je storž.

q.en: Will a corn cob pass on its own?
q.sl: Bo storž prešel sam od sebe?

a.en: Don't wait to find out. A swallowed cob can cause a serious blockage, so contact your vet straight away.
a.sl: Ne čakajte, da bi to ugotovili. Pogoltnjen storž lahko povzroči resno zaporo, zato takoj pokličite veterinarja.

question.sl: Ali lahko psi pijejo energijske pijače?

answer.en: No. Energy drinks often contain a lot of caffeine, which is toxic to dogs. Caffeine overstimulates the heart and nervous system, and dogs are more sensitive to it than people. Even lapping up a spilled energy drink can be a problem.
answer.sl: Ne. Energijske pijače pogosto vsebujejo veliko kofeina, ki je za pse strupen. Kofein pretirano spodbuja srce in živčevje, psi pa so nanj bolj občutljivi kot ljudje. Težava je lahko že polizana razlita energijska pijača.

why.en: Energy and sports drinks often contain a lot of caffeine, and energy shots, pouches and tablets contain caffeine too. Caffeine stimulates the heart and nervous system, which can be dangerous for dogs.
why.sl: Energijske in športne pijače pogosto vsebujejo veliko kofeina, kofein pa vsebujejo tudi energijski šoti, vrečke in tablete. Kofein spodbuja srce in živčevje, kar je za pse lahko nevarno.

sl: Nemir, pretirana živahnost, hoja sem in tja

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline as soon as you realise your dog has had caffeine. Note what it was (drink, shot, pouch or tablet) and roughly how much. Don't wait for signs: early treatment matters.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj ko opazite, da je pes zaužil kofein, pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Zapišite si, kaj je bilo (pijača, šot, vrečka ali tableta) in približno koliko. Ne čakajte na znake: zgodnje zdravljenje je pomembno.

child.en: Energy drinks are not for dogs at all. Wipe up spills fast and tell a grown-up if your dog drinks some.
child.sl: Energijske pijače sploh niso za pse. Razlito hitro pobriši in povej odraslemu, če jo pes popije.

q.en: What about energy shots and caffeine tablets?
q.sl: Kaj pa energijski šoti in tablete s kofeinom?

a.en: They contain caffeine too. Keep them out of reach and call your vet straight away if your dog gets into them.
a.sl: Tudi ti vsebujejo kofein. Hranite jih izven dosega in takoj pokličite veterinarja, če jih pes doseže.

question.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo mastno meso?

answer.en: Not recommended. Fatty meat, poultry skin and gristle are not toxic, but they can cause vomiting and diarrhoea or trigger pancreatitis, a painful and sometimes severe inflammation. Some breeds, such as Miniature Schnauzers, are more prone to it.
answer.sl: Ni priporočljivo. Mastno meso, kožica perutnine in hrustanec niso strupeni, lahko pa povzročijo bruhanje in drisko ali sprožijo vnetje trebušne slinavke, ki je boleče in včasih hudo. Nekatere pasme, na primer pritlikavi šnavcerji, so zanj bolj dovzetne.

why.en: A fatty meal is a known trigger of pancreatitis in dogs. Effects range from a mild upset stomach to a severe, even life-threatening pancreatitis. Dogs that have had pancreatitis before should avoid fatty foods.
why.sl: Mastni obrok je znan sprožilec vnetja trebušne slinavke pri psih. Posledice segajo od blagih prebavnih težav do hudega, celo življenjsko nevarnega vnetja. Psi, ki so vnetje trebušne slinavke že preboleli, naj se mastni hrani izogibajo.

en: Vomiting, sometimes starting 1–4 days after the fatty meal
Tummy pain (a dog may stretch into a 'prayer' position)
sl: Bruhanje, včasih šele 1–4 dni po mastnem obroku
Bolečine v trebuhu (pes se lahko raztegne v »molitveni« položaj)

what_to_do.en: If your dog ate a lot of fatty food, or shows vomiting, tummy pain or tiredness in the following days, contact your vet. Note what was eaten and roughly how much. Signs of pancreatitis can be delayed by a few days.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes pojedel veliko mastne hrane ali v naslednjih dneh bruha, ga boli trebuh ali je utrujen, pokličite veterinarja. Zapišite si, kaj in približno koliko je pojedel. Znaki vnetja trebušne slinavke se lahko pokažejo z nekajdnevno zamudo.

serving.en: If you share meat, choose plain, lean, cooked meat without skin, fat or seasoning, and no bones.
serving.sl: Če delite meso, izberite navadno, pusto, kuhano meso brez kože, maščobe in začimb ter brez kosti.

child.en: Fatty bits of meat can give dogs a sore tummy. Leave the fat on your plate and give your dog its own food.
child.sl: Mastni koščki mesa lahko psu povzročijo boleč trebušček. Maščobo pusti na krožniku, psu pa daj njegovo hrano.

q.en: What is pancreatitis?
q.sl: Kaj je vnetje trebušne slinavke?

a.en: An inflammation of the pancreas that causes vomiting, nausea and pain. In dogs it can be triggered by a fatty meal.
a.sl: Vnetje trebušne slinavke povzroča bruhanje, slabost in bolečine. Pri psih ga lahko sproži mastni obrok.

q.en: Is turkey skin okay at Christmas?
q.sl: Je puranja kožica za praznike v redu?

a.en: No. Turkey skin and other fatty table foods can cause anything from stomach upset to severe pancreatitis.
a.sl: Ne. Puranja kožica in druga mastna hrana z mize lahko povzroči vse od prebavnih težav do hudega vnetja trebušne slinavke.

answer.en: No. Garlic is toxic to dogs and is about 3 to 5 times more toxic than onion. Raw, cooked, dried and powdered garlic can all damage red blood cells and cause anaemia. Signs often appear only a few days after eating it.
answer.sl: Ne. Česen je za pse strupen, in sicer približno 3- do 5-krat bolj kot čebula. Surov, kuhan, posušen in česen v prahu lahko poškodujejo rdeče krvničke in povzročijo slabokrvnost. Znaki se pogosto pokažejo šele nekaj dni po zaužitju.

why.en: It belongs to the allium family (onion, garlic, leek, chives), which is toxic to dogs. These plants contain compounds that damage red blood cells and can lead to anaemia. All parts and all forms are harmful: raw, cooked, dried and powdered. Stomach upset can happen with any amount; larger amounts damage the blood.
why.sl: Spada v družino lukov (čebula, česen, por, drobnjak), ki je za pse strupena. Te rastline vsebujejo snovi, ki poškodujejo rdeče krvničke in lahko povzročijo slabokrvnost. Škodljivi so vsi deli in vse oblike: surove, kuhane, posušene in v prahu. Prebavne težave se lahko pojavijo pri vsaki količini, večje količine pa poškodujejo kri.

en: Tummy upset, even after small amounts
Signs of anaemia (damaged red blood cells), usually a few days later
sl: Prebavne težave, tudi po majhnih količinah
Znaki slabokrvnosti (poškodovane rdeče krvničke), običajno po nekaj dneh

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away. Note what was eaten (garlic) and roughly how much. Don't wait for signs: damage to the blood usually shows only a few days later.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Zapišite si, kaj je pes pojedel (česen) in približno koliko. Ne čakajte na znake: okvara krvi se običajno pokaže šele po nekaj dneh.

child.en: Garlic smells strong and tastes good to people, but it is not for dogs. Tell a grown-up if your dog eats some.
child.sl: Česen ljudem diši in tekne, a ni za pse. Povej odraslemu, če ga pes poje.

q.en: Is garlic worse than onion?
q.sl: Je česen hujši od čebule?

a.en: Yes. Garlic is described as about 3 to 5 times more toxic to dogs than onion.
a.sl: Da. Česen je za pse opisan kot približno 3- do 5-krat bolj strupen od čebule.

q.en: Is it safe when cooked or as powder?
q.sl: Je varno, če je kuhano ali v prahu?

a.en: No. Raw, cooked, dried, powdered and liquid forms are all poisonous to dogs.
a.sl: Ne. Za pse so strupene surove, kuhane, posušene, praškaste in tekoče oblike.

q.en: Why don't signs show straight away?
q.sl: Zakaj se znaki ne pokažejo takoj?

a.en: Symptoms can start within 24 hours but more often take a few days to appear; signs of anaemia typically develop several days after eating.
a.sl: Znaki se lahko pojavijo v 24 urah, pogosteje pa šele po nekaj dneh; znaki slabokrvnosti se običajno razvijejo nekaj dni po zaužitju.

answer.en: No. Dogs should never eat grapes. Grapes can cause kidney failure in dogs, and even a small amount can make a dog seriously ill. There is no way to predict which dogs will be affected, so any grape is a reason to call the vet.
answer.sl: Ne. Psi ne smejo nikoli jesti grozdja. Grozdje lahko pri psih povzroči odpoved ledvic, že majhna količina pa lahko psu resno škodi. Ni mogoče napovedati, kateri psi bodo prizadeti, zato je vsaka pojedena jagoda razlog za klic veterinarju.

why.en: Grapes, raisins and currants can damage a dog's kidneys. Tartaric acid is suspected to be the toxic part, and its amount varies between grapes, so the effect is unpredictable. Because the cause is still uncertain, vets treat any amount as a concern. Dogs that survive kidney injury may be left with long-term kidney disease.
why.sl: Grozdje, rozine in korinte lahko poškodujejo pasje ledvice. Za strupeno sestavino velja vinska kislina, katere količina se med grozdji razlikuje, zato je učinek nepredvidljiv. Ker vzrok še ni povsem pojasnjen, veterinarji vsako količino jemljejo resno. Psi, ki preživijo poškodbo ledvic, imajo lahko trajno bolezen ledvic.

en: Vomiting or diarrhoea, often within 6–24 hours
sl: Bruhanje ali driska, pogosto v 6–24 urah

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away, even if your dog ate only one or two grapes. Note how many were eaten and when. Don't wait for signs: the sooner a dog is treated, the better the outlook.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali, tudi če je pes pojedel le eno ali dve jagodi. Zapišite si, koliko jih je pojedel in kdaj. Ne čakajte na znake: prej ko je pes zdravljen, boljši so obeti.

child.en: Grapes are not for dogs, not even one. They can hurt a dog's kidneys. If your dog eats one, tell a grown-up right away.
child.sl: Grozdje ni za pse, niti ena jagoda. Psu lahko škodi ledvicam. Če ga pes poje, takoj povej odraslemu.

q.en: Is one grape dangerous for a dog?
q.sl: Je ena jagoda grozdja za psa nevarna?

a.en: It can be. Nobody can predict which dogs will react, so any grape eaten is a reason to contact your vet.
a.sl: Lahko je. Nihče ne more napovedati, kateri psi se bodo odzvali, zato je vsaka pojedena jagoda razlog za klic veterinarju.

q.en: Are green and red grapes equally risky?
q.sl: Sta zeleno in rdeče grozdje enako tvegana?

a.en: Sources warn against all grapes, raisins and currants. The amount of the suspected toxin varies between grapes, so no kind is considered safe.
a.sl: Viri svarijo pred vsem grozdjem, rozinami in korintami. Količina domnevnega strupa se med grozdji razlikuje, zato nobena vrsta ne velja za varno.

answer.en: Not recommended. Ham isn't toxic to dogs, but it is high in fat and sodium. Store-bought ham contains a lot of salt, and too much fat can lead to pancreatitis and other digestive upsets. A healthier dog treat is the better choice.
answer.sl: Ni priporočljivo. Šunka za pse ni strupena, vsebuje pa veliko maščob in natrija. Kupljena šunka je zelo slana, preveč maščobe pa lahko vodi v vnetje trebušne slinavke in druge prebavne težave. Bolje je izbrati bolj zdrav pasji priboljšek.

why.en: Ham has a higher fat content than many other meats, and fatty meals are a known trigger of pancreatitis. Most ham is also very salty, and excess salt can be harmful to dogs.
why.sl: Šunka vsebuje več maščob kot številne druge vrste mesa, mastni obroki pa so znan sprožilec vnetja trebušne slinavke. Večina šunke je tudi zelo slana, presežek soli pa lahko psom škoduje.

en: Vomiting, sometimes starting 1–4 days after the fatty meal
Tummy pain (a dog may stretch into a 'prayer' position)
sl: Bruhanje, včasih šele 1–4 dni po mastnem obroku
Bolečine v trebuhu (pes se lahko raztegne v »molitveni« položaj)

what_to_do.en: If your dog ate a lot of fatty food, or shows vomiting, tummy pain or tiredness in the following days, contact your vet. Note what was eaten and roughly how much. Signs of pancreatitis can be delayed by a few days.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes pojedel veliko mastne hrane ali v naslednjih dneh bruha, ga boli trebuh ali je utrujen, pokličite veterinarja. Zapišite si, kaj in približno koliko je pojedel. Znaki vnetja trebušne slinavke se lahko pokažejo z nekajdnevno zamudo.

child.en: Ham is a people food that is too salty and fatty for dogs. Save it for your sandwich and give your dog a dog treat.
child.sl: Šunka je hrana za ljudi in je za pse preslana in premastna. Prihrani jo za svoj sendvič, psu pa daj pasji priboljšek.

q.en: Why is ham worse than other meat?
q.sl: Zakaj je šunka slabša od drugega mesa?

a.en: It has more fat than many meats and store-bought ham contains a great deal of sodium.
a.sl: Vsebuje več maščob kot številne vrste mesa, kupljena šunka pa ima veliko natrija.

answer.en: No, it is best not to. Hazelnuts aren't toxic, but their very hard shells can cause choking and blockages, and like other nuts they are high in fat, which can upset a dog's stomach and may lead to pancreatitis.
answer.sl: Ne, bolje ne. Lešniki niso strupeni, a njihove zelo trde lupine lahko povzročijo dušenje in zamašitev, kot drugi oreščki pa so zelo mastni, kar lahko psu razdraži prebavo in morda vodi do vnetja trebušne slinavke.

why.en: Hazelnut shells are extremely hard and can cause choking and gut blockages. Nuts in general are high in fat and calories: they can be too rich for a dog, cause pancreatitis and add to weight gain. Nuts left lying on the ground can also grow mould that can be toxic to dogs.
why.sl: Lupine lešnikov so izjemno trde in lahko povzročijo dušenje ter zamašitev črevesja. Oreščki so na splošno zelo mastni in kalorični: za psa so lahko pretežki, povzročijo vnetje trebušne slinavke in prispevajo k debelosti. Na oreščkih, ki ležijo na tleh, lahko zraste tudi plesen, ki je za pse lahko strupena.

en: Tummy upset or signs of a blockage

what_to_do.en: After a nut or two, watch for vomiting, diarrhoea or belly pain. Call your vet if your dog swallowed shells, ate a lot of nuts or nuts that were mouldy, seems to be choking, or shows any of these signs.
what_to_do.sl: Po enem ali dveh oreščkih opazujte, ali pes bruha, ima drisko ali ga boli trebuh. Pokličite veterinarja, če je pes pogoltnil lupine, pojedel veliko ali plesnivih oreščkov, se duši ali kaže katerega od teh znakov.

child.en: Hazelnuts are a people snack. Their hard shells can get stuck in a dog, so keep them away from your pet.
child.sl: Lešniki so prigrizek za ljudi. Trde lupine se lahko psu zataknejo, zato jih drži stran od ljubljenčka.

q.en: Are hazelnuts toxic to dogs?
q.sl: So lešniki za pse strupeni?

a.en: No, they aren't toxic; the main risks are the hard shells and the high fat content.
a.sl: Ne, niso strupeni; glavni tveganji sta trde lupine in veliko maščobe.

answer.en: No, it is best not to. Ice cream is full of lactose, fat and sugar, which can upset a dog's tummy, and some flavours contain chocolate or the sweetener xylitol, which are toxic to dogs.
answer.sl: Ne, bolje ne. Sladoled je poln laktoze, maščobe in sladkorja, ki lahko psu razdražijo prebavo, nekateri okusi pa vsebujejo čokolado ali sladilo ksilitol, ki sta za pse strupena.

why.en: Many adult dogs are lactose intolerant to some degree and cannot digest milk products properly. High-fat dairy can cause pancreatitis, and the sugar adds to weight gain. Even 'sugar-free' ice cream may contain xylitol, and chocolate flavours are toxic.
why.sl: Mnogi odrasli psi do neke mere ne prenašajo laktoze in mlečnih izdelkov ne prebavijo dobro. Zelo mastni mlečni izdelki lahko povzročijo vnetje trebušne slinavke, sladkor pa prispeva k debelosti. Tudi sladoled »brez sladkorja« lahko vsebuje ksilitol, čokoladni okusi pa so strupeni.

en: Belly pain, nausea or low energy (possible pancreatitis)
sl: Boleč trebuh, slabost ali utrujenost (možno vnetje trebušne slinavke)

what_to_do.en: A lick of plain vanilla ice cream usually only needs watching for tummy upset. If the ice cream contained chocolate or xylitol, contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away, note what and how much was eaten, and don't wait for signs.
what_to_do.sl: Pri polizku navadnega vanilijevega sladoleda običajno zadošča opazovanje prebave. Če je sladoled vseboval čokolado ali ksilitol, takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali, zapišite, kaj in koliko je pes pojedel, in ne čakajte na znake.

serving.en: Instead of ice cream: a little frozen plain fat-free yogurt, if your dog tolerates it.
serving.sl: Namesto sladoleda: malo zamrznjenega navadnega posnetega jogurta, če ga pes prenaša.

child.en: Ice cream is a people treat. It can give dogs a sore tummy, so keep your cone to yourself.
child.sl: Sladoled je posladek za ljudi. Psa lahko boli trebušček, zato kornet obdrži zase.

q.en: Is sugar-free ice cream safer?
q.sl: Je sladoled brez sladkorja varnejši?

a.en: No. Sugar-free products may contain xylitol, which is toxic to dogs, so always read the label.
a.sl: Ne. Izdelki brez sladkorja lahko vsebujejo ksilitol, ki je za pse strupen, zato vedno preberite etiketo.

answer.en: Yes, a little plain cooked lamb meat with no bones is fine for a healthy dog without a food allergy. Never give cooked lamb bones, which become brittle and splinter, and avoid fatty or salty pieces and onion gravy.
answer.sl: Da, malo navadnega kuhanega jagnječjega mesa brez kosti je za zdravega psa brez alergije na hrano v redu. Nikoli ne dajte kuhanih jagnječjih kosti, ki postanejo krhke in se razcepijo, ter se izogibajte mastnim ali slanim koščkom in omaki s čebulo.

why.en: Lamb meat itself is listed as safe for dogs in small amounts. All bones become brittle when cooked and can splinter. High-fat foods can trigger vomiting, diarrhoea or even pancreatitis, and foods high in fat or salt are best avoided. Onion-based gravies are not safe for dogs.
why.sl: Samo jagnječje meso je navedeno kot varno za pse v majhnih količinah. Vse kosti s kuhanjem postanejo krhke in se lahko razcepijo. Mastna hrana lahko sproži bruhanje, drisko ali celo vnetje trebušne slinavke, hrani z veliko maščobe ali soli pa se je bolje izogniti. Omake s čebulo za pse niso varne.

what_to_do.en: If your dog ate fatty lamb scraps, watch for vomiting, diarrhoea or belly pain and call your vet if they appear. If it ate cooked bones or lamb with onion gravy, call your vet straight away and don't try to make your dog sick.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes pojedel mastne ostanke jagnjetine, opazujte, ali bruha, ima drisko ali ga boli trebuh, in pokličite veterinarja, če se to pojavi. Če je pojedel kuhane kosti ali jagnjetino z omako s čebulo, takoj pokličite veterinarja in ne poskušajte izzvati bruhanja.

serving.en: A little plain cooked lamb meat, no bones, no fatty or salty bits, no gravy.
serving.sl: Malo navadnega kuhanega jagnječjega mesa, brez kosti, brez mastnih ali slanih koščkov, brez omake.

child.en: A small bit of plain lamb with no bones can be a treat. Lamb bones are never for dogs.
child.sl: Majhen košček navadne jagnjetine brez kosti je lahko priboljšek. Jagnječje kosti nikoli niso za pse.

q.en: Can dogs have a lamb bone to chew?
