q.sl: Ali lahko pes gloda jagnječjo kost?

a.en: Not a cooked one: cooked bones become brittle and can splinter. Never give cooked bones of any kind.
a.sl: Kuhane ne: kuhane kosti postanejo krhke in se lahko razcepijo. Nikoli ne dajte kuhanih kosti kakršne koli vrste.

answer.en: No. Leek is an allium, like onion and garlic, and it is toxic to dogs. All parts of the plant are harmful, even when cooked or dried. It can damage red blood cells, and signs often take a few days to appear.
answer.sl: Ne. Por je luk, tako kot čebula in česen, in je za pse strupen. Škodljivi so vsi deli rastline, tudi kuhani ali posušeni. Lahko poškoduje rdeče krvničke, znaki pa se pogosto pokažejo šele po nekaj dneh.

why.en: It belongs to the allium family (onion, garlic, leek, chives), which is toxic to dogs. These plants contain compounds that damage red blood cells and can lead to anaemia. All parts and all forms are harmful: raw, cooked, dried and powdered. Stomach upset can happen with any amount; larger amounts damage the blood.
why.sl: Spada v družino lukov (čebula, česen, por, drobnjak), ki je za pse strupena. Te rastline vsebujejo snovi, ki poškodujejo rdeče krvničke in lahko povzročijo slabokrvnost. Škodljivi so vsi deli in vse oblike: surove, kuhane, posušene in v prahu. Prebavne težave se lahko pojavijo pri vsaki količini, večje količine pa poškodujejo kri.

en: Tummy upset, even after small amounts
Signs of anaemia (damaged red blood cells), usually a few days later
sl: Prebavne težave, tudi po majhnih količinah
Znaki slabokrvnosti (poškodovane rdeče krvničke), običajno po nekaj dneh

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away. Note what was eaten (leek) and roughly how much. Don't wait for signs: damage to the blood usually shows only a few days later.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Zapišite si, kaj je pes pojedel (por) in približno koliko. Ne čakajte na znake: okvara krvi se običajno pokaže šele po nekaj dneh.

child.en: Leeks belong to the onion family, so they are not for dogs. Tell a grown-up if your dog eats some.
child.sl: Por spada v družino čebule, zato ni za pse. Povej odraslemu, če ga pes poje.

q.en: Is leek as dangerous as onion?
q.sl: Je por tako nevaren kot čebula?

a.en: Garlic and onion are the most common causes of poisoning, but leek belongs to the same toxic plant family and should be treated the same way.
a.sl: Česen in čebula najpogosteje povzročita zastrupitev, a por spada v isto strupeno družino rastlin, zato z njim ravnajte enako.

q.en: Is it safe when cooked or as powder?
q.sl: Je varno, če je kuhano ali v prahu?

a.en: No. Raw, cooked, dried, powdered and liquid forms are all poisonous to dogs.
a.sl: Ne. Za pse so strupene surove, kuhane, posušene, praškaste in tekoče oblike.

answer.en: Not as a regular food, and not raw. Vitamin A poisoning in pets most often happens when they are fed raw liver or vitamin A-rich supplements, and raw liver carries the germ risks of all raw meat. Ask your vet before adding liver to your dog's diet.
answer.sl: Ne kot redna hrana in ne surova. Zastrupitev z vitaminom A se pri hišnih živalih najpogosteje zgodi pri hranjenju s surovimi jetri ali dodatki, bogatimi z vitaminom A, surova jetra pa nosijo tudi tveganje klic kot vse surovo meso. Preden psu dodate jetra v prehrano, vprašajte veterinarja.

why.en: Vitamin A poisoning most often happens when pets are fed raw liver, cod liver oil or other vitamin A-rich supplements. Too much over weeks or months can lead to a poor coat and dry skin; a large amount at once can cause vomiting, drowsiness and irritability. Raw animal protein can also carry Salmonella and other bacteria.
why.sl: Zastrupitev z vitaminom A se najpogosteje zgodi, ko živali hranimo s surovimi jetri, z oljem iz trskinih jeter ali drugimi dodatki, bogatimi z vitaminom A. Preveč tedne ali mesece lahko vodi do slabe dlake in suhe kože; velika količina naenkrat lahko povzroči bruhanje, zaspanost in razdražljivost. Surove živalske beljakovine lahko prenašajo tudi salmonelo in druge bakterije.

en: Vomiting, drowsiness or irritability after a large amount
Poor, dry coat or skin after weeks or months
sl: Bruhanje, zaspanost ali razdražljivost po veliki količini
Slaba, suha dlaka ali koža po tednih ali mesecih

what_to_do.en: If your dog ate a large amount of liver at once, or has been fed liver often and has a poor coat or dry skin, call your vet. A balanced commercial diet or a vet-formulated home diet avoids the problem.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes naenkrat pojedel veliko jeter ali jih je pogosto dobival in ima slabo dlako ali suho kožo, pokličite veterinarja. Uravnotežena komercialna hrana ali domača prehrana, ki jo sestavi veterinar, težavo prepreči.

child.en: Too much liver is not good for dogs. A grown-up and the vet decide if a dog gets liver.
child.sl: Preveč jeter psom ne koristi. Odrasel in veterinar odločita, ali pes dobi jetra.

q.en: Why is too much liver a problem?
q.sl: Zakaj je preveč jeter težava?

a.en: Vitamin A poisoning in pets most often happens when they are fed raw liver, cod liver oil or other vitamin A-rich supplements.
a.sl: Zastrupitev z vitaminom A se pri živalih najpogosteje zgodi, ko jih hranimo s surovimi jetri, z oljem iz trskinih jeter ali drugimi dodatki, bogatimi z vitaminom A.

question.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo makadamijine oreščke?

answer.en: No. Macadamia nuts are toxic to dogs, and dogs are the only species known to get ill from them. Even a small amount can cause weakness, vomiting, trembling and a high temperature. Their high fat content can also trigger pancreatitis.
answer.sl: Ne. Makadamijini oreščki so za pse strupeni; psi so edina znana vrsta, ki po njih zboli. Že majhna količina lahko povzroči šibkost, bruhanje, tresenje in povišano telesno temperaturo. Zaradi veliko maščob lahko sprožijo tudi vnetje trebušne slinavke.

why.en: How macadamia nuts poison dogs is unknown, but they affect nerve and muscle function. Because they are very oily, some dogs also develop pancreatitis. Signs generally settle within 12–48 hours, but a vet should always be contacted.
why.sl: Kako makadamijini oreščki zastrupijo psa, ni znano, vplivajo pa na delovanje živcev in mišic. Ker so zelo mastni, pri nekaterih psih povzročijo tudi vnetje trebušne slinavke. Znaki običajno izzvenijo v 12–48 urah, a veterinarja je treba vedno poklicati.

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away. Note how many nuts were eaten, and whether they were coated in chocolate or mixed with other foods. Don't wait for signs.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Zapišite si, koliko oreščkov je pes pojedel in ali so bili obliti s čokolado ali pomešani z drugo hrano. Ne čakajte na znake.

child.en: Macadamia nuts are round nuts that can make dogs weak and wobbly. Keep them away and tell a grown-up if your dog eats some.
child.sl: Makadamijini oreščki so okrogli oreščki, po katerih je pes lahko šibek in se opoteka. Pospravi jih in povej odraslemu, če jih pes poje.

q.en: Are other nuts toxic too?
q.sl: So strupeni tudi drugi oreščki?

a.en: Macadamias are the toxic ones. Other nuts such as almonds, pecans and walnuts are very fatty and can cause vomiting, diarrhoea and possibly pancreatitis, so they are not a good treat either.
a.sl: Strupeni so makadamijini. Drugi oreščki, kot so mandlji, pekan in orehi, so zelo mastni in lahko povzročijo bruhanje, drisko in morda vnetje trebušne slinavke, zato tudi niso dober priboljšek.

q.en: How long do signs last?
q.sl: Kako dolgo trajajo znaki?

a.en: Signs generally resolve within 12–48 hours, but your vet should still be told straight away.
a.sl: Znaki običajno izzvenijo v 12–48 urah, a veterinarja vseeno obvestite takoj.

answer.en: Yes, but only a little. Milk is a safe treat in small quantities, but many dogs are lactose intolerant and get diarrhoea, gas or vomiting from it. Milk is also high in fat and natural sugars.
answer.sl: Da, a le malo. Mleko je v majhnih količinah varen priboljšek, a veliko psov ne prenaša laktoze in po njem dobijo drisko, vetrove ali bruhajo. Mleko vsebuje tudi veliko maščob in naravnih sladkorjev.

why.en: Dogs have little lactase, the enzyme that digests the sugar in milk, so milk and dairy often cause diarrhoea or other digestive upset. Individual dogs differ in how well they tolerate dairy.
why.sl: Psi imajo malo laktaze, encima, ki prebavlja mlečni sladkor, zato mleko in mlečni izdelki pogosto povzročijo drisko ali druge prebavne težave. Psi se razlikujejo v tem, kako dobro prenašajo mlečne izdelke.

what_to_do.en: If your dog gets loose stools, gas, vomiting or tummy pain after milk, stop giving it. Contact your vet if you are worried.
what_to_do.sl: Če ima pes po mleku mehko blato, vetrove, bruha ali ga boli trebuh, mu mleka ne dajajte več. Če vas skrbi, pokličite veterinarja.

serving.en: Only a small amount of plain milk now and then, and none if your dog's tummy reacts.
serving.sl: Le občasno malo navadnega mleka, če pa se pasji trebuh odzove, nič.

child.en: Some dogs get a tummy ache from milk, so only a little, and only if a grown-up says yes.
child.sl: Nekatere pse po mleku boli trebušček, zato le malo in le, če odrasli dovoli.

q.en: Why do some dogs get diarrhoea from milk?
q.sl: Zakaj nekateri psi po mleku dobijo drisko?

a.en: Many dogs are lactose intolerant: they don't have much lactase, the enzyme that digests milk sugar.
a.sl: Veliko psov ne prenaša laktoze: nimajo dovolj laktaze, encima, ki prebavlja mlečni sladkor.

answer.en: No. Onion is toxic to dogs in every form: raw, cooked, dried or powdered. It damages red blood cells and can cause anaemia, with signs often appearing only days later. Powders and soup mixes count too.
answer.sl: Ne. Čebula je za pse strupena v vseh oblikah: surova, kuhana, posušena ali v prahu. Poškoduje rdeče krvničke in lahko povzroči slabokrvnost, znaki pa se pogosto pokažejo šele po nekaj dneh. Štejejo tudi praški in mešanice za juhe.

why.en: It belongs to the allium family (onion, garlic, leek, chives), which is toxic to dogs. These plants contain compounds that damage red blood cells and can lead to anaemia. All parts and all forms are harmful: raw, cooked, dried and powdered. Stomach upset can happen with any amount; larger amounts damage the blood.
why.sl: Spada v družino lukov (čebula, česen, por, drobnjak), ki je za pse strupena. Te rastline vsebujejo snovi, ki poškodujejo rdeče krvničke in lahko povzročijo slabokrvnost. Škodljivi so vsi deli in vse oblike: surove, kuhane, posušene in v prahu. Prebavne težave se lahko pojavijo pri vsaki količini, večje količine pa poškodujejo kri.

en: Tummy upset, even after small amounts
Signs of anaemia (damaged red blood cells), usually a few days later
sl: Prebavne težave, tudi po majhnih količinah
Znaki slabokrvnosti (poškodovane rdeče krvničke), običajno po nekaj dneh

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away. Note what was eaten (onion) and roughly how much. Don't wait for signs: damage to the blood usually shows only a few days later.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Zapišite si, kaj je pes pojedel (čebula) in približno koliko. Ne čakajte na znake: okvara krvi se običajno pokaže šele po nekaj dneh.

child.en: Onions are not for dogs, even cooked ones in food. They can make a dog's blood sick. Tell a grown-up if your dog eats some.
child.sl: Čebula ni za pse, tudi kuhana v hrani ne. Psu lahko poškoduje kri. Povej odraslemu, če jo pes poje.

q.en: Is it safe when cooked or as powder?
q.sl: Je varno, če je kuhano ali v prahu?

a.en: No. Raw, cooked, dried, powdered and liquid forms are all poisonous to dogs.
a.sl: Ne. Za pse so strupene surove, kuhane, posušene, praškaste in tekoče oblike.

q.en: Why don't signs show straight away?
q.sl: Zakaj se znaki ne pokažejo takoj?

a.en: Symptoms can start within 24 hours but more often take a few days to appear; signs of anaemia typically develop several days after eating.
a.sl: Znaki se lahko pojavijo v 24 urah, pogosteje pa šele po nekaj dneh; znaki slabokrvnosti se običajno razvijejo nekaj dni po zaužitju.

answer.en: Not recommended. Some vets allow fresh peach flesh in small cubes with the stem and pit removed, but the pit is a real danger: it can cause choking or a gut blockage and contains a form of cyanide.
answer.sl: Ni priporočljivo. Nekateri veterinarji dovolijo sveže meso breskve v majhnih kockah brez peclja in koščice, koščica pa je resna nevarnost: lahko povzroči zadušitev ali zaporo prebavil in vsebuje obliko cianida.

why.en: Peach stems, leaves and seeds contain cyanogenic glycosides. If a pit is thoroughly chewed, cyanide can be released, and a swallowed pit may block the gut, especially in small dogs. Canned or dried peaches often contain extra sugar. Because the plant is listed as toxic to dogs, we rate peaches as not recommended rather than a safe treat.
why.sl: Peclji, listi in semena breskve vsebujejo cianogene glikozide. Če pes koščico temeljito prežveči, se lahko sprosti cianid, pogoltnjena koščica pa lahko zamaši prebavila, zlasti pri majhnih psih. Breskve iz konzerve ali posušene pogosto vsebujejo dodan sladkor. Ker je rastlina navedena kot strupena za pse, breskve uvrščamo med odsvetovane in ne med varne priboljške.

en: Signs of a blockage: repeated vomiting, not eating, tiredness
Dilated pupils, brick-red gums, difficulty breathing (cyanide)
sl: Znaki zapore: ponavljajoče se bruhanje, pes noče jesti, utrujenost
Razširjene zenice, opečnato rdeče dlesni, težko dihanje (cianid)

what_to_do.en: If your dog swallowed or chewed a peach pit, contact your vet for advice right away. Note when it happened and how many pits were eaten.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes pogoltnil ali prežvečil koščico breskve, se takoj posvetujte z veterinarjem. Zapišite si, kdaj se je to zgodilo in koliko koščic je pojedel.

serving.en: Fresh flesh only, in small cubes, with the stem and pit removed. Skip canned and dried peaches.
serving.sl: Samo sveže meso, v majhnih kockah, brez peclja in koščice. Breskev iz konzerve in posušenih ne dajajte.

child.en: Peach stones are dangerous for dogs. Never give your dog a peach stone, and ask a grown-up before sharing any peach.
child.sl: Koščice breskev so za pse nevarne. Psu nikoli ne daj koščice in vprašaj odraslega, preden deliš breskev.

q.en: Are canned peaches okay?
q.sl: So breskve iz konzerve v redu?

a.en: They are not recommended, because canned or dried peaches often contain extra sugar and other ingredients.
a.sl: Niso priporočljive, ker breskve iz konzerve ali posušene pogosto vsebujejo dodan sladkor in druge sestavine.

q.en: Why is the pit so risky?
q.sl: Zakaj je koščica tako tvegana?

a.en: It is a choking hazard, can block the intestines, and its seed contains cyanide-releasing compounds.
a.sl: Lahko povzroči zadušitev, zamaši črevesje, njeno seme pa vsebuje snovi, ki sproščajo cianid.

question.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo arašidovo maslo?

answer.en: Yes, in small amounts, if it contains no xylitol. Most peanut butter is safe for dogs, but some brands use xylitol, a sweetener that is toxic to dogs, so always check the label. Unsalted peanut butter is best.
answer.sl: Da, v majhnih količinah, če ne vsebuje ksilitola. Večina arašidovega masla je za pse varna, a nekatere znamke uporabljajo ksilitol, sladilo, ki je za pse strupeno, zato vedno preverite etiketo. Najboljše je nesoljeno arašidovo maslo.

why.en: Peanut butter is rich in fat and can be high in salt, so it suits only as an occasional treat, and it is not ideal for dogs on a diet. The real danger is xylitol: some peanut and nut butters contain it, and in dogs it can cause a sharp drop in blood sugar.
why.sl: Arašidovo maslo je bogato z maščobo in je lahko zelo slano, zato je primerno le kot občasen priboljšek in ni idealno za pse na dieti. Prava nevarnost je ksilitol: vsebujejo ga nekatera arašidova in druga oreščkova masla, pri psih pa lahko povzroči močan padec krvnega sladkorja.

what_to_do.en: If the peanut butter contained xylitol, contact your vet, an emergency clinic or a pet poison helpline right away, note how much was eaten, and don't wait for signs.
what_to_do.sl: Če je arašidovo maslo vsebovalo ksilitol, takoj pokličite veterinarja, dežurno kliniko ali center za zastrupitve živali, zapišite, koliko je pes pojedel, in ne čakajte na znake.

serving.en: A small amount of unsalted peanut butter whose label lists no xylitol; as a treat, not a daily food.
serving.sl: Malo nesoljenega arašidovega masla, na etiketi katerega ni ksilitola; kot priboljšek, ne vsak dan.

child.en: Many dogs love a little peanut butter! A grown-up must check the jar first, because some kinds are not safe for dogs.
child.sl: Mnogi psi obožujejo malo arašidovega masla! Odrasel mora najprej preveriti kozarec, ker nekatere vrste za pse niso varne.

q.en: How do I know if peanut butter has xylitol?
q.sl: Kako vem, ali arašidovo maslo vsebuje ksilitol?

a.en: Read the ingredients on the label, especially on products marked sugar-free or low sugar.
a.sl: Preberite sestavine na etiketi, posebej pri izdelkih z oznako brez sladkorja ali z malo sladkorja.

q.en: Can I use peanut butter to give my dog a pill?
q.sl: Ali lahko psu z arašidovim maslom dam tableto?

a.en: Many people do; the FDA advises checking the label first to make sure it doesn't contain xylitol.
a.sl: Mnogi to počnejo; FDA svetuje, da najprej preverite etiketo, ali ne vsebuje ksilitola.

answer.en: Yes, a few plain peanuts now and then: unsalted, unflavoured, dry-roasted or raw, with the shells removed. Salted, honey-roasted or flavoured peanuts are not suitable, and peanuts are fatty, so keep it to a few.
answer.sl: Da, občasno nekaj navadnih arašidov: nesoljenih, brez okusov, suho praženih ali surovih, brez lupin. Soljeni, medeni ali začinjeni arašidi niso primerni, arašidi pa so mastni, zato naj jih bo le nekaj.

why.en: Peanuts are high in fat, which can cause digestive upset and even pancreatitis if a dog eats too much. Salted peanuts add sodium a dog doesn't need, flavoured ones add other risky ingredients, and the fibrous shell can be a choking hazard, especially for small breeds.
why.sl: Arašidi so zelo mastni, kar lahko pri preveliki količini povzroči prebavne težave in celo vnetje trebušne slinavke. Soljeni arašidi vsebujejo več natrija, kot ga pes potrebuje, začinjeni še druge tvegane sestavine, vlaknata lupina pa lahko povzroči dušenje, posebej pri majhnih pasmah.

what_to_do.en: If your dog ate a lot of peanuts, salted peanuts or shells, watch for vomiting, diarrhoea or belly pain, and call your vet if these appear or your dog seems to be choking.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes pojedel veliko arašidov, soljene arašide ali lupine, opazujte, ali bruha, ima drisko ali ga boli trebuh, in pokličite veterinarja, če se to pojavi ali če se pes duši.

serving.en: Only a few, plain: dry-roasted or raw, unsalted, unseasoned, uncoated, shells removed — not every day.
serving.sl: Le nekaj, navadnih: suho praženih ali surovih, nesoljenih, nezačinjenih, brez obloge in brez lupin — ne vsak dan.

child.en: A dog may have a few plain peanuts without shells. Salty or sweet peanuts are only for people.
child.sl: Pes lahko dobi nekaj navadnih arašidov brez lupin. Slani ali sladki arašidi so samo za ljudi.

q.en: Are honey-roasted peanuts OK?
q.sl: So medeni arašidi v redu?

a.en: No. Honey-roasted and other flavoured peanuts are unsafe for dogs; only plain, unsalted peanuts are suitable.
a.sl: Ne. Medeni in drugi začinjeni arašidi za pse niso varni; primerni so le navadni, nesoljeni arašidi.

question.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo pekan orehe?

answer.en: No. Pecans aren't good for dogs: even a small number can make a dog very sick. They contain juglone, can carry toxic mould, are fatty, and their hard shells can cause choking or blockages. Call your vet if your dog eats any.
answer.sl: Ne. Pekan orehi za pse niso dobri: že majhno število lahko psu zelo škodi. Vsebujejo juglon, na njih je lahko strupena plesen, so mastni, njihove trde lupine pa lahko povzročijo dušenje ali zamašitev. Če jih pes poje, pokličite veterinarja.

why.en: Pecans contain juglone, which can cause digestive problems, and they are very prone to moulds that produce mycotoxins such as aflatoxin, which can cause serious illness, including neurological problems. Their fat raises the risk of pancreatitis, and the hard shells can block the gut. Sources range from 'not good' to 'can make very sick'; we use the stricter level.
why.sl: Pekan orehi vsebujejo juglon, ki lahko povzroči prebavne težave, in so zelo dovzetni za plesni, ki tvorijo mikotoksine, kot je aflatoksin, ta pa lahko povzroči resno bolezen, tudi živčne težave. Maščoba povečuje tveganje za vnetje trebušne slinavke, trde lupine pa lahko zamašijo črevesje. Viri segajo od »niso dobri« do »lahko zelo škodijo«; izbrali smo strožjo stopnjo.

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet right away, even if your dog ate only a few pecans. Note how many were eaten and whether they were old or mouldy, and don't wait for signs.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja, tudi če je pes pojedel le nekaj pekan orehov. Zapišite, koliko jih je pojedel in ali so bili stari ali plesnivi, ter ne čakajte na znake.

child.en: Pecans are not for dogs. If a dog eats some, tell a grown-up straight away so they can call the vet.
child.sl: Pekan orehi niso za pse. Če jih pes poje, takoj povej odraslemu, da pokliče veterinarja.

q.en: Why are pecans riskier than some other nuts?
q.sl: Zakaj so pekan orehi bolj tvegani od nekaterih drugih oreščkov?

a.en: Every part of the pecan contains juglone, and pecans easily grow mould that produces mycotoxins.
a.sl: Vsi deli pekan oreha vsebujejo juglon, na pekan orehih pa zlahka zraste plesen, ki tvori mikotoksine.

answer.en: No, it is best to avoid them. Pistachios are not toxic in themselves, but they are fatty and usually salty, can upset the stomach or lead to pancreatitis, and nuts or shells can cause choking. They can also grow harmful mould.
answer.sl: Ne, bolje se jim je izogniti. Pistacije same po sebi niso strupene, so pa mastne in običajno slane, lahko razdražijo prebavo ali vodijo do vnetja trebušne slinavke, oreščki ali lupine pa lahko povzročijo dušenje. Na njih lahko zraste tudi škodljiva plesen.

why.en: Pistachios are high in fat and salt, which can cause stomach problems, and fatty, salty snacks can lead to pancreatitis. Even shelled nuts can be a choking hazard. Mould on nut shells can produce aflatoxin, which can make dogs weak and lethargic, upset the stomach and even cause seizures.
why.sl: Pistacije vsebujejo veliko maščobe in soli, kar lahko povzroči prebavne težave, mastni in slani prigrizki pa lahko vodijo do vnetja trebušne slinavke. Tudi oluščeni oreščki lahko povzročijo dušenje. Plesen na lupinah lahko tvori aflatoksin, ki psa lahko oslabi in utrudi, mu razdraži prebavo in celo povzroči krče.

en: Belly pain, nausea or low energy (possible pancreatitis)
sl: Boleč trebuh, slabost ali utrujenost (možno vnetje trebušne slinavke)

what_to_do.en: If your dog ate a few pistachios, watch for vomiting, diarrhoea or belly pain. Call your vet if your dog ate a lot of them or their shells, seems to be choking, or shows weakness, tiredness or any of these signs.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes pojedel nekaj pistacij, opazujte, ali bruha, ima drisko ali ga boli trebuh. Pokličite veterinarja, če jih je pojedel veliko ali z lupinami, se duši ali je šibek, utrujen ali kaže katerega od teh znakov.

child.en: Pistachios and their shells are not for dogs. They can upset a dog's tummy, so keep the bowl up high.
child.sl: Pistacije in njihove lupine niso za pse. Psa lahko boli trebušček, zato skledico postavi visoko.

q.en: Are pistachio shells dangerous?
q.sl: So lupine pistacij nevarne?

a.en: Yes. Pistachios and their shells can get lodged in a dog's throat, and mould can grow on nut shells.
a.sl: Da. Pistacije in njihove lupine se lahko zataknejo v grlu, na lupinah pa lahko raste plesen.

answer.en: Not recommended. A little plum flesh with the pit removed is not the main worry, but plum pits are toxic to dogs and can cause choking or an intestinal blockage. The stems, leaves and seeds of the plum plant contain cyanide.
answer.sl: Ni priporočljivo. Malo mesa slive brez koščice ni glavna skrb, koščice sliv pa so za pse strupene in lahko povzročijo zadušitev ali zaporo črevesja. Peclji, listi in semena slive vsebujejo cianid.

why.en: The plum plant is listed as toxic to dogs because its stems, leaves and seeds contain cyanogenic glycosides. A pit can also be swallowed and get stuck. Some vets allow plum flesh as an occasional treat with the pit removed; because the plant itself is listed as toxic, we use the stricter rating. Prunes are even higher in sugar.
why.sl: Sliva je navedena kot strupena za pse, ker njeni peclji, listi in semena vsebujejo cianogene glikozide. Pes lahko koščico tudi pogoltne in ta se zatakne. Nekateri veterinarji dovolijo meso slive kot občasen priboljšek brez koščice; ker je rastlina navedena kot strupena, uporabljamo strožjo oceno. Suhe slive imajo še več sladkorja.

en: Signs of a blockage: repeated vomiting, not eating, tiredness
Dilated pupils, brick-red gums, difficulty breathing (cyanide)
sl: Znaki zapore: ponavljajoče se bruhanje, pes noče jesti, utrujenost
Razširjene zenice, opečnato rdeče dlesni, težko dihanje (cianid)

what_to_do.en: If your dog ate a plum pit, contact your vet right away. Note when it happened and how many pits were eaten.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes pojedel koščico slive, takoj pokličite veterinarja. Zapišite si, kdaj se je to zgodilo in koliko koščic je pojedel.

serving.en: If you share any, give only a little fresh flesh with the pit and stem removed. Skip prunes. Check with your vet first.
serving.sl: Če jo delite, dajte le malo svežega mesa brez koščice in peclja. Suhih sliv ne dajajte. Najprej se posvetujte z veterinarjem.

child.en: Plum stones are bad for dogs. Never give your dog a plum stone, and ask a grown-up before sharing any plum.
child.sl: Koščice sliv so za pse slabe. Psu nikoli ne daj koščice in vprašaj odraslega, preden deliš slivo.

q.en: Are prunes okay for dogs?
q.sl: So suhe slive za pse v redu?

a.en: Prunes are even higher in sugar than fresh plums, so they are not a great option for dogs.
a.sl: Suhe slive imajo še več sladkorja kot sveže, zato za pse niso dobra izbira.

answer.en: Not as a regular treat. Some vet sources allow a little plain, fully cooked lean pork, but pork is fatty and hard for dogs to digest, and fatty foods can trigger pancreatitis. Raw pork, cooked bones, ham and bacon are not suitable.
answer.sl: Ne kot reden priboljšek. Nekateri veterinarski viri dovolijo malo navadne, popolnoma kuhane puste svinjine, a svinjina je mastna in jo psi težko prebavijo, mastna hrana pa lahko sproži vnetje trebušne slinavke. Surova svinjina, kuhane kosti, šunka in slanina niso primerne.

why.en: Pork is rich in a type of fat that is difficult for dogs to digest. Raw or undercooked pork can carry the parasite Trichinella. Cooked bones become brittle, and seasonings can be dangerous. Ham is high in salt and fat. Sources differ: the AKC calls plain cooked lean pork safe in moderation, while PDSA lists pork among high-fat foods that can lead to pancreatitis and advises dogs that have had it to avoid high-fat treats like pork, so we use the stricter level.
why.sl: Svinjina vsebuje vrsto maščobe, ki jo psi težko prebavijo. Surova ali premalo kuhana svinjina lahko prenaša zajedavca trihinelo. Kuhane kosti postanejo krhke, začimbe pa so lahko nevarne. Šunka vsebuje veliko soli in maščobe. Viri se razlikujejo: AKC navadno kuhano pusto svinjino v zmernih količinah označuje kot varno, PDSA pa svinjino navaja med mastno hrano, ki lahko sproži vnetje trebušne slinavke, psom, ki so ga že imeli, pa svetuje, naj se izogibajo mastnim priboljškom, kot je svinjina, zato smo izbrali strožjo stopnjo.

en: Vomiting, sometimes starting 1–4 days after a fatty meal
sl: Bruhanje, ki se lahko začne 1–4 dni po mastnem obroku

what_to_do.en: If your dog ate fatty or seasoned pork, watch for vomiting, diarrhoea or belly pain over the next few days and call your vet as soon as possible if they appear. If it ate raw pork, cooked bones or food with onion or garlic, call your vet straight away.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes pojedel mastno ali začinjeno svinjino, v naslednjih dneh opazujte, ali bruha, ima drisko ali ga boli trebuh, in čim prej pokličite veterinarja, če se to pojavi. Če je pojedel surovo svinjino, kuhane kosti ali hrano s čebulo ali česnom, takoj pokličite veterinarja.

serving.en: If you share at all: a small piece of plain, fully cooked lean pork, fat trimmed, boneless, unseasoned.
serving.sl: Če jo sploh daste: majhen košček navadne, popolnoma kuhane puste svinjine, brez maščobe, kosti in začimb.

child.en: Pork is very fatty for a dog's tummy. Only a grown-up should decide if a dog gets a tiny plain piece.
child.sl: Svinjina je za pasji trebušček zelo mastna. Samo odrasel naj odloči, ali pes dobi droben navaden košček.

q.en: Can dogs eat ham or bacon?
q.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo šunko ali slanino?

a.en: They aren't good choices: ham is high in fat and sodium, and eating a lot of bacon can cause pancreatitis.
a.sl: Nista dobri izbiri: šunka vsebuje veliko maščobe in natrija, veliko slanine pa lahko povzroči vnetje trebušne slinavke.

answer.en: No. Raisins are dried grapes, and dogs should never eat them. They can cause kidney failure, and even a small amount can make a dog seriously ill. There is no way to predict which dogs will be affected.
answer.sl: Ne. Rozine so posušeno grozdje in psi jih ne smejo nikoli jesti. Lahko povzročijo odpoved ledvic, že majhna količina pa lahko psu resno škodi. Ni mogoče napovedati, kateri psi bodo prizadeti.

why.en: Raisins, grapes and currants can damage a dog's kidneys. Tartaric acid is suspected to be the toxic part; its amount varies, so effects are unpredictable, and there is no way to tell which dogs are more sensitive. Because the cause is uncertain, any amount is treated as a concern.
why.sl: Rozine, grozdje in korinte lahko poškodujejo pasje ledvice. Za strupeno sestavino velja vinska kislina; njena količina se razlikuje, zato so učinki nepredvidljivi, in ni mogoče vedeti, kateri psi so bolj občutljivi. Ker vzrok ni pojasnjen, se vsaka količina jemlje resno.

en: Vomiting or diarrhoea, often within 6–24 hours
sl: Bruhanje ali driska, pogosto v 6–24 urah

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away, even if only a few raisins were eaten. Note roughly how many were eaten. Don't wait for signs: the sooner treatment starts, the better.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali, tudi če je pes pojedel le nekaj rozin. Zapišite si, približno koliko jih je pojedel. Ne čakajte na znake: prej ko se zdravljenje začne, bolje je.

child.en: Raisins are tiny dried grapes, and they are not for dogs. If your dog eats some, tell a grown-up right away.
child.sl: Rozine so majhno posušeno grozdje in niso za pse. Če jih pes poje, takoj povej odraslemu.

q.en: Are raisins worse than grapes?
q.sl: So rozine slabše od grozdja?

a.en: Both are dangerous. Sources treat grapes, raisins and currants as the same risk and advise calling the vet after any amount.
a.sl: Oboje je nevarno. Viri grozdje, rozine in korinte obravnavajo kot enako tveganje in svetujejo klic veterinarju po kateri koli količini.

q.en: What about currants?
q.sl: Kaj pa korinte?

a.en: Currants are named in the same warnings as grapes and raisins, so they are not safe for dogs either.
a.sl: Korinte so navedene v istih opozorilih kot grozdje in rozine, zato tudi one za pse niso varne.

question.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo surove kosti?

answer.en: Only after talking to your vet. Cooked bones splinter, but raw bones carry risks too: they can break teeth, cause choking or block the gut, and raw meat on them may carry bacteria such as Salmonella. Some vets allow them under supervision; others advise against bones.
answer.sl: Le po posvetu z veterinarjem. Kuhane kosti se cepijo, a tudi surove kosti so tvegane: lahko zlomijo zob, povzročijo dušenje ali zamašijo prebavila, surovo meso na njih pa lahko prenaša bakterije, kot je salmonela. Nekateri veterinarji jih dovolijo pod nadzorom, drugi kosti odsvetujejo.

why.en: Sources differ, so we use the stricter level. The FDA lists blockages, choking and mouth injuries after bones and advises asking your vet about safer chews. AKC notes raw bones may carry Salmonella and very hard bones can damage teeth. Bones can injure or block the gut, and blockages are very serious.
why.sl: Viri se razlikujejo, zato uporabljamo strožjo stopnjo. FDA navaja zapore, dušenje in poškodbe ust po kosteh ter svetuje posvet z veterinarjem o varnejših grizalih. AKC opozarja, da surove kosti lahko prenašajo salmonelo in da pretrde kosti lahko poškodujejo zobe. Kosti lahko poškodujejo ali zamašijo prebavila, zapore pa so zelo resne.

en: Cuts or bleeding in the mouth

what_to_do.en: If your dog swallowed a large piece of bone, or shows any of these signs, contact your vet right away. Note the kind and size of the bone.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes pogoltnil velik kos kosti ali kaže katerega od teh znakov, takoj pokličite veterinarja. Zapišite si, kakšna in kako velika je bila kost.

serving.en: Ask your vet first. If they agree, choose a bone larger than your dog's muzzle so it can't be swallowed whole, avoid very hard bones, and always supervise chewing.
serving.sl: Najprej vprašajte veterinarja. Če se strinja, izberite kost, večjo od dolžine pasjega gobca, da je ne more pogoltniti cele, izogibajte se pretrdim kostem in grizenje vedno nadzorujte.

child.en: Bones can hurt a dog's teeth and tummy. Only grown-ups and the vet decide if a dog gets a bone, and someone always watches.
child.sl: Kosti lahko poškodujejo pasje zobe in trebušček. O kosti odločajo le odrasli in veterinar, med grizenjem pa vedno nekdo pazi.

q.en: Are raw bones safer than cooked ones?
q.sl: So surove kosti varnejše od kuhanih?

a.en: Cooked bones splinter, which is why they should never be given. Raw bones still carry risks of broken teeth, blockages and bacteria, so ask your vet first.
a.sl: Kuhane kosti se cepijo, zato jih nikoli ne dajajte. Tudi surove kosti nosijo tveganje zlomljenih zob, zapor in bakterij, zato najprej vprašajte veterinarja.

q.en: What size bone is safer?
q.sl: Kako velika kost je varnejša?

a.en: A bone should be larger than the length of the dog's muzzle so it can't be swallowed whole, and you should check on your dog while it chews.
a.sl: Kost naj bo večja od dolžine pasjega gobca, da je pes ne more pogoltniti cele, med grizenjem pa psa preverjajte.

question.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo surova jajca?

answer.en: No, it is best not to. Raw eggs can carry bacteria such as Salmonella, which can harm dogs and the people around them, and raw egg white can interfere with a vitamin. Cook eggs fully before sharing them.
answer.sl: Ne, bolje ne. Surova jajca lahko prenašajo bakterije, kot je salmonela, ki lahko škodijo psu in ljudem okoli njega, surovi beljak pa lahko ovira vsrkavanje enega od vitaminov. Jajca pred deljenjem s psom popolnoma skuhajte.

why.en: Raw eggs can contain Salmonella and E. coli, harmful to pets and people alike. Raw egg white contains avidin, which blocks the vitamin biotin; deficiency is rare, but it can affect skin and coat. Most vets recommend cooking eggs fully before giving them to a dog.
why.sl: Surova jajca lahko vsebujejo salmonelo in E. coli, ki škodita tako živalim kot ljudem. Surovi beljak vsebuje avidin, ki ovira vitamin biotin; pomanjkanje je redko, lahko pa vpliva na kožo in dlako. Večina veterinarjev svetuje, da jajca pred hranjenjem psa popolnoma skuhamo.

what_to_do.en: If your dog licked up a raw egg, watch for vomiting, diarrhoea or low energy over the next days and call your vet if vomiting or diarrhoea is severe or doesn't stop. Wash your hands and clean up well.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes polizal surovo jajce, v naslednjih dneh opazujte, ali bruha, ima drisko ali je utrujen, in pokličite veterinarja, če sta bruhanje ali driska huda ali ne prenehata. Umijte si roke in dobro počistite.

serving.en: Cook the egg fully (hard-boiled or scrambled), plain, without oil, butter, salt or seasonings.
serving.sl: Jajce popolnoma skuhajte (trdo kuhano ali umešano), navadno, brez olja, masla, soli in začimb.

child.en: Dogs should only have eggs that are cooked. Raw eggs can carry germs that make dogs and people poorly.
child.sl: Psi naj jedo samo kuhana jajca. Surova jajca lahko prenašajo klice, ki škodijo psom in ljudem.

q.en: Isn't raw egg good for a shiny coat?
q.sl: Ali surovo jajce ni dobro za sijočo dlako?

a.en: Not reliably: raw egg white can block biotin absorption, which can lead to skin and coat problems.
a.sl: Ne nujno: surovi beljak lahko ovira vsrkavanje biotina, kar lahko vodi do težav s kožo in dlako.

question.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo surove ribe?

answer.en: It is not recommended. Raw fish can carry bacteria such as Salmonella and Listeria, as well as parasites, and its small bones are a hazard. In the Pacific Northwest of the USA, raw salmon or trout can cause salmon poisoning disease. Cook fish plain and remove the bones.
answer.sl: Ni priporočljivo. Surove ribe lahko prenašajo bakterije, kot sta salmonela in listerija, pa tudi zajedavce, njihove drobne kosti pa so nevarne. Na pacifiškem severozahodu ZDA lahko surov losos ali postrv povzroči bolezen »zastrupitev z lososom«. Ribe skuhajte brez dodatkov in odstranite kosti.

why.en: Raw fish is among the foods linked to food poisoning in dogs. Raw or undercooked salmon and trout from the Pacific Northwest can carry a parasite that causes salmon poisoning disease, which is serious if untreated. Fish bones are small and brittle and can cause choking or injure the mouth or gut. Raw and smoked fish are best avoided.
why.sl: Surove ribe sodijo med živila, povezana z zastrupitvijo s hrano pri psih. Surov ali premalo kuhan losos in postrv s pacifiškega severozahoda lahko prenašata zajedavca, ki povzroči bolezen »zastrupitev z lososom«, ki je brez zdravljenja resna. Ribje kosti so drobne in krhke ter lahko povzročijo dušenje ali poškodujejo usta ali prebavila. Surovim in dimljenim ribam se je bolje izogniti.

en: High fever, weakness and complete loss of appetite (salmon poisoning)
sl: Visoka vročina, šibkost in popolna izguba apetita (zastrupitev z lososom)

what_to_do.en: Watch for vomiting, diarrhoea or low energy and call your vet if they are severe or don't stop. If your dog ate raw salmon or trout from the Pacific Northwest, call your vet promptly and mention it — signs can take up to a week to appear.
what_to_do.sl: Opazujte, ali pes bruha, ima drisko ali je utrujen, in pokličite veterinarja, če so težave hude ali ne prenehajo. Če je pes pojedel surovega lososa ali postrv s pacifiškega severozahoda ZDA, hitro pokličite veterinarja in mu to povejte — znaki se lahko pojavijo šele v tednu dni.

serving.en: Only fully cooked fish (baked, steamed or grilled), plain, with all bones removed.
serving.sl: Samo popolnoma kuhane ribe (pečene, kuhane na pari ali na žaru), brez dodatkov in brez vseh kosti.

child.en: Fish for dogs must be cooked and have no bones. Raw fish can have germs that upset a dog's tummy.
child.sl: Riba za psa mora biti kuhana in brez kosti. Surova riba ima lahko klice, ki psu razdražijo trebušček.

q.en: What is salmon poisoning disease?
q.sl: Kaj je bolezen »zastrupitev z lososom«?

a.en: An illness dogs get from eating raw or undercooked salmon, trout or similar fish from the Pacific Northwest of the USA; it is prevented by not feeding them raw.
a.sl: Bolezen, ki jo psi dobijo, če pojedo surovega ali premalo kuhanega lososa, postrv ali podobne ribe s pacifiškega severozahoda ZDA; preprečimo jo tako, da jih ne hranimo s surovimi.

question.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo surovo meso?

answer.en: It is not recommended. Raw meat often carries bacteria such as Salmonella, Listeria and E. coli, which can make dogs ill and spread to people in the home, even when the dog looks healthy. Veterinary bodies such as the AVMA discourage raw feeding.
answer.sl: Ni priporočljivo. Surovo meso pogosto prenaša bakterije, kot so salmonela, listerija in E. coli, ki lahko psu škodijo in se prenesejo na ljudi v domu, tudi če je pes videti zdrav. Veterinarske organizacije, kot je AVMA, odsvetujejo hranjenje s surovim.

why.en: Contamination of raw meat by bacteria is common. Dogs can carry these germs without signs and shed them in saliva and faeces, putting family members at risk, especially high-risk groups such as the young and the old. Raw pork can carry a parasite, raw bones can block the gut, and home-made raw diets are likely not balanced unless a nutritionist formulated the recipe.
why.sl: Surovo meso je pogosto okuženo z bakterijami. Psi lahko te klice nosijo brez znakov in jih izločajo s slino in iztrebki, kar ogroža družinske člane, posebej skupine z večjim tveganjem, kot so otroci in starejši. Surova svinjina lahko prenaša zajedavca, surove kosti lahko zamašijo črevesje, doma pripravljeni surovi obroki pa verjetno niso uravnoteženi, če recepta ni sestavil strokovnjak za prehrano.

what_to_do.en: If your dog grabbed some raw meat, watch for vomiting, diarrhoea or low energy and call your vet if these are severe or don't stop. Wash your hands, bowls and surfaces thoroughly. Talk to your vet before changing your dog's diet.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes zgrabil kos surovega mesa, opazujte, ali bruha, ima drisko ali je utrujen, in pokličite veterinarja, če so težave hude ali ne prenehajo. Temeljito umijte roke, sklede in površine. Pred spremembo prehrane se posvetujte z veterinarjem.

serving.en: Share meat only fully cooked, plain and boneless.
serving.sl: Meso delite samo popolnoma kuhano, navadno in brez kosti.

child.en: Raw meat can have germs. Dogs should only get cooked meat from people food, and everyone washes hands after touching raw meat.
child.sl: Surovo meso ima lahko klice. Psi naj od človeške hrane dobijo samo kuhano meso, po dotiku surovega mesa pa si vsi umijemo roke.

q.en: My dog seems fine on raw food. Is there still a risk?
q.sl: Pes se s surovo hrano zdi v redu. Ali tveganje še obstaja?

a.en: Yes. Apparently healthy dogs can carry these bacteria and shed them, which can harm people in the home.
a.sl: Da. Navidez zdravi psi lahko te bakterije nosijo in izločajo, kar lahko škodi ljudem v domu.

q.en: Is freeze-dried raw food safer?
q.sl: Je zamrznjeno sušena surova hrana varnejša?

a.en: Not for germs: freeze-drying is not equivalent to cooking when it comes to bacteria and parasites.
a.sl: Glede klic ne: zamrzovalno sušenje ni enakovredno kuhanju, kar zadeva bakterije in zajedavce.

question.en: Can dogs eat raw yeast dough?
question.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo surovo kvašeno testo?

answer.en: No. Raw, unbaked yeast dough is dangerous for dogs. It keeps rising in the warm stomach, causing bloating that can lead to a twisted stomach. The yeast also makes alcohol, which can cause alcohol poisoning. The danger is the unbaked dough.
answer.sl: Ne. Surovo, nepečeno kvašeno testo je za pse nevarno. V toplem želodcu še naprej vzhaja in povzroči napihnjenje, ki lahko vodi v zasuk želodca. Kvas tvori tudi alkohol, ki lahko povzroči zastrupitev z alkoholom. Nevarno je nepečeno testo.

why.en: Yeast keeps working in the warm, moist stomach: the dough expands and gas builds up, which can block the gut or, less often, twist the stomach (bloat). At the same time the yeast produces alcohol, which is quickly absorbed into the blood. Dogs are affected most often because they eat whatever they find.
why.sl: Kvas v toplem in vlažnem želodcu deluje naprej: testo se širi in nabirajo se plini, kar lahko zamaši prebavila ali, redkeje, zasuka želodec. Hkrati kvas tvori alkohol, ki se hitro vsrka v kri. Psi so najpogosteje prizadeti, ker pojedo, kar najdejo.

en: Vomiting or retching without bringing anything up
sl: Bruhanje ali siljenje na bruhanje brez izbljuvka

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet right away. Note roughly how much dough was eaten and when. Don't wait for signs: a swelling stomach and alcohol poisoning both need prompt care.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja. Zapišite si, približno koliko testa je pes pojedel in kdaj. Ne čakajte na znake: napihnjen želodec in zastrupitev z alkoholom zahtevata hitro pomoč.

child.en: Bread dough that is still rising is not for dogs. It keeps growing in their tummy. Tell a grown-up if your dog eats some.
child.sl: Testo, ki še vzhaja, ni za pse. V trebuščku še naprej raste. Povej odraslemu, če ga pes poje.

q.en: Is baked bread dangerous too?
q.sl: Je nevaren tudi pečen kruh?

a.en: The danger described here is raw, unbaked yeast dough, because the yeast is still alive and keeps working in the stomach.
a.sl: Nevarnost, opisana tukaj, velja za surovo, nepečeno kvašeno testo, ker je kvas še živ in v želodcu deluje naprej.

q.en: Why does dough cause alcohol poisoning?
q.sl: Zakaj testo povzroči zastrupitev z alkoholom?

a.en: Fermenting yeast produces alcohol in the stomach, and it is rapidly absorbed into the bloodstream.
a.sl: Kvas pri vrenju v želodcu tvori alkohol, ki se hitro vsrka v kri.

answer.en: Yes, if it is fully cooked, plain and boneless. Cooked salmon is a good source of protein and omega-3 fats. Raw or undercooked salmon is not safe, and smoked salmon is too salty, so keep those away from your dog.
answer.sl: Da, če je popolnoma kuhan, brez dodatkov in brez kosti. Kuhan losos je dober vir beljakovin in omega-3 maščob. Surov ali premalo kuhan losos ni varen, dimljen losos pa je preslan, zato ju psu ne dajajte.

why.en: Raw salmon can carry parasites and bacteria; in the Pacific Northwest of the USA it can cause salmon poisoning disease, which is serious if untreated. Salmon has small, brittle bones that can cause choking. Smoked salmon and lox are high in salt. Seasonings, oils and sauces don't belong on a dog's portion.
why.sl: Surov losos lahko prenaša zajedavce in bakterije; na pacifiškem severozahodu ZDA lahko povzroči bolezen »zastrupitev z lososom«, ki je brez zdravljenja resna. Losos ima drobne, krhke kosti, ki lahko povzročijo dušenje. Dimljen losos vsebuje veliko soli. Začimbe, olja in omake ne sodijo na pasji obrok.

what_to_do.en: If your dog ate raw salmon, especially from the Pacific Northwest of the USA, call your vet and mention it; watch for fever, weakness, loss of appetite, vomiting or diarrhoea. If your dog swallowed bones and is choking, call your vet straight away.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes pojedel surovega lososa, posebej s pacifiškega severozahoda ZDA, pokličite veterinarja in mu to povejte; opazujte, ali se pojavijo vročina, šibkost, izguba apetita, bruhanje ali driska. Če je pes pogoltnil kosti in se duši, takoj pokličite veterinarja.

serving.en: Fully cooked (baked, steamed or grilled), plain, no seasoning, oils or sauces, boneless fillet; never raw or smoked.
serving.sl: Popolnoma kuhan (pečen, na pari ali na žaru), brez začimb, olj in omak, file brez kosti; nikoli surov ali dimljen.

child.en: Cooked salmon without bones can be a healthy treat for a dog. Raw or smoked salmon is not for dogs.
child.sl: Kuhan losos brez kosti je lahko za psa zdrav priboljšek. Surov ali dimljen losos ni za pse.

q.en: Can dogs eat smoked salmon?
q.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo dimljen losos?

a.en: It isn't a good choice: smoked salmon and lox are high in salt.
a.sl: Ni dobra izbira: dimljen losos in loks vsebujeta veliko soli.

q.en: Is salmon in dog food safe?
q.sl: Je losos v pasji hrani varen?

a.en: Salmon in commercial diets is typically safe because it is cooked.
a.sl: Losos v komercialni pasji hrani je običajno varen, ker je kuhan.

answer.en: No, not in large amounts. Salty food in moderation should not cause salt poisoning, but eating a lot of salt, for example from homemade salt dough, play dough or lots of sea water, can. Signs include vomiting, strong thirst, tremors and seizures.
answer.sl: Ne v velikih količinah. Slana hrana v zmernih količinah naj ne bi povzročila zastrupitve s soljo, veliko soli, na primer iz domačega slanega testa, plastelina ali veliko morske vode, pa jo lahko. Znaki so bruhanje, huda žeja, tresenje in krči.

why.en: Common causes of salt poisoning are homemade salt-dough ornaments and play dough, snow with salt de-icer, and drinking a lot of sea water. Salt poisoning is unlikely when a healthy dog has fresh water, but small dogs with health problems are at more risk if they have no fresh water. Salt must never be used to make a dog vomit.
why.sl: Pogosti vzroki zastrupitve s soljo so domači okraski iz slanega testa in plastelin, sneg s soljo za posipanje ter pitje veliko morske vode. Pri zdravem psu s svežo vodo je zastrupitev s soljo malo verjetna, večje tveganje pa imajo majhni psi z zdravstvenimi težavami, če nimajo sveže vode. Soli nikoli ne uporabljajte, da bi psa spravili k bruhanju.

en: Strong thirst and peeing a lot
Vomiting, often within a few hours

what_to_do.en: If your dog ate a lot of salt, salt dough or play dough, or drank a lot of sea water, contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away. Note what and how much was eaten. Don't wait for signs, and never give salt to make a dog vomit.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes pojedel veliko soli, slanega testa ali plastelina ali popil veliko morske vode, takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Zapišite si, kaj in koliko je pojedel. Ne čakajte na znake in psu nikoli ne dajajte soli, da bi bruhal.

child.en: Too much salt makes dogs very thirsty and ill. Keep salt and salty play dough away from your dog.
child.sl: Preveč soli psa zelo odžeja in mu škodi. Sol in slani plastelin pospravi stran od psa.

q.en: Is homemade play dough dangerous?
q.sl: Je domači plastelin nevaren?

a.en: Yes. Because of its high salt content, homemade play dough is highly toxic to dogs. Salt dough ornaments are a risk too.
a.sl: Da. Zaradi veliko soli je domači plastelin za pse zelo strupen. Tveganje so tudi okraski iz slanega testa.

q.en: Can I give salt water to make my dog vomit?
q.sl: Lahko psu dam slano vodo, da bruha?

a.en: No. Salt and salt water should never be used to make an animal vomit, because of the high risk of salt poisoning. Call your vet instead.
a.sl: Ne. Soli in slane vode nikoli ne uporabljajte, da bi žival bruhala, ker je tveganje zastrupitve s soljo veliko. Raje pokličite veterinarja.

question.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo slane prigrizke?

answer.en: Not recommended. A few salty snacks are unlikely to cause salt poisoning in a healthy dog with fresh water, but salty foods are generally not good for dogs, especially those with heart disease. Eating a lot can cause thirst, vomiting and worse.
answer.sl: Ni priporočljivo. Nekaj slanih prigrizkov pri zdravem psu s svežo vodo verjetno ne povzroči zastrupitve s soljo, a slana hrana psom na splošno ne koristi, zlasti tistim z boleznijo srca. Večja količina lahko povzroči žejo, bruhanje in hujše težave.

why.en: Salty food in moderation should not cause salt toxicity, but too much salt can lead to fluid retention and, in large amounts, salt poisoning. Small dogs with health issues are more at risk when fresh water isn't available. Dog foods are best served without added salt or seasoning.
why.sl: Slana hrana v zmernih količinah naj ne bi povzročila zastrupitve s soljo, preveč soli pa lahko vodi v zastajanje tekočine in pri velikih količinah v zastrupitev. Majhni psi z zdravstvenimi težavami so bolj ogroženi, kadar nimajo sveže vode. Hrano za pse je najbolje ponuditi brez dodane soli in začimb.

en: Strong thirst and peeing a lot
Vomiting, often within a few hours

what_to_do.en: If your dog ate a large amount of salty snacks, contact your vet or a pet poison helpline. Note what and how much was eaten. Fresh water should always be available.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes pojedel veliko slanih prigrizkov, pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Zapišite si, kaj in koliko je pojedel. Sveža voda naj bo vedno na voljo.

serving.en: Better not to share. If you give people food, serve it plain, without salt or seasoning.
serving.sl: Raje jih ne delite. Če psu daste človeško hrano, naj bo navadna, brez soli in začimb.

child.en: Salty snacks are for people. Too much salt makes dogs thirsty and sick, so give your dog its own treats.
child.sl: Slani prigrizki so za ljudi. Preveč soli psa odžeja in mu škodi, zato mu daj njegove priboljške.

q.en: Does my dog need water after salty food?
q.sl: Potrebuje pes po slani hrani vodo?

a.en: Yes. Fresh drinking water helps a dog flush out salt; salt poisoning is unlikely when fresh water is available.
a.sl: Da. Sveža pitna voda psu pomaga izplakniti sol; zastrupitev s soljo je malo verjetna, kadar ima pes svežo vodo.

answer.en: Yes, in moderation. Canned sardines packed in water, unsalted and unseasoned, are a suitable fish treat, and their tiny bones are soft and edible after canning. Fresh sardines must be fully cooked. Avoid salty, seasoned or raw fish.
answer.sl: Da, zmerno. Sardine v konzervi, vložene v vodi, nesoljene in nezačinjene, so primeren ribji priboljšek, njihove drobne kosti pa so po konzerviranju mehke in užitne. Sveže sardine morajo biti popolnoma kuhane. Izogibajte se slanim, začinjenim ali surovim ribam.

why.en: Plain, fully cooked fish provides protein and fatty acids. Cooking fully reduces the risk from parasites and bacteria. Canned sardines are the exception to the bones rule because their bones soften during canning; for other fish, bones must be removed. Canned fish should be unsalted and unseasoned.
why.sl: Navadne, popolnoma kuhane ribe dajejo beljakovine in maščobne kisline. Popolno kuhanje zmanjša tveganje zaradi zajedavcev in bakterij. Sardine v konzervi so izjema pri pravilu o kosteh, ker se kosti med konzerviranjem zmehčajo; pri drugih ribah je treba kosti odstraniti. Ribe v konzervi naj bodo nesoljene in nezačinjene.

what_to_do.en: If your dog ate salty or seasoned sardines or raw fish, watch for vomiting, diarrhoea or low energy and call your vet if these are severe or don't stop.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes pojedel slane ali začinjene sardine ali surove ribe, opazujte, ali bruha, ima drisko ali je utrujen, in pokličite veterinarja, če so težave hude ali ne prenehajo.

serving.en: Canned in water, unsalted and unseasoned; or fresh sardines fully cooked (steamed, baked or poached) and plain; in moderation.
serving.sl: V konzervi v vodi, nesoljene in nezačinjene; ali sveže, popolnoma kuhane (na pari, pečene ali poširane) in brez dodatkov; zmerno.

child.en: Sardines in water can be a fishy treat for a dog, now and then. Salty fish is not for dogs.
child.sl: Sardine v vodi so lahko za psa občasen ribji priboljšek. Slane ribe niso za pse.

q.en: Do I need to remove the bones from canned sardines?
q.sl: Ali moram sardinam v konzervi odstraniti kosti?

a.en: No. The tiny bones are soft and fully edible after canning, so sardines canned in water can be fed without deboning.
a.sl: Ne. Drobne kosti so po konzerviranju mehke in povsem užitne, zato lahko sardine v vodi daste brez odstranjevanja kosti.

answer.en: Yes, a few pieces of plain, fully cooked shrimp are fine for dogs. Remove the shell, head, legs and tail first. Raw shrimp can carry harmful germs, and fried, breaded or seasoned shrimp are not suitable.
answer.sl: Da, nekaj koščkov navadnih, popolnoma kuhanih kozic je za pse v redu. Najprej odstranite oklep, glavo, nožice in rep. Surove kozice lahko prenašajo škodljive klice, ocvrte, panirane ali začinjene kozice pa niso primerne.

why.en: Raw shellfish contain harmful pathogens that cooking avoids. Shrimp shells are a choking hazard and can cause blockages. Fried or breaded shrimp add unnecessary fats and oils. Shrimp are low in fat and calories but high in cholesterol, so moderation is key.
why.sl: Surovi raki in školjke vsebujejo škodljive klice, ki jih s kuhanjem odpravimo. Oklepi kozic lahko povzročijo dušenje in zamašitev. Ocvrte ali panirane kozice dodajo nepotrebne maščobe in olja. Kozice imajo malo maščob in kalorij, a veliko holesterola, zato je ključna zmernost.

what_to_do.en: Stop giving shrimp if your dog shows tummy discomfort or seems unwell, and call your vet if signs get worse. Also call your vet if your dog swallowed shells and seems to be choking.
what_to_do.sl: Prenehajte dajati kozice, če ima pes težave s trebuhom ali se ne počuti dobro, in pokličite veterinarja, če se znaki poslabšajo. Pokličite ga tudi, če je pes pogoltnil oklepe in se zdi, da se duši.

serving.en: A few pieces, fully cooked (steamed is best), plain, with shell, head, legs and tail removed; not fried, breaded or seasoned.
serving.sl: Nekaj koščkov, popolnoma kuhanih (najboljše na pari), brez dodatkov, brez oklepa, glave, nožic in repa; ne ocvrtih, paniranih ali začinjenih.

child.en: A dog may have a couple of cooked, peeled shrimp. The shells and tails are not for dogs.
child.sl: Pes lahko dobi nekaj kuhanih, olupljenih kozic. Oklepi in repki niso za pse.

q.en: Can dogs eat shrimp tails?
q.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo repke kozic?

a.en: No. Remove the shell, head, legs and tail, as shells are a choking hazard and can cause blockages.
a.sl: Ne. Odstranite oklep, glavo, nožice in rep, ker oklepi lahko povzročijo dušenje in zamašitev.

answer.en: No, caffeinated tea is not for dogs. Tea contains caffeine, which is toxic to dogs. A small taste is unlikely to harm, but larger amounts can be dangerous, especially for small dogs, and eaten tea bags can cause serious poisoning.
answer.sl: Ne, čaj s kofeinom ni za pse. Čaj vsebuje kofein, ki je za pse strupen. Majhen požirek verjetno ne škodi, večje količine pa so lahko nevarne, zlasti za majhne pse, pojedene čajne vrečke pa lahko povzročijo hudo zastrupitev.

why.en: Many teas contain caffeine, which overstimulates a dog's heart and nervous system. Dogs are more sensitive to caffeine than people. One or two licks of tea are unlikely to poison, but swallowed tea bags can cause serious toxicity.
why.sl: Številni čaji vsebujejo kofein, ki pretirano spodbuja pasje srce in živčevje. Psi so na kofein bolj občutljivi kot ljudje. Polizek ali dva čaja verjetno ne zastrupita, pogoltnjene čajne vrečke pa lahko povzročijo hudo zastrupitev.

sl: Nemir, pretirana živahnost, hoja sem in tja

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline as soon as you realise your dog has had caffeine. Note what it was (drink, grounds, beans, tea bags) and roughly how much. Don't wait for signs: early treatment matters.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj ko opazite, da je pes zaužil kofein, pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Zapišite si, kaj je bilo (pijača, mleta kava, zrna, čajne vrečke) in približno koliko. Ne čakajte na znake: zgodnje zdravljenje je pomembno.

child.en: Tea with caffeine is a people drink, not a dog drink. Give your dog fresh water instead.
child.sl: Čaj s kofeinom je pijača za ljudi, ne za pse. Psu raje daj svežo vodo.

q.en: My dog licked my cup. Is that an emergency?
q.sl: Pes je polizal mojo skodelico. Je to nujno?

a.en: One or two licks are unlikely to poison most dogs. If your dog drank more, or ate grounds, beans or tea bags, call your vet or a pet poison helpline.
a.sl: En ali dva polizka večine psov verjetno ne zastrupita. Če je pes popil več ali pojedel mleto kavo, zrna ali čajne vrečke, pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali.

q.en: What if my dog ate a tea bag?
q.sl: Kaj, če je pes pojedel čajno vrečko?

a.en: Tea bags can cause serious caffeine poisoning. Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away.
a.sl: Čajne vrečke lahko povzročijo hudo zastrupitev s kofeinom. Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali.

answer.en: Yes, occasionally and in small amounts. Tuna isn't toxic to dogs, but it is high in mercury, so it shouldn't be a regular food. Choose cooked tuna or 'light' (skipjack) canned tuna packed only in water, without added salt or oil.
answer.sl: Da, občasno in v majhnih količinah. Tuna za pse ni strupena, vsebuje pa veliko živega srebra, zato ne sme biti redna hrana. Izberite kuhano tuno ali svetlo tuno (črtasti tun) v konzervi, vloženo samo v vodi, brez dodane soli ali olja.

why.en: Tuna are large, long-lived fish, so their mercury levels are high, and dogs are more sensitive to mercury than people. Feeding tuna regularly can lead to mercury poisoning over time. Albacore, yellowfin and 'white' tuna carry more mercury than skipjack. Canned tuna often has added salt or oil, which isn't healthy for dogs.
why.sl: Tune so velike, dolgo živeče ribe, zato vsebujejo veliko živega srebra, psi pa so nanj bolj občutljivi kot ljudje. Redno hranjenje s tuno lahko sčasoma povzroči zastrupitev z živim srebrom. Beli tun, rumenoplavuti tun in »bela« tuna imajo več živega srebra kot črtasti tun. Tuna v konzervi ima pogosto dodano sol ali olje, kar za pse ni zdravo.

what_to_do.en: A stolen bite of tuna is nothing to panic about. If your dog has been eating tuna regularly and shows signs such as tremors, loss of coordination, vomiting blood or bloody diarrhoea, take them to the vet immediately.
what_to_do.sl: Ukraden grižljaj tune ni razlog za paniko. Če pes redno je tuno in se pojavijo znaki, kot so tresenje, slaba koordinacija, bruhanje krvi ali krvava driska, ga takoj odpeljite k veterinarju.

serving.en: Occasionally, a small amount of cooked tuna or 'light' (skipjack) canned tuna in water only, no salt or oil; avoid albacore, yellowfin and 'white' tuna.
serving.sl: Občasno malo kuhane tune ali svetle tune (črtasti tun) v konzervi samo v vodi, brez soli in olja; izogibajte se belemu in rumenoplavutemu tunu ter »beli« tuni.

child.en: A little tuna is a rare treat for a dog, not everyday food. Ask a grown-up to pick tuna in water.
child.sl: Malo tune je za psa redek priboljšek, ne vsakdanja hrana. Prosi odraslega, naj izbere tuno v vodi.

q.en: My dog stole some tuna. Should I worry?
q.sl: Pes je ukradel nekaj tune. Naj me skrbi?

a.en: Usually not: tuna isn't toxic, and the concern is regular feeding over time.
a.sl: Običajno ne: tuna ni strupena, skrb vzbuja redno hranjenje skozi daljši čas.

q.en: Which canned tuna is best?
q.sl: Katera tuna v konzervi je najboljša?

a.en: 'Light' or skipjack tuna packed only in water, given occasionally.
a.sl: Svetla tuna oziroma črtasti tun, vložen samo v vodi, občasno.

question.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo puranovo meso?

answer.en: Yes, a little plain cooked turkey meat is safe for most dogs. Remove the skin, excess fat and all bones first. Turkey cooked with seasoning, onion or garlic, and onion gravy or stuffing, are not for dogs.
answer.sl: Da, malo navadnega kuhanega puranovega mesa je za večino psov varno. Najprej odstranite kožo, odvečno maščobo in vse kosti. Puran, pripravljen z začimbami, čebulo ali česnom, ter omaka s čebulo ali nadev niso za pse.

why.en: Turkey isn't toxic, but how it is cooked matters. Skin and fat are rich and can cause pancreatitis, while extra seasonings can irritate a dog's stomach. Onions and garlic can be toxic to dogs. Cooked poultry bones are brittle and can splinter. White meat is leaner than dark meat.
why.sl: Puran ni strupen, pomembno pa je, kako je pripravljen. Koža in maščoba sta težki in lahko povzročita vnetje trebušne slinavke, začimbe pa lahko psu razdražijo želodec. Čebula in česen sta lahko za pse strupena. Kuhane perutninske kosti so krhke in se lahko razcepijo. Belo meso je bolj pusto od temnega.

what_to_do.en: If your dog ate turkey skin, fatty scraps or seasoned meat, watch for vomiting, diarrhoea or belly pain over the next few days and call your vet if they appear. If it ate bones or food with onion or garlic, call your vet straight away.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes pojedel puranovo kožo, mastne ostanke ali začinjeno meso, v naslednjih dneh opazujte, ali bruha, ima drisko ali ga boli trebuh, in pokličite veterinarja, če se to pojavi. Če je pojedel kosti ali hrano s čebulo ali česnom, takoj pokličite veterinarja.

serving.en: Plain cooked turkey meat, ideally white meat, with no skin, excess fat or bones, no seasoning; a small amount.
serving.sl: Navadno kuhano puranovo meso, najbolje belo, brez kože, odvečne maščobe in kosti, brez začimb; v majhni količini.

child.en: A little plain turkey with no skin or bones is a nice dog treat. Turkey bones are never for dogs.
child.sl: Malo navadnega purana brez kože in kosti je lep pasji priboljšek. Puranove kosti nikoli niso za pse.

q.en: Can I give my dog leftovers from a holiday turkey?
q.sl: Ali lahko psu dam ostanke prazničnega purana?

a.en: Only plain meat without skin or bones. Keep stuffing and onion-based gravy away from your dog.
a.sl: Le navadno meso brez kože in kosti. Nadev in omako s čebulo držite stran od psa.

answer.en: No, it is best not to. A walnut or two is unlikely to cause harm, but walnuts are fatty and can be a choking hazard. Mouldy walnuts, such as old ones fallen in the garden, and black walnuts are much more dangerous.
answer.sl: Ne, bolje ne. En ali dva oreha verjetno ne bosta škodovala, a orehi so mastni in pes se lahko z njimi zaduši. Plesnivi orehi, na primer stari, odpadli na vrtu, in črni orehi so precej bolj nevarni.

why.en: Walnuts are high in fat, which can cause vomiting, diarrhoea and possibly pancreatitis. Mould can grow on the shell or kernel and produce toxins that can cause tremors, seizures and vomiting. Black walnuts are very toxic to dogs and may contain juglone.
why.sl: Orehi so zelo mastni, kar lahko povzroči bruhanje, drisko in morda vnetje trebušne slinavke. Na lupini ali jedrcu lahko raste plesen, ki tvori strupe in lahko povzroči tresenje, krče in bruhanje. Črni orehi so za pse zelo strupeni in lahko vsebujejo juglon.

what_to_do.en: After a walnut or two, watch for vomiting or diarrhoea. If your dog ate a black walnut or mouldy walnuts, contact your vet right away and don't wait for signs; also call if tremors, seizures or choking appear.
what_to_do.sl: Po enem ali dveh orehih opazujte, ali pes bruha ali ima drisko. Če je pes pojedel črni oreh ali plesnive orehe, takoj pokličite veterinarja in ne čakajte na znake; pokličite tudi, če se pojavijo tresenje, krči ali dušenje.

child.en: Walnuts are not a dog snack. Old walnuts on the ground can make dogs sick, so tell a grown-up if your dog finds some.
child.sl: Orehi niso pasji prigrizek. Stari orehi na tleh lahko psu škodijo, zato povej odraslemu, če jih pes najde.

q.en: Why are fallen walnuts in the garden a risk?
q.sl: Zakaj so odpadli orehi na vrtu nevarni?

a.en: Nuts lying on the ground can get damp and grow mould, which can be toxic to dogs.
a.sl: Oreščki, ki ležijo na tleh, se navlažijo in na njih zraste plesen, ki je lahko za pse strupena.

q.en: What about black walnuts?
q.sl: Kaj pa črni orehi?

a.en: Black walnuts are very toxic to dogs. Contact your vet immediately if your dog eats one.
a.sl: Črni orehi so za pse zelo strupeni. Če ga pes poje, takoj pokličite veterinarja.

answer.en: No. Xylitol, a sugar-free sweetener, is toxic to dogs. Even small amounts can cause a dangerous drop in blood sugar, seizures and liver failure. It is found in sugar-free gum, sweets, baked goods, toothpaste and supplements.
answer.sl: Ne. Ksilitol, sladilo brez sladkorja, je za pse strupen. Že majhne količine lahko povzročijo nevaren padec krvnega sladkorja, krče in odpoved jeter. Najdemo ga v žvečilnih gumijih brez sladkorja, sladkarijah, pecivu, zobnih pastah in prehranskih dopolnilih.

why.en: In dogs, xylitol can cause a rapid, dangerous drop in blood sugar. Some dogs also develop severe liver injury; how this happens is not yet known. Sugar-free gum is the most common source, and the amount of xylitol can differ even between flavours of one brand.
why.sl: Pri psih ksilitol lahko povzroči hiter in nevaren padec krvnega sladkorja. Pri nekaterih psih pride tudi do hude okvare jeter; kako, še ni znano. Najpogostejši vir je žvečilni gumi brez sladkorja, količina ksilitola pa se lahko razlikuje celo med okusi iste znamke.

en: Signs of low blood sugar can start within 30 minutes
sl: Znaki nizkega krvnega sladkorja se lahko začnejo v 30 minutah

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline as soon as you realise your dog ate something with xylitol. Note the product and how much was eaten. Don't wait for signs, and don't give anything by mouth unless your vet tells you to.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj ko opazite, da je pes pojedel nekaj s ksilitolom, pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Zapišite si izdelek in koliko ga je pojedel. Ne čakajte na znake in psu ne dajajte ničesar v usta, razen če tako naroči veterinar.

child.en: Sugar-free gum can contain xylitol, which is very bad for dogs. Keep gum and toothpaste away, and tell a grown-up if your dog eats some.
child.sl: Žvečilni gumi brez sladkorja lahko vsebuje ksilitol, ki je za pse zelo slab. Gumi in zobno pasto pospravi ter povej odraslemu, če ju pes poje.

q.en: Where is xylitol found?
q.sl: Kje najdemo ksilitol?

a.en: In sugar-free gum, sweets, baked goods, toothpaste, vitamins and supplements. Sugar-free gum is the most common source of poisoning.
a.sl: V žvečilnih gumijih brez sladkorja, sladkarijah, pecivu, zobnih pastah, vitaminih in prehranskih dopolnilih. Najpogostejši vir zastrupitev je žvečilni gumi brez sladkorja.

q.en: Can I use human toothpaste for my dog?
q.sl: Lahko psu umivam zobe s človeško zobno pasto?

a.en: Some toothpastes contain xylitol, which is toxic to dogs, so human toothpaste is not a safe choice.
a.sl: Nekatere zobne paste vsebujejo ksilitol, ki je za pse strupen, zato človeška zobna pasta ni varna izbira.

answer.en: Yes, in small amounts, if it is plain and unsweetened and your dog tolerates dairy. Some dogs get tummy upset from lactose. Never give yogurt with xylitol or other sweeteners, or with added sugar.
answer.sl: Da, v majhnih količinah, če je navaden, nesladkan in ga pes prenaša. Nekaterim psom laktoza razdraži prebavo. Nikoli ne dajte jogurta s ksilitolom ali drugimi sladili ali z dodanim sladkorjem.

why.en: Many dogs have trouble digesting lactose, which can cause gas, diarrhoea or vomiting. Greek-style yogurt has less lactose, so it is usually the better choice. Some sweeteners, especially xylitol, are toxic to dogs, and too much dairy fat can upset the stomach or cause pancreatitis.
why.sl: Mnogi psi težko prebavljajo laktozo, kar lahko povzroči vetrove, drisko ali bruhanje. Grški jogurt ima manj laktoze, zato je običajno boljša izbira. Nekatera sladila, predvsem ksilitol, so za pse strupena, preveč mlečne maščobe pa lahko razdraži želodec ali povzroči vnetje trebušne slinavke.

what_to_do.en: Start with a small amount and watch for gas, diarrhoea or vomiting; stop if they appear. If the yogurt contained xylitol, contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away.
what_to_do.sl: Začnite z majhno količino in opazujte, ali se pojavijo vetrovi, driska ali bruhanje; če se, prenehajte. Če je jogurt vseboval ksilitol, takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali.

serving.en: Plain yogurt with no added sweeteners, ideally Greek-style; check the label for sugar and xylitol.
serving.sl: Navaden jogurt brez dodanih sladil, najbolje grški; na etiketi preverite sladkor in ksilitol.

child.en: A little plain yogurt can be a treat for some dogs. Sweet or flavoured yogurt is not for dogs.
child.sl: Malo navadnega jogurta je za nekatere pse lahko priboljšek. Sladek ali aromatiziran jogurt ni za pse.

q.en: Is Greek yogurt better for dogs?
q.sl: Je grški jogurt boljši za pse?

a.en: Usually yes: plain Greek-style yogurt has lower levels of lactose than regular yogurt.
a.sl: Običajno da: navaden grški jogurt ima manj laktoze kot običajni jogurt.

q.en: Why check the label?
q.sl: Zakaj preveriti etiketo?

a.en: Some yogurts contain sweeteners such as xylitol, which is toxic to dogs, or added sugar.
a.sl: Nekateri jogurti vsebujejo sladila, kot je ksilitol, ki je za pse strupen, ali dodan sladkor.
